paras.en: "What is particularly important is that the students have never compromised on these values and principles. Of course, widespread public dissatisfaction also played a major role, along with a lack of trust in both the current regime and the opposition parties," Jevtic explained.
paras.zh: “特别重要的是，学生们从未在这些价值观和原则上妥协。当然，公众普遍的不满情绪以及对现政权和反对党缺乏信任也发挥了重要作用，”耶夫提奇解释道。

paras.en: Jevtic said he believes the priorities for the new Student List-run government should be economic stability, fighting corruption, establishing the rule of law and strengthening institutions, much of what carried the student-led protests since 2024.
paras.zh: 杰夫蒂克表示，他认为新的学生名单政府的首要任务应该是经济稳定、打击腐败、建立法治和加强机构，这些都是 2024 年以来学生主导的抗议活动的主要内容。

paras.en: "The ultimate goal is to build a system in which institutions function in the interests of all citizens," Jevtic said.
paras.zh: 耶夫蒂克说：“最终目标是建立一个制度，让各机构为所有公民的利益发挥作用。”

paras.en: On foreign policy, there is an expectation that there will be a certain degree of continuity with the Vucic administration in international relations, including maintaining good relations with neighboring European countries and all major international partners.
paras.zh: 在外交政策上，人们期望在国际关系上与武契奇政府保持一定程度的连续性，包括与欧洲邻国和所有主要国际伙伴保持良好关系。

paras.en: But Brnabic warned that "Serbia has lost meaningful political pluralism. After 35 years of a multiparty system, the country is effectively left with one established political party, SNS, while the rest of the political scene is dominated by largely unknown movements without a clear ideology. This is catastrophic for any parliamentary democracy."
paras.zh: 但布尔纳比奇警告说，“塞尔维亚已经失去了有意义的政治多元化。经过35年的多党制，该国实际上只剩下一个既定的政党——SNS，而政治舞台的其余部分则由基本上不为人知的运动主导，没有明确的意识形态。这对任何议会民主制来说都是灾难性的。”

paras.en: She added, "Secondly, nobody in Serbia knows where the country is heading. Are we firmly pro-EU? Will we maintain our ties with Russia? What about China? Will we continue to enhance our relations with the United States — which was a priority of Aleksandar Vucic? Will economic policy be more left-liberal or conservative? Are we heading towards a woke liberal society, or will we preserve our traditional Orthodox Christian values? There are no clear answers to any of these questions."
paras.zh: 她补充道，“其次，塞尔维亚没有人知道这个国家的发展方向。我们是坚定支持欧盟吗？我们会维持与俄罗斯的关系吗？中国呢？我们会继续加强与美国的关系——这是亚历山大·武契奇的优先事项吗？经济政策会更加左翼自由还是更加保守？我们是走向一个觉醒的自由社会，还是会保留我们传统的东正教价值观？这些问题都没有明确的答案。”

paras.en: She concluded by noting, "We have also called for Parliament and all state institutions to be constituted as soon as possible, so that the country has functioning institutions on which people can rely. We will be a strong but constructive opposition. We call on the Student List’s representatives to end the intimidation and assume the responsibility entrusted to them by the voters."
paras.zh: 她最后指出，“我们还呼吁尽快组建议会和所有国家机构，以便国家拥有人民可以依赖的运转良好的机构。我们将成为强有力但建设性的反对派。我们呼吁学生名单的代表停止恐吓，承担起选民赋予他们的责任。”

articles.title: US military says strike on alleged drug vessel in eastern Pacific kills five people
articles.author: Guardian staff and agencies

paras.en: The US military said on Tuesday it killed five people after an airstrike on a suspected drug-trafficking vessel in the eastern Pacific.
paras.zh: 美国军方周二表示，在东太平洋对一艘涉嫌贩毒的船只进行空袭后，造成五人死亡。

paras.en: Tuesday’s strike was among more than 70 such attacks since the beginning of Donald Trump’s second presidency, according to media tallies. Collectively, they have killed more than 240 people.
paras.zh: 据媒体统计，自唐纳德·特朗普就任第二任总统以来，周二发生的袭击事件已超过 70 起。他们总共杀死了 240 多人。

paras.en: The Trump administration has maintained the people and boats were involved in trafficking. Trump has said the US is locked in armed conflict with Latin American cartels while justifying strikes as necessary to stem the flow of drugs into the US.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府坚称这些人和船只参与了贩运活动。特朗普表示，美国与拉丁美洲贩毒集团陷入武装冲突，同时为阻止毒品流入美国而采取必要的打击行动。

paras.en: But the Trump administration has not provided definitive evidence to back up its contentions of drug trafficking and has prompted debate about the legality of the strikes.
paras.zh: 但特朗普政府尚未提供明确的证据来支持其贩毒论点，并引发了有关袭击合法性的争论。

paras.en: Legal experts and rights groups argue the strikes could amount to extrajudicial killings because they have apparently targeted civilians who do not pose an immediate threat to the US.
paras.zh: 法律专家和人权组织认为，这些袭击可能构成法外处决，因为他们显然针对的是不会对美国构成直接威胁的平民。

paras.en: Reuters, the Associated Press and Agence France-Presse contributed reporting
paras.zh: 路透社、美联社和法新社提供报道

articles.title: Oleshky truce appears to hold as two European leaders have ‘frank’ call with Putin
articles.author: Luke Harding and Pjotr Sauer

paras.en: A local ceasefire in a southern Ukrainian city under Russian occupation appeared to be holding on Tuesday, with both sides ceasing drone attacks ahead of an apparent evacuation of about 2,000 trapped and desperate civilians.
paras.zh: 周二，俄罗斯占领下的乌克兰南部城市的局部停火似乎得以实现，双方停止了无人机袭击，随后约 2000 名被困绝望的平民明显撤离。

paras.en: The temporary truce began at 3am in Russian-controlled Oleshky. The city sits on the Dnipro River and is about 3 miles (5km) from Kherson, a larger city on the opposite bank. Ukrainian troops recaptured Kherson in autumn 2022.
paras.zh: 临时休战于凌晨 3 点在俄罗斯控制的奥列什基开始。该城市坐落在第聂伯河沿岸，距离对岸较大的城市赫尔松约 3 英里（5 公里）。乌克兰军队于 2022 年秋季收复赫尔松。

paras.en: Witnesses reported that the deadly frontline across the river was quiet for the first time in four years. The pause in fighting is due to last until 11pm on Sunday, Ukrainian officials said, and represents a significant if limited moment of de-escalation.
paras.zh: 目击者称，河对岸的致命前线四年来首次陷入平静。乌克兰官员表示，战斗暂停将持续到周日晚上 11 点，这代表着紧张局势缓和的一个重要但有限的时刻。

paras.en: Finland’s president, Alexander Stubb, and Norway’s prime minister, Jonas Gahr Støre, held what they described as a “frank and substantive” phone call with Vladimir Putin about efforts to end the war in Ukraine. Støre indicated afterwards that big differences remained.
paras.zh: 芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布和挪威首相乔纳斯·加尔·斯托尔与弗拉基米尔·普京就结束乌克兰战争的努力进行了“坦诚而实质性”的通话。斯托尔事后指出，仍然存在很大差异。

paras.en: The two Nordic leaders said the call – a rare instance of direct contact between Putin and western leaders – was linked to upcoming talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US, expected to take place in Abu Dhabi next month.
paras.zh: 两位北欧领导人表示，这次通话是普京与西方领导人之间罕见的直接接触，与俄罗斯、乌克兰和美国即将举行的会谈有关，会谈预计将于下个月在阿布扎比举行。

paras.en: The ceasefire in Oleshky appears to be an attempt by the Kremlin to curry favour with Donald Trump before the trilateral meeting and next week’s US midterm elections. The first lady, Melania Trump, requested the humanitarian mission, and in a post on X said it was brought forward by two days to allow the delivery of critical aid.
paras.zh: 奥列什基停火似乎是克里姆林宫试图在三边会议和下周美国中期选举之前讨好唐纳德·特朗普。第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普请求执行人道主义任务，并在 X 上发帖表示，任务提前了两天，以便运送关键援助物资。

paras.en: Its geographical scope had been extended beyond Oleshky “within the Kherson region”, she added, to provide safe passage for convoys. Calls for a ceasefire were also issued by Pope Leo, the United Nations, EU officials and the Council of Europe.
paras.zh: 她补充说，其地理范围已超出奥列什基“赫尔松地区内”的范围，以便为车队提供安全通道。教皇利奥、联合国、欧盟官员和欧洲委员会也呼吁停火。

paras.en: Between 1,500 and 2,000 people in the city have been living under a complete blockade by Russia. The last delivery of food to stores was in May, and many people are now starving and eating weeds. The Ukrainian military has airdropped food using drones but locals say Russian security forces detain anyone who takes it.
paras.zh: 该市有1500至2000人一直生活在俄罗斯的全面封锁之下。上次向商店运送食物是在五月份，许多人现在正在挨饿并吃杂草。乌克兰军方使用无人机空投食物，但当地人称俄罗斯安全部队拘留了任何拿走食物的人。

paras.en: Russian soldiers have mined roads and use ruined buildings to coordinate round-the-clock strikes against Kherson. Some Oleshky residents have managed to escape, walking or cycling past bodies lying on the street and the burnt-out shells of vehicles.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯士兵在道路上埋设地雷，并利用毁坏的建筑物来协调对赫尔松的全天候打击。一些奥列什基居民设法逃脱，步行或骑自行车经过街上的尸体和烧毁的车辆外壳。

paras.en: Ukrainian observers say the Kremlin is planning a major propaganda tour this week in which Kyiv is blamed for Oleshky’s destruction. Trump-supporting US media channels have been invited to witness the evacuation, in which buses will take residents to occupied Crimea and Russia.
paras.zh: 乌克兰观察家表示，克里姆林宫计划本周进行一次大型宣传巡演，其中基辅被指责为奥列什基的破坏事件。支持特朗普的美国媒体渠道已被邀请见证这次疏散，巴士将把居民送往被占领的克里米亚和俄罗斯。

paras.en: Ksenia Arkhipova, who fled the city in 2022 and now, as a volunteer, helps others leave, said some residents have told her they fear Russian officials may “filter out” evacuees with pro-Ukraine views.
paras.zh: 克塞尼亚·阿尔希波娃 (Ksenia Arkhipova) 于 2022 年逃离该市，现在作为志愿者帮助其他人离开。她说，一些居民告诉她，他们担心俄罗斯官员可能会“过滤掉”持亲乌克兰观点的撤离者。

paras.en: “People say they are genuinely afraid that the Russians will check their phones and look for evidence of Ukrainian relatives or ties to the Armed Forces of Ukraine – something they have done repeatedly in other occupied territories,” Arkhipova told the Associated Press.
paras.zh: 阿尔希波娃告诉美联社：“人们说，他们真的担心俄罗斯人会检查他们的手机，寻找乌克兰亲属或与乌克兰武装部队有联系的证据——他们在其他被占领土上多次这样做过。”

paras.en: The ceasefire does not extend to other parts of Ukraine. Overnight, Russia bombarded Kyiv with drones and ballistic missiles, killing at least one person and injuring 15. It hit a university campus, wounding students, as well as a bridge over the Dnipro and metro infrastructure. Ten other regions came under fire.
paras.zh: 停火协议并未延伸至乌克兰其他地区。一夜之间，俄罗斯用无人机和弹道导弹轰炸了基辅，造成至少 1 人死亡、15 人受伤。飞机袭击了一所大学校园，造成学生受伤，还击中了第聂伯河上的一座桥梁和地铁基础设施。其他十个地区也受到攻击。

paras.en: The bridge remains closed to traffic, but some commuters walked across it to get to work. Writing on social media, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia “must stop dragging out this war” and said he welcomed European attempts to end it.
paras.zh: 这座桥仍然禁止通行，但一些通勤者步行穿过它去上班。弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在社交媒体上写道，俄罗斯“必须停止拖延这场战争”，并表示他欢迎欧洲结束这场战争的努力。

paras.en: He said Stubb and Støre had briefed him on their call with Putin. “Alex and Jonas clearly conveyed to the Russian leadership the need for genuine steps towards de-escalation, particularly when it comes to our energy sector and infrastructure,” Zelenskyy wrote.
paras.zh: 他说斯塔布和斯托雷向他通报了他们与普京的通话情况。泽伦斯基写道：“亚历克斯和乔纳斯明确向俄罗斯领导层传达了采取真正步骤缓和局势的必要性，特别是在我们的能源部门和基础设施方面。”

paras.en: The Finnish-Norwegian initiative comes amid growing efforts by some European nations to establish a direct channel of communication with Moscow and secure a stronger European voice in negotiations. Stubb and Støre said they took part in the call as leaders of their respective countries and were not speaking on behalf of Europe as a whole.
paras.zh: 芬兰和挪威的倡议是在一些欧洲国家不断努力建立与莫斯科的直接沟通渠道并确保欧洲在谈判中拥有更强有力的声音的背景下提出的。斯塔布和斯托尔表示，他们作为各自国家的领导人参加了这次电话会议，并不代表整个欧洲发言。

paras.en: European governments remain divided over whether direct engagement with Putin is worthwhile, given Russia’s maximalist demands remain stubbornly unchanged. There is little agreement on who should lead such talks. Stubb is seen by some EU officials as a candidate.
paras.zh: 鉴于俄罗斯的最高要求仍然顽固地保持不变，欧洲各国政府对于与普京直接接触是否值得存在分歧。对于谁应该领导此类会谈几乎没有达成一致。一些欧盟官员将斯塔布视为候选人。

paras.en: The divisions were laid bare shortly after news of the call emerged, when Denmark’s prime minister, Mette Frederiksen, criticised the move. “I am very sceptical about this independent initiative by Norway and Finland. It was not agreed with any of us,” Frederiksen said.
paras.zh: 这一呼吁的消息传出后不久，丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森(Mette Frederiksen)批评了此举，分歧就暴露无遗。 “我对挪威和芬兰的这项独立倡议非常怀疑。我们没有人同意它，”弗雷德里克森说。

paras.en: She added: “I see no signs that Russia wants peace with Europe – neither in the hybrid warfare it wages every day, nor in Ukraine, where brutal and aggressive strikes continue daily, claiming many lives.”
paras.zh: 她补充道：“我没有看到任何迹象表明俄罗斯希望与欧洲实现和平——无论是在它每天发动的混合战争中，还是在乌克兰，那里每天都在发生残酷和侵略性的袭击，夺去了许多人的生命。”

paras.en: Russia’s foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov, said the Europeans had offered “nothing new”, and were simply trying to insert themselves in the negotiation process.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫表示，欧洲人没有提出“任何新内容”，只是试图介入谈判进程。

paras.en: This month Putin said he was willing to resume peace talks, but only on Russia’s hardline terms. They include the handover of the entire eastern Donbas region, including parts Russia has been unable to seize since 2014, as well as further territory in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia provinces.
paras.zh: 普京本月表示，他愿意恢复和谈，但前提是俄罗斯提出强硬条件。其中包括移交整个顿巴斯东部地区，包括俄罗斯自2014年以来无法夺取的部分地区，以及赫尔松省和扎波罗热省的更多领土。

paras.en: Last week Zelenskyy said he was open to a peace agreement that would freeze the war along the current frontlines. “Yes, we are ready to stop this war as soon as possible,” he said in an interview with ABC News. He made clear that Ukraine would not recognise land seized and occupied by Russia as Russian.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基上周表示，他对一项和平协议持开放态度，该协议将冻结当前前线的战争。 “是的，我们准备尽快停止这场战争，”他在接受美国广播公司新闻采访时说。他明确表示，乌克兰不会承认俄罗斯夺取和占领的土地是俄罗斯的。

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro flees Brazil after presidential election loss, reports say
articles.author: Tiago Rogero in Brasília and Tom Phillips in São Paulo

paras.en: The far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro has reportedly fled Brazil and is on his way to the United States after losing Sunday’s presidential election to the leftwing incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
paras.zh: 据报道，极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在周日的总统选举中输给左翼现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦后，已逃离巴西，前往美国。

paras.en: A report by the news website Metrópoles, citing people close to the politician’s family, said he was en route to the US. “The plane is in flight,” Metrópoles reported, without making clear where it had departed from.
paras.zh: 新闻网站Metrópoles援引这位政治家家人的知情人士的话报道说，他正在前往美国的途中。梅特罗波尔斯报道称：“飞机正在飞行中”，但没有明确说明飞机是从哪里起飞的。

paras.en: Bolsonaro allies told Metrópoles that he would land in Florida on Tuesday afternoon and planned to request political asylum. “The Donald Trump administration has been informed,” the website added.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的盟友告诉大都会报，他将于周二下午抵达佛罗里达州，并计划申请政治庇护。该网站补充道：“唐纳德·特朗普政府已获悉。”

paras.en: Allies also confirmed to the Folha de S Paulo newspaper that he was on his way to the US, and said the escape plan had been “organized and enabled by a lawyer close to the Bolsonaro clan”.
paras.zh: 盟友还向《圣保罗页报》证实，他正在前往美国的途中，并表示逃跑计划是“由一位与博尔索纳罗家族关系密切的律师组织和促成的”。

paras.en: “They say the flight should land in a few hours,” the newspaper added.
paras.zh: “他们说航班将在几个小时内降落，”该报补充道。

paras.en: The news network CNN Brasil reported that Bolsonaro had fled to the US with his wife and two daughters in the early hours of this morning.
paras.zh: 据CNN巴西新闻网报道，博尔索纳罗今天凌晨与妻子和两个女儿逃往美国。

paras.en: Bolsonaro had not been seen since Monday and missed a Tuesday-morning deadline to hand his passport to the federal police, fuelling rumours that he may have fled Brazil after losing on Sunday.
paras.zh: 自周一以来，博尔索纳罗就再也没有出现过，并且错过了周二上午将护照交给联邦警察的最后期限，这加剧了有关他在周日落败后可能逃离巴西的谣言。

paras.en: A report in the Brazilian newspaper O Globo said that during a meeting with friends and lawyers on Monday, the defeated candidate had appeared “possessed and made it clear he was afraid of being arrested”.
paras.zh: 巴西《环球报》的一篇报道称，在周一与朋友和律师的会面中，落选的候选人显得“着魔了，并明确表示他害怕被捕”。

paras.en: A supreme court justice cancelled Bolsonaro’s passport minutes after the result in a ruling related to a criminal case against the senator. He had until 11am to surrender the document to the federal police, but did not appear.
paras.zh: 最高法院法官在针对博尔索纳罗的刑事案件作出裁决后几分钟就取消了他的护照。他必须在上午 11 点之前将文件交给联邦警察，但他没有出现。

paras.en: The Argentinian news website Infobae reported that on Monday night he reportedly fled to Argentina, where he was expected to board a private jet in Puerto Iguazú bound for the US, but the plane did not take off.
paras.zh: 阿根廷新闻网站Infobae报道称，周一晚间，据报道他逃往阿根廷，预计他将在伊瓜苏港登上一架飞往美国的私人飞机，但飞机没有起飞。

paras.en: Bolsonaro, who has yet to concede defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, posted a video on Monday in which, commenting on the cancellation of his passport, he said: “I never thought about leaving the country.”
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗尚未承认输给路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦，他周一发布了一段视频，在评论他的护照被取消时，他说：“我从未想过离开这个国家。”

paras.en: One of the senator’s brothers, the former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, who is in self-imposed exile in the US, had said in an interview last Friday that his brother should leave Brazil if he lost.
paras.zh: 这位参议员的兄弟之一、目前在美国自我流亡的前国会议员爱德华多·博索纳罗(Eduardo Bolsonaro)上周五在接受采访时表示，如果他失败了，他的兄弟应该离开巴西。

paras.en: The Brazilian newspaper Folha de S Paulo reported that allies in the Bolsonaro family’s inner circle had been told that he had indeed left for Argentina and intended to travel from there to the US.
paras.zh: 巴西《圣保罗页报》报道称，博尔索纳罗家族的核心盟友被告知，他确实已前往阿根廷，并打算从那里前往美国。

paras.en: As there is no record of him passing through any regular Brazilian immigration checkpoint, the federal police are trying to establish from Argentinian authorities whether there is any record of him entering the country.
paras.zh: 由于没有他通过巴西任何常规移民检查站的记录，联邦警察正在试图向阿根廷当局确认是否有他进入该国的记录。

paras.en: The Argentinian channel Todo Noticias reported that the senator had reportedly crossed the border into Argentina on foot and abandoned plans to board the plane once news of his movements leaked.
paras.zh: 阿根廷《消息报》频道报道称，据报道，这位参议员步行越过边境进入阿根廷，并在其行踪消息泄露后放弃了登机计划。

paras.en: Bolsonaro was told to surrender his passport over a criminal case in which the federal police are investigating him for possible involvement in a money-laundering scheme worth about £680m ($905m) involving betting companies.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗因一起刑事案件被告知交出护照，联邦警察正在调查他可能参与涉及博彩公司的价值约 6.8 亿英镑（合 9.05 亿美元）的洗钱计划。

paras.en: The senator’s possible flight makes the future of the far right after the presidential election even more uncertain. The family patriarch, Jair Bolsonaro, is under house arrest for attempting a coup, and one of his sons is in the US and the whereabouts of another unclear.
paras.zh: 参议员可能的出逃使得总统选举后极右翼的未来更加不确定。该家族族长雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗因企图政变而被软禁，他的一个儿子在美国，另一个儿子下落不明。

paras.en: Eduardo Bolsonaro has an outstanding arrest warrant against him in Brazil, after being sentenced to four years in prison for trying to interfere in his father’s trial by lobbying Donald Trump to impose sanctions on the justices hearing the case.
paras.zh: 爱德华多·博尔索纳罗在巴西因试图游说唐纳德·特朗普对审理此案的法官实施制裁而干预其父亲的审判而被判处四年监禁，目前尚未对他发出逮捕令。

paras.en: Political scientist Magna Inácio, a professor at the Federal University of Minas Gerais, believes a power vacuum may now emerge within the right.
paras.zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯联邦大学教授、政治学家麦格纳·伊纳西奥认为，右翼内部现在可能出现权力真空。

paras.en: “The resistance of Brazilian voters to handing victory to this more extremist camp sends a signal that the right leadership is now up for grabs,” she said.
paras.zh: “巴西选民抵制将胜利交给这个更加极端主义的阵营，这发出了一个信号，即正确的领导层现在正在等待争夺，”她说。

paras.en: Since Jair Bolsonaro, then a career congressman with few laws to his name, surprisingly won the presidency in 2018, there has effectively been no right wing in Brazil, only the far-right Bolsonarismo movement.
paras.zh: 贾尔·博尔索纳罗（Jair Bolsonaro）当时是一名职业国会议员，名下几乎没有什么法律，但自从他在 2018 年出人意料地赢得总统职位以来，巴西实际上已经没有右翼了，只有极右翼的博尔索纳主义运动。

paras.en: Camila Rocha, a political scientist who studies Brazil’s new right, believes the fact that three Bolsonaros are now potentially out of the picture could trigger a “shift in power” away from blood ties.
paras.zh: 研究巴西新右翼的政治学家卡米拉·罗查 (Camila Rocha) 认为，三名博尔索纳罗现在有可能退出这一事实，这可能会引发血缘关系的“权力转移”。

paras.en: “I think there is a tendency for power to move away from the sons,” said Rocha, noting that before the election, polls showed Jair Bolsonaro supporters preferred other potential candidates over his eldest son, including Jair Bolsonaro’s wife, Michelle Bolsonaro, who was recently elected senator, and the São Paulo governor, Tarcísio de Freitas.
paras.zh: 罗查表示：“我认为权力有从儿子手中转移的趋势。”他指出，选举前的民意调查显示，雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的支持者更喜欢其他潜在候选人，而不是他的长子，其中包括雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的妻子、最近当选参议员的米歇尔·博尔索纳罗和圣保罗州长塔尔西西奥·德弗雷塔斯。

paras.en: Flávio Bolsonaro reportedly did not want to run because he thought a presidential campaign would turn his life into “hell”, and believed his re-election to the senate was assured. But with Eduardo, his father’s “plan A”, now living in the US, the senator was chosen to run.
paras.zh: 据报道，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗不想参选，因为他认为总统竞选会让他的生活变成“地狱”，并相信他将再次当选参议员。但随着他父亲的“A计划”爱德华多现在居住在美国，这位参议员被选为参选人。

paras.en: Most observers agree that Flávio lacks his father’s charisma. He had a 24-year political career in which he passed very few laws as a state legislator and senator, and the only previous time he ran for executive office was for mayor of Rio de Janeiro in 2016, when he fainted during a televised debate and finished fourth.
paras.zh: 大多数观察家都认为弗拉维奥缺乏他父亲的魅力。他拥有 24 年的政治生涯，作为州议员和参议员，通过的法律很少。他上一次竞选行政职务是 2016 年竞选里约热内卢市长，当时他在电视辩论中晕倒，最终获得第四名。

paras.en: Even in a family frequently embroiled in legal trouble he stood out, facing longstanding criminal allegations, including suspicions that he embezzled part of his staff’s salaries, as well as more recent accusations.
paras.zh: 即使在一个经常卷入法律纠纷的家庭中，他也脱颖而出，面临着长期的刑事指控，包括怀疑他挪用部分员工工资，以及最近的指控。

paras.en: Even so, 48.21% of Brazilians voted for Flávio Bolsonaro on Sunday, which many analysts see as both an anti-Lula vote and a vote for whomever Jair Bolsonaro had chosen.
paras.zh: 即便如此，周日仍有 48.21% 的巴西人投票支持弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，许多分析人士认为，这既是反对卢拉的投票，也是对雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗选择的人的投票。

paras.en: Inácio believes the struggle over the Bolsonaro legacy will also play out among family members who remain in Brazil, including Michelle and Bolsonaro’s other political sons, the senator-elect Carlos Bolsonaro and congressman-elect Jair Renan Bolsonaro, who publicly do not get along with their stepmother.
paras.zh: 伊纳西奥认为，围绕博尔索纳罗遗产的斗争也将在留在巴西的家庭成员中展开，包括米歇尔和博尔索纳罗的其他政治儿子、当选参议员卡洛斯·博尔索纳罗和当选国会议员贾尔·雷南·博尔索纳罗，他们在公开场合与继母相处不睦。

paras.en: “Michelle clearly has a political project of her own, but she is likely to face strong resistance from the two stepsons who are in congress. It is only a matter of time before tensions between them grow,” said the political scientist.
paras.zh: 这位政治学家表示：“米歇尔显然有自己的政治计划，但她可能会面临国会中两个继子的强烈抵制。他们之间的紧张关系加剧只是时间问题。”

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro's passports cancelled after he fails to surrender them

paras.en: Police in Brazil say they have cancelled the passports of the defeated right-wing presidential candidate, FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro, after he failed to comply with an order to surrender the documents.
paras.zh: 巴西警方表示，因失败的右翼总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗未能遵守交出文件的命令，他们已取消了他的护照。

paras.en: On Monday, the Supreme Court ordered Bolsonaro to hand his passports over to police within 24 hours as part of an investigation into alleged money laundering, which he denies.
paras.zh: 周一，最高法院命令博尔索纳罗在 24 小时内将护照交给警方，作为洗钱指控调查的一部分，但博尔索纳罗否认了这一点。

paras.en: At the time, Bolsonaro said he had no plans to leave the country, and insisted that he would stay in Brazil to lead the opposition to his left-wing rival, President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva.
paras.zh: 当时，博尔索纳罗表示，他没有离开巴西的计划，并坚称他将留在巴西，领导反对派反对他的左翼竞争对手、总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦。

paras.en: However, the deadline has passed without the senator surrendering the passports, prompting speculation he may have left the country.
paras.zh: 然而，截止日期已过，参议员仍未交出护照，这引发了人们对他可能已离开该国的猜测。

paras.en: Federal officers are checking border crossings to establish if Bolsonaro may have travelled to neighbouring Argentina, according to a police source consulted by BBC News Brasil.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司巴西新闻部咨询的警方消息人士透露，联邦官员正在检查边境口岸，以确定博尔索纳罗是否可能前往邻国阿根廷。

paras.en: However, Argentine authorities have told the BBC there is no record of Bolsonaro entering their country through any border crossing.
paras.zh: 然而，阿根廷当局告诉英国广播公司，没有博尔索纳罗通过任何过境点进入阿根廷的记录。

paras.en: Bolsonaro was already under investigation for alleged corruption over the financing of a film about his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who was convicted of plotting a coup and is under house arrest.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗已经因涉嫌为其父亲、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的电影融资而受到调查，博尔索纳罗因策划政变而被定罪，目前被软禁。

paras.en: In addition to that investigation, Brazil's Supreme Court ordered police on Tuesday to probe FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro's electoral campaign over alleged foreign funding.
paras.zh: 除了这项调查外，巴西最高法院周二还命令警方调查弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗涉嫌接受外国资助的竞选活动。

paras.en: The 45-year-old senator suffered a stinging defeat on Sunday when he was beaten by Lula in a presidential run-off, which Bolsonaro had been widely expected to win.
paras.zh: 这位45岁的参议员周日在总统决选中惨遭卢拉击败，此前人们普遍预计博尔索纳罗会获胜。

paras.en: Opinion polls had put him narrowly ahead of Lula and analysts pointed out that Bolsonaro's win in the first round of the election on 4 October, meant he was likely to take victory in the run-off.
paras.zh: 民调显示他以微弱优势领先卢拉，分析人士指出，博尔索纳罗在10月4日第一轮选举中获胜，意味着他很可能在决选中获胜。

paras.en: But after an early lead in the count, he was overtaken by the veteran incumbent, who became the first presidential candidate to overturn a first round loss to win in the second round.
paras.zh: 但在计票初期领先后，他被这位资深的现任总统超越，成为第一位扭转第一轮失利并在第二轮获胜的总统候选人。

paras.en: Lula won 51.79% of the vote, compared to Bolsonaro's 48.21%.
paras.zh: 卢拉赢得了51.79%的选票，而博尔索纳罗的得票率为48.21%。

paras.en: Despite trailing by 4.4 million votes, Bolsonaro has not conceded and has called for the election to be annulled.
paras.zh: 尽管落后 440 万票，博尔索纳罗并未认输，并呼吁取消选举。

paras.en: He argues that he was put at a disadvantage because polling was extended by two hours on election day - even though the extension was requested by both his party and that of his rival.
paras.zh: 他辩称，他处于不利地位，因为投票在选举日延长了两个小时——尽管他的政党和竞争对手都要求延长投票时间。

paras.en: He called the extension, which was ordered by a Supreme Court justice, a "dirty trick".
paras.zh: 他称最高法院法官下令的延期是“肮脏的伎俩”。

paras.en: However the party he represented, the Liberal Party, has accepted the result, although it did say that the extension of voting "merits investigation".
paras.zh: 然而，他所代表的自由党已经接受了这一结果，尽管它确实表示延长投票“值得调查”。

articles.title: Nanotyrannus skeleton sells for $47.3m in New York auction

paras.en: The mounted skeleton of a newly-identified dinosaur once mistaken for a young Tyrannosaurus rex has sold at auction for a colossal $47.3m (Â£35.5m).
paras.zh: 一具新发现的恐龙骨架曾被误认为是年轻的霸王龙，如今在拍卖会上以 4730 万美元（3550 万英镑）的天价售出。

paras.en: Nicknamed Jodi, the roughly 10-foot-tall (3m) skeleton was auctioned by Sotheby's in New York. The sale comes a year after researchers confirmed that the skeleton belongs to a distinct genus.
paras.zh: 这具绰号为“乔迪”(Jodi) 的骨架高约 10 英尺 (3m)，由纽约苏富比拍卖行拍卖。此次拍卖是在研究人员确认该骨骼属于一个独特属一年后进行的。

paras.en: The Late Cretaceous carnivore was expected to fetch at least $9m when it went under the hammer on Tuesday. The auction comes after Sotheby's sold a Tyrannosaurus rex, dubbed Gus, for a record $50.1m in July.
paras.zh: 这只白垩纪晚期的食肉动物周二拍卖时预计售价至少为 900 万美元。此次拍卖是在苏富比拍卖行于 7 月份以创纪录的 5010 万美元售出一只名为 Gus 的霸王龙之后进行的。

paras.en: The sale has reignited debate in the scientific community over whether dinosaur remains should be sold privately or displayed publicly.
paras.zh: 这次出售重新引发了科学界关于恐龙遗骸是否应该私下出售还是公开展示的争论。

paras.en: Sotheby's described Jodi as an "excellent exhibition-ready" skeleton with about 191 fossil-bone elements and a "beautifully preserved, virtually complete skull".
paras.zh: 苏富比将乔迪描述为“优秀的展览就绪”骨架，包含约 191 个化石骨骼元素和“保存完好、几乎完整的头骨”。

paras.en: The auction house added that the Nanotyrannus is "one of only three such skeletons known to science". The specimen is the first to come to market since the existence of the genus was confirmed by US researchers last October, Sotheby's said.
paras.zh: 拍卖行补充说，矮暴龙是“科学界已知的仅有的三具此类骨骼之一”。苏富比表示，该标本是自去年 10 月美国研究人员证实该属存在以来第一个进入市场的标本。

paras.en: The identify of the buyer, who won after a thrilling 12 minutes of auction bidding between six interested parties, has not been disclosed.
paras.zh: 六位感兴趣的各方经过 12 分钟的激动人心的拍卖竞价后获胜，买家的身份尚未透露。

paras.en: It becomes the second-most valuable dinosaur fossil ever sold, behind Gus. The third-most valuable was a Stegosaurus named Apex, which was sold by Sotheby's in July 2024 for $44.6m.
paras.zh: 它成为有史以来售出的第二高价值的恐龙化石，仅次于格斯。第三高价值的是一只名为 Apex 的剑龙，它于 2024 年 7 月被苏富比拍卖行以 4460 万美元的价格售出。

paras.en: Megan Jenkins, a palaeontologist at the University of Portsmouth, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme on Tuesday that Nanotyrannus "was for a very long time believed to be sort of a teenager of T. rex".
paras.zh: 朴茨茅斯大学的古生物学家梅根·詹金斯 (Megan Jenkins) 周二在 BBC 广播四台的《今日》节目中表示，矮暴龙“很长一段时间以来都被认为是霸王龙的少年”。

paras.en: "But it's a lot smaller and its a lot more gracile. So it's very sort-of sleek, slender, [with] blade-like teeth for slicing through meat," Jenkins said.
paras.zh: “但它要小得多，而且更纤细。所以它非常光滑、细长，有刀片状的牙齿，可以切肉，”詹金斯说。

paras.en: Tyrannosaurus rex and Nanotyrannus lived alongside one another during the same geological period approximately 67 million years ago.
paras.zh: 霸王龙和矮暴龙在大约 6700 万年前的同一地质时期共同生活。

paras.en: Jodi was initially exhibited as a juvenile T. rex at London's Frieze Masters international art fair in October 2023, before the Nanotyrannus genus was classified.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月，在小暴龙属被分类之前，乔迪最初以幼年霸王龙的身份在伦敦弗里兹大师国际艺术博览会上展出。

paras.en: The skeleton was discovered in the US state of Montana by rancher Jodi Pierson on her land in the Hell Creek Formation, a heavily studied geological site. It was later excavated by commercial palaeontologist Clayton Phipps.
paras.zh: 这具骨架是由牧场主乔迪·皮尔森 (Jodi Pierson) 在美国蒙大拿州地狱溪地层 (Hell Creek Formation) 的土地上发现的，这是一个经过深入研究的地质地点。后来它被商业古生物学家克莱顿·菲普斯挖掘出来。

paras.en: Phipps also discovered the famous "Dueling Dinosaurs" fossil. That specimen, which shows the remains of a Nanotyrannus and Triceratops apparently in combat, was found eight miles (13km) away from Jodi in 2006.
paras.zh: 菲普斯还发现了著名的“决斗恐龙”化石。该标本于 2006 年在距乔迪 8 英里（13 公里）处发现，显示了显然正在战斗的矮暴龙和三角龙的遗骸。

paras.en: The "Dueling Dinosaurs" discovery became crucial to the research published by Lindsay Zanno and James Napoli that classified Nanotyrannus as separate from T. rex. Their paper ended decades of debate over whether the dinosaurs were distinct from one another.
paras.zh: “决斗恐龙”的发现对于 Lindsay Zanno 和 James Napoli 发表的研究至关重要，该研究将小暴龙与霸王龙分开。他们的论文结束了数十年来关于恐龙是否彼此不同的争论。

paras.en: The auction of Jodi comes as some scientists warn that auctions could herald a new era in fossil collecting by the ultra-rich.
paras.zh: 乔迪的拍卖正值一些科学家警告称，拍卖可能预示着超级富豪化石收藏的新时代。

paras.en: Researchers told the BBC after the sale of Gus that such remains should be exhibited in public spaces where they can be more freely studied.
paras.zh: 研究人员在古斯出售后告诉英国广播公司，这些遗骸应该在公共场所展出，以便人们可以更自由地研究它们。

paras.en: Prof Steve Brusatte, a palaeontologist at the University of Edinburgh and consultant on the Jurassic Park films, told BBC World Service's What in the World programme in July that the T. rex's auction was "concerning".
paras.zh: 爱丁堡大学古生物学家、《侏罗纪公园》电影顾问史蒂夫·布鲁萨特 (Steve Brusatte) 教授在 7 月份向 BBC 国际频道的“世界观”节目表示，霸王龙的拍卖“令人担忧”。

paras.en: "I don't know of any museum or university that can afford a price tag like that," he said. "Imagine if the Mona Lisa was just owned by a super-wealthy person and it wasn't on display and people couldn't see it, couldn't enjoy it."
paras.zh: “我不知道有哪个博物馆或大学能负担得起这样的价格，”他说。 “想象一下，如果《蒙娜丽莎》只是一位超级富豪的拥有者，而它没有被展示出来，人们就看不到它，无法欣赏它。”

paras.en: He said at the time that he hoped such a sale didn't become a trend, adding it could adversely affect scientific research and public education.
paras.zh: 他当时表示，他希望这种出售不会成为一种趋势，并补充说这可能会对科学研究和公共教育产生不利影响。

paras.en: Responding to Tuesday's auction, Brusatte called it "harrowing" that Jodi could disappear from public view.
paras.zh: 在回应周二的拍卖时，布鲁萨特称乔迪可能从公众视野中消失是“令人痛苦的”。

paras.en: "We've really just found out that Nanotyrannus is real, and now one of the best skeletons is about to be sold to the highest bidder, and it's harrowing to think it could disappear into the vaults of a collector rather than displayed on a museum where it can wow and inspire kids and families and the public at large," he told the BBC.
paras.zh: 他告诉英国广播公司：“我们刚刚发现矮暴龙是真实的，现在最好的骨架之一即将被卖给出价最高的人，一想到它可能会消失在收藏家的金库里，而不是在博物馆里展示，它可以让孩子、家庭和广大公众惊叹不已，激发他们的灵感，真是令人痛苦。”

paras.en: But Jenkins told the Today programme on Tuesday there were two sides to the debate, and that a lot of time, effort and money went into excavating the specimens.
paras.zh: 但詹金斯周二告诉《今日》节目，争论有两个方面，挖掘标本投入了大量的时间、精力和金钱。

paras.en: "I don't begrudge the people involved for wanting to sell it for such a large amount of money," she said. "Although its a scary prospect, actually a lot of them have ended up in the public eye... these things without a doubt will end end up in a museum at some point."
paras.zh: 她说：“我并不嫉妒那些想要以如此大的价格出售它的人。” “虽然这是一个可怕的前景，但实际上其中很多已经出现在公众视野中......毫无疑问，这些东西最终会在某个时候进入博物馆。”

articles.title: Turnout so far highest on record as Israelis vote in pivotal election

paras.en: Turnout so far is the highest on record, as Israelis vote in what many view as one of the most pivotal elections in the country's history.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，投票率是有记录以来最高的，因为以色列人在许多人看来是该国历史上最关键的选举之一进行了投票。

paras.en: Polling published on Friday suggests incumbent Benjamin Netanyahu is almost neck-and-neck with former military chief Gadi Eisenkot in the race to become prime minister.
paras.zh: 周五公布的民意调查显示，现任总理内塔尼亚胡在总理竞选中与前军事首长加迪·艾森科特几乎不相上下。

paras.en: But neither of their political blocs is projected to win the 61 seats needed to form a government - and weeks or months of political wrangling may lie ahead.
paras.zh: 但预计他们的政治集团都无法赢得组建政府所需的 61 个席位，而且未来可能会持续数周或数月的政治角力。

paras.en: The campaign has been shaped by the issues of democracy and security, and the election is widely being seen as a referendum on Netanyahu's rule.
paras.zh: 此次竞选活动受到民主和安全问题的影响，这次选举被广泛视为对内塔尼亚胡统治的全民公投。

paras.en: Throughout polling day, Netanyahu has posted on social media about a reportedly high turnout among Arab voters. He has labelled it an "emergency" and a "matter of life or death" for the Israeli right, and called on his supporters to get out and vote.
paras.zh: 在整个投票日，内塔尼亚胡在社交媒体上发布了有关阿拉伯选民投票率高的消息。他将其称为以色列右翼的“紧急情况”和“生死攸关的问题”，并呼吁他的支持者出去投票。

paras.en: His Likud party has said it has asked for voting to be extended beyond 22:00 (20:00 GMT). But Eisenkot's camp has called it an attempt to "lay the groundwork for allegations challenging the integrity of the election".
paras.zh: 他的利库德集团表示，已要求将投票时间延长至 22:00（格林威治标准时间 20:00）之后。但艾森科特的阵营称其为“为挑战选举公正性的指控奠定基础”的尝试。

paras.en: Many leading parties complained on Tuesday morning of alleged irregularities at polling stations across the country - but Israel's Central Election Committee (CEC) said there is no evidence of systematic tampering with ballot slips.
paras.zh: 许多主要政党周二上午抱怨全国各地投票站涉嫌违规行为，但以色列中央选举委员会（CEC）表示，没有证据表明选票被系统性篡改。

paras.en: Israel's proportional representation system means governments have always been coalitions - and the race to power can, and has, produced unexpected alliances. But this election looks especially tight - and lines in the sand have already been drawn.
paras.zh: 以色列的比例代表制意味着政府一直都是联盟——而权力竞赛可以而且已经产生了意想不到的联盟。但这次选举看起来特别紧张——而且界线已经划定。

paras.en: Eisenkot, who leads the newly formed Yashar Party, is the main figure in the so-called "change bloc", a collection of parties which have ideological differences but share the goal of ousting Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 艾森科特领导新成立的亚沙尔党，是所谓“变革集团”的主要人物。“变革集团”是一个由意识形态不同但共同目标是推翻内塔尼亚胡的政党组成的联盟。

paras.en: Other leaders in the bloc include former Prime Minister Naftali Bennett and Avigdor Lieberman - both right-wingers who take hardline positions on security - and Yair Golan, a left-leaning former general.
paras.zh: 该集团的其他领导人包括前总理纳夫塔利·贝内特和阿维格多·利伯曼——两人都是在安全问题上采取强硬立场的右翼分子——以及左倾前将军亚伊尔·戈兰。

paras.en: For Netanyahu, a titan of Israeli politics who first served as prime minister in 1996, a new term will hinge on another alliance with the far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties that make up his current governing coalition - the most right-wing in Israel's history.
paras.zh: 对于1996年首次担任总理的以色列政坛巨头内塔尼亚胡来说，新任期将取决于与极右翼和极端正统政党的再次联盟，这些政党组成了他目前的执政联盟——以色列历史上最右翼的联盟。

paras.en: There are two Arab party blocs in the running too, as about one-fifth of Israel's population is Arab - many of whom describe themselves as Palestinian citizens of Israel. In theory, they could prove kingmakers. However, all but one of the leading Jewish parties have ruled out working with them.
paras.zh: 还有两个阿拉伯政党集团也在竞选，因为以色列约五分之一的人口是阿拉伯人，其中许多人自称是以色列的巴勒斯坦公民。理论上，他们可以成为拥王者。然而，除了一个主要犹太政党外，其他所有政党都排除了与他们合作的可能性。

paras.en: The campaign has been dominated by the issue of security - with the opposition bloc hammering Netanyahu for the unprecedented security failure that led to the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel, in which nearly 1,200 people were killed and 251 taken back to Gaza as hostages.
paras.zh: 这场运动的主要议题是安全问题——反对派集团抨击内塔尼亚胡在安全方面史无前例的失败，导致哈马斯领导的2023年10月7日对以色列发动袭击，造成近1,200人死亡，251人被带回加沙作为人质。

paras.en: They have pushed for an independent commission of inquiry into the attacks - something Netanyahu has long resisted, insisting it would be biased against him.
paras.zh: 他们推动成立一个独立委员会对袭击事件进行调查，但内塔尼亚胡长期以来一直拒绝这样做，坚称这会对他产生偏见。

paras.en: They also point to what they see as threats to democracy under Netanyahu, who faces an ongoing trial on corruption charges - which he denies - and is still pursuing contentious plans for reforms to the judicial system, which led to mass protests before the 7 October attacks.
paras.zh: 他们还指出，他们认为内塔尼亚胡领导下的民主受到威胁，内塔尼亚胡面临着腐败指控的持续审判（他对此予以否认），并且仍在推行有争议的司法系统改革计划，这导致 10 月 7 日袭击之前引发大规模抗议。

paras.en: Despite the opposition's attack lines, Netanyahu has once again framed himself as "Mr Security" - pointing to what he says are strategic victories in Israel's wars across the Middle East and his close relationship with US President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 尽管反对派的攻击路线，内塔尼亚胡再次将自己称为“安全先生” - 指出他所说的以色列在中东战争中的战略胜利以及他与美国总统唐纳德特朗普的密切关系。

paras.en: On Sunday, Israel's Channel 12 reported that Netanyahu had pushed for last-minute military action that could trigger a confrontation with Iran prior to the elections, but was opposed by his own military chief Eyal Zamir. The following day, CNN reported that he had also tried to persuade Trump to carry out new strikes on Iran, but the US leader had refused to give the green light. Netanyahu denied both reports.
paras.zh: 周日，以色列第 12 频道报道称，内塔尼亚胡曾推动在选举前最后一刻采取军事行动，这可能引发与伊朗的对抗，但遭到了他自己的军事首长埃亚尔·扎米尔 (Eyal Zamir) 的反对。第二天，美国有线电视新闻网报道称，他还试图说服特朗普对伊朗进行新的打击，但美国领导人拒绝批准。内塔尼亚胡否认了这两项报道。

paras.en: He also made headlines in the final days of his campaign for posting an AI-generated image of a nuclear bomb hitting Tel Aviv, warning that he is the only leader who can protect Israel "if the Iranians acquire nuclear weapons". Eisenkot called him "hysterical".
paras.zh: 他还在竞选活动的最后几天因发布人工智能生成的核弹袭击特拉维夫的图像而成为头条新闻，并警告说，“如果伊朗人获得核武器”，他是唯一能够保护以色列的领导人。艾森科特称他“歇斯底里”。

paras.en: Another dominating issue has been conscription, with Netanyahu's government failing to enforce a Supreme Court ruling that ultra-Orthodox Jewish men in full-time religious study should be conscripted to the military - a highly divisive move.
paras.zh: 另一个主要问题是征兵问题，内塔尼亚胡政府未能执行最高法院的一项裁决，即应将从事全职宗教研究的极端正统犹太男子征召入伍——这是一个高度分裂的举动。

paras.en: Eisenkot takes a broadly similar position to Netanyahu on the Gaza Strip, and has pledged to end Hamas rule in the territory within 18 months through a US-led peace plan or, if necessary, military means.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在加沙地带的立场与内塔尼亚胡大致相似，并承诺在18个月内通过美国主导的和平计划或必要时采取军事手段，结束哈马斯对该地区的统治。

paras.en: Israel has continued to strike Gaza almost every day since a ceasefire was agreed last year, saying it is targeting Hamas operatives. The Israeli military has killed more than 74,000 people since the start of the war, according to Gaza's Hamas-run health ministry, whose figures are considered reliable by the UN.
paras.zh: 自去年达成停火协议以来，以色列几乎每天都继续袭击加沙，称其目标是哈马斯特工。据加沙哈马斯管理的卫生部称，自战争开始以来，以色列军队已造成超过 74,000 人死亡，联合国认为该数字是可靠的。

paras.en: Israel has faced growing international condemnation over its conduct in the war, and relations with its allies around the world have deteriorated.
paras.zh: 以色列因其在战争中的行为而面临越来越多的国际谴责，其与世界各地盟友的关系也不断恶化。

paras.en: Eisenkot largely supports Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank - which are illegal under international law - but wants to crack down on extremist Jewish settlers whose attacks are at an all-time high, according to UN figures. He has also spoken about creating the conditions for "autonomy or a state-minus" for Palestinians - under ultimate Israeli security control.
paras.zh: 根据联合国数据，艾森科特主要支持以色列在被占领的约旦河西岸建立定居点，根据国际法，这些定居点是非法的，但他希望打击极端主义犹太定居者，这些定居者的袭击数量达到历史最高水平。他还谈到为巴勒斯坦人创造“自治或无国​​家”的条件——在以色列的最终安全控制下。

paras.en: The two-state solution - the creation of an independent Palestinian state in peaceful coexistence alongside Israel - has all but disappeared from mainstream Israeli politics.
paras.zh: 两国解决方案——建立一个与以色列和平共处的独立巴勒斯坦国——几乎从以色列主流政治中消失。

paras.en: Though some have speculated that the Arab parties may end up informally propping up an Eisenkot-led minority government - Lieberman, a key prospective member, has ruled out being part of such an arrangement.
paras.zh: 尽管一些人猜测阿拉伯政党最终可能会非正式地支持艾森科特领导的少数派政府，但主要的潜在成员利伯曼已经排除了参与这种安排的可能性。

paras.en: Red lines like these mean the electoral arithmetic is complex, but it remains to be seen what kind of concessions, deals and U-turns can be reached once the results come in.
paras.zh: 像这样的红线意味着选举算术很复杂，但一旦结果出来，能达成什么样的让步、协议和掉头还有待观察。

paras.en: An unprecedented 70,000 people have reportedly flown home from abroad to vote, while hundreds of thousands are casting ballots for the first time.
paras.zh: 据报道，前所未有的7万人从国外飞回国内投票，而数十万人是首次投票。

paras.en: Once voting ends on Tuesday, Israeli broadcasters will publish exit polls. These will give some indication of the direction of voting, but can vary significantly.
paras.zh: 周二投票结束后，以色列广播公司将公布出口民意调查。这些将给出投票方向的一些指示，但可能会有很大差异。

paras.en: Up and down the country, Israelis will gather to watch the results trickle in, with Netanyahu's Likud meeting in Jerusalem and Eisenkot's Yashar - formed only last year - assembling in Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 全国各地的以色列人将聚集在一起，观看结果的逐渐显现，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团将在耶路撒冷举行会议，而艾森科特领导的亚沙尔集团（去年才成立）将在特拉维夫集会。

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of Israeli soldiers and reservists are also casting ballots, but many of those votes will not begin being counted until Wednesday - meaning there may be a late boon for the right-wing parties which are thought to have strong support from that demographic.
paras.zh: 数十万以色列士兵和预备役军人也在投票，但其中许多选票要到周三才会开始计票，这意味着右翼政党可能会得到迟到的好处，因为他们被认为得到了这些人的大力支持。

paras.en: Though often framed as a run-off between Eisenkot and Netanyahu, it is possible another leader could take power, if they were to withhold their party's support for a coalition unless given the top job.
paras.zh: 尽管经常被认为是艾森科特和内塔尼亚胡之间的决选，但如果另一位领导人在不获得最高职位的情况下拒绝本党对联合政府的支持，那么另一位领导人就有可能掌权。

paras.en: An outcome dreaded by many is political deadlock - where no bloc is able to reach a majority, and a minority government cannot be formed. In that scenario, new elections would be called, with Netanyahu to remain as interim prime minister.
paras.zh: 许多人担心的一个结果是政治僵局——没有一个集团能够获得多数席位，也无法组建少数派政府。在这种情况下，将举行新的选举，内塔尼亚胡将继续担任临时总理。

paras.en: Between 2019 and 2022, Israel held five separate elections as parties struggled time and again to co-operate.
paras.zh: 2019年至2022年间，以色列举行了五次独立选举，各党派一次又一次地努力合作。

paras.en: CONEXPO-CON/AGG 2026 in Las Vegas, Nevada, reaffirmed its position as the largest construction trade show in North America, drawing more than 140,000 construction professionals from 128 countries across the globe. For Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, the week was an incredible opportunity to showcase innovation, strengthen partnerships and gain valuable insights into the future of the construction, mining and aggregate industries. Throughout the busy week, attendees had the chance to speak with our experts and watch live demonstrations of our brake systems, along with our advanced brake and transmission friction solutions for the construction industry.

Top trends included integrating autonomous equipment, advanced digital tools and sustainable technologies. The exhibition footprint spanned more than 3 million square feet with greater than 2,000 exhibitors, and attendees covered miles of exhibits sprawled across indoor and outdoor spaces.

At the show, Carlisle Brake & Friction highlighted its advanced brake systems and friction technologies designed to withstand extreme duty cycles and demanding off‑highway applications. Attendees experienced firsthand the performance, quality, and engineering expertise that define the CarlisleCBF brand. The CentroMotion booth was a hub of activity, and the team welcomed OEM leaders and aftermarket specialists. These interactions went beyond showcasing our products, they enhanced relationships and increased our team’s understanding of the industry’s evolving needs. • Solutions designed to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.

The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.

articles.title: Vermont Insurance Study Calls for Changes to Labor Rate, Appraisal and Aftermarket Parts Rules
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: A comprehensive study by the Vermont Department of Financial Regulation (DFR) has identified shortcomings in how auto insurers determine collision repair labor rates, handle appraisals and disclose the use of aftermarket parts, prompting recommendations for changes to the state’s insurance claims regulations.

The 52-page report, dated Dec. 31, 2025, was prepared in response to Act No. 32 of 2023, which directed the department to examine whether auto insurers’ labor rates, parts practices and other business procedures are fair and reasonable.

Among its most significant findings, DFR concluded that insurers’ methods for establishing prevailing labor rates are frequently inconsistent, inadequately documented or based on information that may not accurately represent the repair marketplace.
The department recommends amending Vermont Insurance Regulation I-79-2 to establish clearer standards for determining labor rates, resolving payment disputes and protecting consumers.
The report also addresses DRPs, total loss valuations, virtual appraisals, repair estimating practices and the potential effects of regulatory changes on insurance premiums.

Labor rates emerged as a central issue in the study, with collision repairers expressing concerns that insurer reimbursement has failed to keep pace with operating expenses, technician wages and increasingly complex vehicle repairs.

According to the department’s survey of Vermont collision repair facilities, shops reported hourly body labor rates ranging from $60 to $84, with an average of $67. The average reported rate had increased 26% since 2020.

By comparison, insurer data showed an unweighted mean reimbursement rate of $60.50 in 2024, up from $44.33 in 2010. The report cautioned that this measure combines different labor categories and is only a rough indicator of average costs, rather than a direct comparison with shops’ average body labor rate.
The department surveyed 25 collision repair facilities, representing approximately 17% of the 147 shops it identified. It also collected information from 20 insurance companies or insurance groups.

Eleven of the 20 insurer respondents reported using aggregated information from CCC ONE and/or NuGenIT to determine prevailing labor rates. Other insurers relied on geographic data, surveys, proprietary estimating tools or their own appraisal histories.
Although insurers maintained that their methods reflected prevailing marketplace rates, DFR found problems when it examined how those methods were applied.
The report states that insurer procedures for determining labor rates are often inconsistent, may fail to produce representative market rates and are not always clearly documented.

It also found that some insurers relied on information derived from direct repair agreements or previously negotiated insurance settlements to establish prevailing rates. Such information may reflect amounts insurers have already agreed to pay rather than independently established market prices.

Additionally, the department identified instances in which insurers appeared to compensate for labor rate differences through separate estimate or supplement line items, potentially obscuring the actual labor rate used to settle a claim.
DFR acknowledged that collision repair businesses also bear responsibility for understanding their costs and establishing defensible rates.
The department recommended creating objective standards for insurers to identify average market labor rates, along with documentation requirements and procedures for handling disagreements.
Rather than recommending a statewide minimum reimbursement rate, DFR favored regulatory changes designed to make labor rate determinations more transparent and consistent.
Virtual Appraisals and Supplements Raise Concerns
The department also identified problems associated with insurers’ growing reliance on photo-based estimating and virtual appraisals.
According to the shop survey, respondents reported that supplemental estimates were required on an average of 95% of repairs. Ten shops said they needed supplements on every repair.
Shops reported an average repair delay of 7.32 days associated with the supplement process.
The department cautioned that insurer-provided data did not show the same magnitude of increase in supplements reported by repair facilities.

Nevertheless, DFR found that virtual adjusting can result in incomplete initial estimates, additional administrative work for repairers and delays while shops await approval to order parts or proceed with repairs.

The study also found that 72% of responding shops said insurers would not send an appraiser when requested by the repair facility, while 76% said insurers would not send one at the customer’s request.

DFR recommends amending its regulations to establish deadlines for responding to and paying supplements. It also recommends formalizing previous guidance requiring in-person inspections when consumers request them, ensuring access to qualified Vermont-licensed appraisers and prohibiting insurers from discouraging those requests.
The department further recommended requiring insurers to document and justify significant deviations from estimating software guidance.
Aftermarket Parts Disclosures Recommended

The study also examined the use of aftermarket and recycled parts, including potential cost savings, quality concerns and the additional labor sometimes required to make replacement components fit properly.
DFR acknowledged that aftermarket parts can reduce repair costs and may be easier to obtain than OEM components.

However, the report found that fit and modification problems can arise and that most responding repair facilities said they were not reimbursed for additional labor and paint materials associated with modifying insurer-required aftermarket parts.
The department recommends adopting disclosure requirements consistent with the National Association of Insurance Commissioners’ model regulation.
It also plans to explore requiring insurers to identify aftermarket parts used in calculating claims settlements.

DFR did not recommend requiring OEM parts for vehicles within a specified age range. If lawmakers pursue such a requirement, the department suggested including a consumer opt-out provision to preserve choice and affordability.
The department will also consider requiring insurers to offer an optional OEM parts endorsement that consumers could purchase when obtaining or renewing coverage.
The report also raised questions about the extent to which insurers influence repairs through DRPs, estimating systems and parts sourcing requirements.

DFR found that DRPs can provide shops with customer referrals and offer consumers access to facilities evaluated by insurers. However, the programs can also give insurers greater influence over labor rates, parts selection and repair procedures.
The department noted that DRP agreements may affect the broader repair marketplace when nonparticipating shops accept insurer-established rates or estimates to remain competitive.

DFR plans to explore regulatory changes intended to preserve consumer choice and prevent insurer interference with necessary repair procedures unless a disagreement is based on legitimate technical issues evaluated by qualified representatives.
The department will also examine when insurer influence over repair decisions becomes a specific directive that could carry additional responsibility for repair costs or liability.
DFR found that consumer disclosures at the time an auto insurance policy is purchased are limited and often difficult to understand.
The department is considering additional disclosures at the time of purchase and when claims are filed, potentially through a consumer bill of rights.

The report also identified inconsistent insurer practices involving betterment deductions, which reduce claim payments when replacement parts are considered to improve a vehicle’s condition beyond its pre-loss state.

According to DFR, half of the responding insurers had no specific betterment procedures, and some applied deductions to third-party claimants even when those motorists were not responsible for the collision.
The department recommends adding betterment standards to Regulation I-79-2, potentially drawing from NAIC model language.
While the report identifies opportunities to strengthen consumer protections and improve repair reimbursement practices, DFR cautioned that regulatory changes could affect insurance affordability.
The department retained actuarial consulting firm Oliver Wyman to evaluate how hypothetical increases in collision repair labor rates and total loss valuations might affect insurance premiums.

Under the scenarios examined, labor rate increases of 10% to 40% could produce estimated premium increases ranging from 1.2% to 14.9%, depending on the proportion of insured vehicle damage and theft costs attributable to labor.
Separately, increases in total loss valuations of 10% to 30% could result in estimated premium increases ranging from 1% to 8.9%.
The report emphasized that these are illustrative scenarios, not forecasts of the effects of the department’s specific recommendations.

DFR also noted that Vermont has a competitive automobile insurance market, with more than 70 insurers offering private passenger coverage and premiums historically ranking among the lowest nationally.
However, the department warned that affordability pressures remain a concern, particularly as the state’s estimated uninsured motorist rate has risen above 10% since 2021.
The report represents a significant examination of the relationship between insurers, collision repair facilities and consumers in Vermont.
Its recommendations focus primarily on revising existing insurance regulations, strengthening disclosure requirements and establishing more consistent standards for claims handling.

For collision repairers, the most consequential proposals involve labor rate methodology, supplement processing deadlines, in-person appraisal requirements, aftermarket parts disclosures and insurer influence over repair decisions.

The department’s findings also underscore the challenges facing independent repair facilities as vehicle complexity increases and shops assume additional administrative responsibilities associated with insurance claims.

Although DFR did not recommend establishing a mandatory minimum collision repair labor rate, it concluded that the current regulatory framework needs greater clarity to address disagreements over repair costs and claims practices.

The report’s recommendations are not themselves new laws or binding regulatory changes. Any proposed amendments would require further action through the applicable state regulatory or legislative process.

articles.title: How Cam Designs Are Meeting More Specialized Demands
articles.author: Greg Jones

paras.en: Picking a camshaft used to involve a simple flip through a catalog to find a grind that matched your basic engine specs. Today, off-the-shelf cams still make sense for many applications, but more specialized engine combinations are pushing builders toward more custom solutions. Experts attribute this shift to a handful of factors.

Nick Norris of Callies says the move away from “one-size-fits-most” cams is largely due to combinations becoming too specialized. The same basic engine, he notes, can be naturally aspirated, turbocharged, positive-displacement supercharged, or run with nitrous, and each can require a very different approach to valve timing.

“Better EFI, data acquisition and simulation have also changed what we can evaluate,” Norris says. “We can look at boost, backpressure, converter behavior, engine acceleration, and other data and design around what the vehicle actually needs. Instead of asking only what cam will make the most power, we can ask where we need the torque and how we want that power delivered.”

All of this has changed how Norris and other top manufacturers look at valvetrain development. While cam specs and events have traditionally been referenced to what’s happening at the lobe, “for the past couple of years I’ve been retraining myself to think more about the events at the valve,” he says. “After all, that’s what the engine sees.”

That shift – from designing around the camshaft itself to designing around what the valve actually does – is a big part of where cam development is headed. It also helps explain why manufacturers are moving beyond basic specs like lobe separation angle (LSA) and taking a more complete, system-level approach to the valvetrain.

Why exactly is the market evolving this way? One important driver, according to Bobby Biancaniello of Cam Motion, is “the ability to have a camshaft spec’d for your exact build and ground and shipped to you in one week’s time.”

While Cam Motion’s off-the-shelf grinds will work for almost any late-model application, he notes, when you start changing things like runner lengths on intakes, incorporating power adders, or adding displacement by lengthening the stroke, “it’s easier to make them exactly what they need with a custom grind than having a catalog with thousands of options” that can just end up complicating the selection process.

Another reason for this changing dynamic is the role of modern technology and tuning. Nic Woods of Clay Smith Cams explains that until about 10-15 years ago, EFI was a major headache for cam manufacturers, and “there were only a few guys in the country who really knew how to dial in performance cams and get them tuned and mapped correctly for the air-fuel ratio at idle.”
But now, with the rapid evolution of ECU technology and how well these systems communicate with the O2 sensors, today’s self-learning systems can better accommodate more aggressive performance cams.

“We don’t really have to recommend cams differently for fuel-injected platforms anymore,” Woods says. “We can give them the right cam, and if the guy doesn’t know how to tune it, the fuel injection can self-learn and map the fuel correctly.”

Charlie Westcott of Militia Racing Products points to manufacturing technology and material advances as additional factors influencing the market. He says many traditional cam cores are designed to cover a wide range of applications, which can create challenges when they’re machined and heat-treated.

By comparison, tool-steel cores (like S7) are high-strength throughout and can be manufactured more efficiently without some of the heat-treating and coating steps that materials like 8620 or 9310 would require.

“I can make a camshaft – from a phone call to the finished product – in about three days,” Westcott says. “Those three days are only because I’m waiting for the heat treat to come back. Whereas if you’re doing these other cams, you have to send them out to get copper-coated, then send them out again for heat treatment after you mill them. It’s a big time suck. I prefer getting things done quickly for people.”

Of course, to get a custom camshaft recommendation, certain information must be collected. Norris says the engine’s cubic inches, rpm range, cylinder heads, and application will get the Callies team in the ballpark. But choosing the actual profiles requires more detail.

“We’ll look at the weights of the valvetrain components and the overall stiffness of the system based on things like pushrod dimensions, rocker ratios and material, and the rest of the valvetrain configuration,” Norris says.
The spring package is another big consideration. If a customer has one they’re happy with, Norris and his team will go over the specs to make sure it’s compatible with the profiles they’ve chosen.

“If we’re starting from scratch, the spring and lobe need to be considered together rather than treating the spring as something that gets selected after the cam,” he notes. “Ultimately, the basic engine information helps determine the valve events and general cam specifications, while the details of the valvetrain help determine how aggressive the lobe profiles can be and still maintain control through the intended rpm range.”

Biancaniello agrees that when deciding on the best camshaft for a particular application, “it’s important for the cam guy to know as much as possible about the setup.” That means customers need to be as clear and up front as possible about their goals and how they plan to use the vehicle. Why? Because two builds that look virtually the same can require two very different cams.

As an example, he points to a turbocharged LS 5.3L with a set of 62mm turbos. In one case, the engine is being used in a streetcar with a tight converter, air conditioning, power brakes, and no transbrake. This customer wants very quick spool-up, a broad powerband, a 6,500-rpm ceiling, and 700-plus horsepower.

“That setup will have much different specs than the identical engine/turbos going into a drag race-only application with a transbrake and a converter that flashes 6,200-plus rpm and gets run to 8,000 rpm max on much higher boost levels with a goal of 1,200-plus hp,” he says.
Norris offers a similar assessment, making note of pressure conditions and the fact that the same boost level with two different turbo systems can produce very different exhaust backpressure.

“That affects how I approach exhaust timing and overlap,” Norris explains. “The engine specifications may look nearly identical on paper, but what the vehicle needs from the engine can lead to two very different camshafts.”

Woods, too, leaves no stone unturned when gathering information, wanting to know the compression, what cylinder head is being used, the flow numbers, the type of intake manifold, components in the bottom end, and more.

“We need to have some idea of whose brand piston is in there so we can get a good estimate of how much valve clearance we have and how much camshaft we can actually put in before he has a problem,” Woods says.

Once the specs are covered, it’s time to discuss the vehicle and its intended use, which gives manufacturers an idea of rpm range and where a customer wants power and torque to occur. “Some of these conversations can take five minutes; some can take two hours,” Woods admits. “At the end of the day, the cam is the same price, but a company has to be willing to put in that extra time to make sure the customer gets the exact right cam for his application.”

Westcott, whose customers include Pro Line Racing and Noonan Race Engineering, among others, sees plenty of unorthodox projects as well. His work has covered everything from a one-of-a-kind 1969 455-style Pontiac engine with a single overhead cam to a four-valve-per-cylinder, small block Oldsmobile W-30 (one of only two ever made) to an inline six-cylinder Holden race engine from Australia and a set of John Deere tractor pulling cams. At this point, it’s safe to say almost nothing is out of bounds.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Even so, Westcott still gets calls where he has to steer people away from potential trouble. One of the most common mistakes he encounters is customers focusing too heavily on aggressive lobe profiles to try to maximize area under the curve.

“I always say, you can’t make an engine good with the camshaft,” he states. “The camshaft, in my mind, is like the conductor of the orchestra. You’ve got your cylinder heads and your manifold, and your induction system is probably the most important thing. It really sets the rpm band for the engine. The camshaft has to match that stuff, so the camshaft comes last in the party.”

In other words, a cam can’t compensate for an engine combo that won’t support the desired rpm or power level. “You can’t take a stock small-block Chevy 350 and change the cam and think you’re going to make power at 10,000 rpm,” he adds. “That’s just not going to do it.”
Instead, he says, builders should focus on getting the entire combination right rather than trying to make up for shortcomings with an overly aggressive camshaft.

“I have to talk guys out of trying to make aggressive lobes because they think they need to square up the lobes to make the engine good,” Westcott says. “I tell them, you need to fix your heads and make the cam smooth. That way you’re not beating up parts.”

An overly aggressive cam can create unnecessary stress throughout the valvetrain. “If you have to get so aggressive that you’re beating up stuff, that’s never good,” he says. “If you’ve got a jackhammer for an engine, you want the engine to be nice and smooth and not have any problems. Work on the induction system.”

Another common mistake is simply going too large on duration. “You’re better off being 5 degrees short than 5 degrees big,” he says. “Everybody wants to have the cam be too big, but they’ll typically run better if they’re smaller than if they’re bigger.”

For Biancaniello, the biggest sticking point is unquestionably LSA. He says engine builders will often request a cam with a specific LSA and little else, expecting him to fill in the blanks. He has to remind them that LSA is only one part of the equation.

“Duration and centerlines are equally important pieces to that puzzle,” he says. “We need to choose the correct valve timing the setup wants,” adding that he encourages builders to reference Cam Motion’s cam timing calculator to better understand how changes in cam specs affect the engine’s behavior.

“I can make a camshaft ‘work’ with the LSA you might think is ideal for the setup,” Biancaniello says, “but the more ideal approach would have been picking the best open and close timing and letting the duration/LSA and centerlines fall wherever they fall to make those events timed where you want them.”

Norris tabs a common mistake as choosing a cam primarily from duration at .050” lift. While he notes that’s an important number, “it doesn’t tell you where the valve events occur or how the valve gets from the seat to peak lift and back.”

He also warns against concentrating too much on duration and lobe separation and overlooking the individual valve events. Intake closing, exhaust opening and the amount and location of overlap can have a major effect on where the engine makes torque and how it responds.

“The valvetrain also has to be considered,” Norris adds. “A lobe may look ideal from an airflow standpoint but be too aggressive for the lifter, rocker, valve, and spring combination. Making the cam more aggressive doesn’t help if the valvetrain becomes unstable before the engine reaches its intended rpm.”

As racing classes and enthusiast segments continue to become more specialized, application-specific camshaft development will undoubtedly progress in kind. Biancaniello expects the industry to head “down a further rabbit hole of constant testing, R&D and real-world data” to keep pace with the seemingly endless introduction of new segments and rulebooks on the competition side.

Norris sees the next step as combining traditional cam design with more detailed analysis of the complete valvetrain. Duration, lift and valve events will always be important, he says, “but we’re increasingly able to evaluate velocity, acceleration, jerk, radius of curvature and frequency content along with actual valve motion from Spintron testing.”

The long-term goal, then, is to put that data to work earlier in the cycle. “The ability to predict if and when the valvetrain will become unstable in software, verify it through Spintron testing and ultimately validate it on the dyno would take the development process to the next level,” Norris states.

Woods raises an interesting point about the future, and something he would like to see become more commonplace in the market: moving toward validated systems to prevent premature failures, especially in high-end builds.

“You get into those specialty racing applications and you test your lobe designs on a Spintron,” he says. “You have this rocker arm, this spring, this retainer, this pushrod, and this head, and then you sell the cam by itself – how does that make sense? It’s almost like you can only buy this cam with what we tested it with.

“That’s something I think the industry is really lacking: telling the customer that these lobes are specific for drag-racing applications, and you have to have this rocker, this spring, this retainer, and this diameter pushrod with this wall thickness. Otherwise, the results may vary. When it gets to those levels of application, you have to have the system. If one piece of that system isn’t in place, the likelihood of premature failure is evident. It’s impossible for it not to be.”

The bottom line is that off-the-shelf camshafts certainly have their place, but the direction of the industry is clear. As engine combinations get more specialized and manufacturers zero in on what’s happening at the valve, the cam is becoming less of an isolated component and increasingly one piece in a complete valvetrain system.

articles.title: How OE Tire Fitments Influence Replacement Tire Sales
articles.author: Denise Koeth

paras.en: An original equipment (OE) tire fitment can influence a customer’s next tire purchase years after a vehicle leaves the factory. Aaron Neumann, head of the Nexen Tire America Technical Center, estimates that around 30% of drivers request the same tire or brand when shopping for replacements. Among luxury vehicle owners, he says more than half choose the same brand.

For tire dealers, that familiarity creates an opportunity to turn OE tire fitments into replacement sales. But making the right recommendation requires understanding why automakers select particular tires, which customers want to preserve their vehicle’s original performance and when another tire might better meet their needs.
Neumann explains how OE partnerships influence consumer purchasing decisions and what dealers should consider when recommending replacement tires.

An OE tire can begin taking shape two to three years before its intended vehicle even reaches the market. Tiremakers earn an OE fitment on a vehicle through a multi-year, collaborative engineering and testing process with the auto manufacturer long before the vehicle goes into production.

“There is a high bar to earning OE fitment,” says Aaron Neumann, head of Nexen Tire America Technical Center. “Technically, a tire manufacturer has to prove they have a highly controlled production process with robust quality systems that pass very stringent audits. They also must have the technical capability to meet performance targets at the leading edge of tire technology, which is generally only within reach for Tier 1 and 2 manufacturers. Commercially, they need to show a top-level financial rating and logistically, need to show a 100% on-time global supply chain.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Neumann says many Hyundai, Kia, Ram and Jeep vehicles in the United States feature Nexen tires.

“Two fitments we’re particularly excited about right now are the Jeep Wrangler and the new Jeep Recon,” he says. “We are also very proud of our Porsche Panamera and Cayenne fitments. Those programs are good examples of the range of capabilities required in OE development. The performance targets for a Porsche are different from those of a Jeep, but in both cases the tire has to be engineered as part of the vehicle rather than treated as an off-the-shelf component.”
For a tire manufacturer, the rigorous process is worth it for both the added business and increased brand awareness.
While Nexen does see an increase in replacement sales for sizes with OE fitments, quantifying brand awareness is a little more difficult, according to Neumann.

“There are so many new brands in the market, and customers only need to think about tires once every few years, but OE creates familiarity over the entire ownership period,” he says. “Someone may see Nexen on their own vehicle, on a neighbor’s SUV or a spare OE Nexen Roadian HTX2 on the back of a Jeep Wrangler during their morning commute every day. They may not consciously think about it at the time, but that exposure helps make the brand familiar. That recognition matters when it becomes time to replace tires.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: That tendency to stick with an OE tire varies by vehicle segment and by what customers expect from their replacement tires.

“Understandably, luxury or performance owners are more sensitive to maintaining the way the vehicle was engineered to drive, so they place more value on staying with the OE brand or specification,” he says. “At the other end of the market, a value-oriented consumer may be more willing to compare brands based on price, mileage or another practical need.”
How OE Tire Fitments Influence Replacement Sales

When recommending replacement tires, ask customers what performance characteristics they want from their vehicles. Ask whether customers liked their OE tires and what driving conditions they regularly face. Then determine whether the OE fitment or another product is the best choice.

For luxury and performance vehicle owners, Neumann suggests considering which characteristics the driver wants to preserve, including steering response, ride quality, noise levels, braking and handling.

“Enthusiasts can be similar, although they may also be more willing to move away from the exact OE tire if they are deliberately trying to change a particular performance characteristic,” he adds. “That’s where understanding the customer’s priorities becomes important.

“Generally, OE specification carries more weight as vehicles become more specialized and customers become more sensitive to how the vehicle performs. That can include luxury cars, sports cars, performance SUVs and increasingly EVs, where factors such as rolling resistance, noise, vehicle weight and range can all make tire selection more noticeable.”

However, Neumann explains that in these instances, OE is not automatically the best replacement choice simply because of the vehicle type or price point. “The better question is whether the customer wants to preserve the original balance of performance or change it,” he notes.
From a customer’s point of view, it depends less on the vehicle and more on what they need from their tires.

“If they are happy with the OE tire’s performance, then replace them like for like,” Neumann says. “If they live in snow country, then they should upgrade to a tire marked with a three-peak mountain snowflake symbol. Now, if they do a lot of miles and would like better treadwear, then look for tires with longer treadwear warranties. If they have a truck and want to upgrade the appearance, look for a more aggressive A/T or R/T tire.”

He explains that when the switch is made from OE tires to a different product, there will be a trade-off, “perhaps 2 mpg of fuel economy or a little bit more tire noise,” but that many people think these trade-offs are worth making.
“I’m an advocate for teaching consumers about tire performance and trade-offs so they can make educated decisions when buying tires,” Neumann says.
