articles.title: Florida mom arrested after Vegas trip left 4 kids without overnight supervision: deputies

paras.en: A Florida mother returning from Las Vegas was met by deputies as she stepped off a plane and arrested after authorities say she left her four children home alone while she traveled for work.
Body camera video shows deputies approaching Irene Miller as she exited the plane Friday morning, escorting her through the airport terminal and placing her in handcuffs.
The arrest came two days after one of Miller’s children called 911 to report that a dumbbell had fallen on her 9-year-old brother’s head, according to the Osceola County Sheriff’s Office.

Deputies responded to the Kissimmee home shortly after 8:30 p.m. on Oct. 21 and found four children, ages 9, 11, 12 and 14, with no adults present, the sheriff’s office said. Fire rescue crews took the injured boy to Celebration Hospital, where he was treated and discharged.
A deputy reached Miller by phone, and she said she was working in Las Vegas and planned to return Oct. 23, according to the sheriff’s office. Deputies learned she had left Florida on Oct. 18.

Miller told deputies she had arranged for a babysitter to travel from Tampa in the mornings to help the children get ready for school and check on them afterward. The sitter was not required to stay overnight, the sheriff’s office said.
Authorities contacted the children’s father, who agreed to take all four to his home while detectives made plans to meet Miller when her flight landed.
Deputies arrested Miller, 50, on four counts of child neglect without great bodily harm and booked her into the Orange County Jail.

"The Osceola County Sheriff’s Office will not tolerate child neglect," Sheriff Chris Blackmon said. "These cases will be investigated, and charges will be brought against the parents who are not properly supervising or caring for their children."

articles.title: Pat McAfee invokes Charlie Kirk killing as Utah post sparks 'uncomfortable' GameDay visit

paras.en: ESPN star Pat McAfee appeared to reference the killing of Charlie Kirk as he ripped the University of Utah over a social media post he says made him feel "very, very uncomfortable" before Saturday’s "College GameDay" broadcast.

McAfee said he saw a video on the university’s Instagram account shortly before going on air in Salt Lake City. The post asked students to do impressions of him, he said, and included comments calling him "corny" and "creepy."
The video has since been removed from the university’s social media accounts.
The former NFL punter said he would not have minded if students had shared the remarks themselves, but he took issue with the university posting them before he walked in front of thousands of fans.

"The university puts that out, like as I’m about to go out and do an infomercial for the place, and then I’m walking in front of thousands of these people," McAfee said Monday on "The Pat McAfee Show."
"This is how the university feels about it. It’s an uncomfortable feeling."

McAfee said the post "set me off a little bit" and made him feel "a little weird." He then appeared to reference the September 2025 shooting of Kirk, the conservative activist who was killed during an event at Utah Valley University in Orem, about 40 miles south of Salt Lake City.

"Has anything like really scary happened at like a college gathering in the state of Utah recently?" McAfee asked. "Like, do we think we should be amplifying reasons for why people hate my guts as a university?"

Later in the segment, McAfee again pointed to "what happened 40 miles south of Salt Lake City a little over a year ago," saying the university’s post added to the hostility he faces just before he went on air to promote the school.
"I was very, very uncomfortable," he said. "I think it made me not have the greatest morning."

The University of Utah apologized in a statement posted to its official Instagram account, saying its goal was to create "lighthearted engagement" about McAfee’s return to campus, but it "missed the mark."
"University staff are responsible for reviewing and posting content on official social media accounts and we take full accountability for that decision," the school said.
The university said officials had reached out to McAfee to express their appreciation and regret.
"We sincerely apologize for creating any perception that Pat was unsafe or unwelcome on our campus. Nothing could be further from the truth," the statement said.

The school added that McAfee and the entire "College GameDay" crew are always welcome at the university. It said ESPN’s pregame show has visited its campus seven times and that it has enjoyed a positive relationship with the crew.
McAfee said he knew some people believed the students’ comments were not particularly harsh, but he kept coming back to who posted the video.
"It was the university putting that out. It’s not like a blog. It’s the actual place that we’re at," he said.

The Instagram post was not the only part of McAfee’s visit that appeared to frustrate him. He also took issue with a student participating in his weekly "Kicking Is Easy" contest, which gives a contestant a chance to kick a field goal for $1 million.
McAfee said the student questioned why the prize was "only $1 million" after the potential prize reached $3 million for the previous week’s Notre Dame-BYU game.
"It’s my money! Only $1 million. It’s like, all right, I hate this place. I hate this place," he said.
McAfee said he hopes he never has to return to the university and joked that he might have COVID if "College GameDay" goes back.
Despite his frustrations, he praised Utah’s football team and called its student section "incredible." He also thanked the fans who attended Saturday’s broadcast.
"It was a phenomenal GameDay. Thank you to everybody that showed up," he said.
Utah went on to defeat Houston 21-13 on Saturday.

articles.title: Chinese markets lose trillions as race for AI supremacy with US takes its toll
articles.author: Amy Hawkins in Beijing

paras.en: Trillions of dollars have been wiped from China’s stock markets in recent months amid increasing anxiety about the future of artificial intelligence, as Beijing races against the United States for dominance in the sector.

The STAR 50 Index, which tracks technology and innovation companies on the Shanghai stock exchange, has plunged 40% since June. Other indexes of major companies dropped by about 20% over the same time period.
The precipitous drop has wiped out $2.4tn from the Chinese stock market since May, according to Bloomberg.
AI stocks account for over 40% of the stock market value in China and Hong Kong, according to Goldman Sachs, meaning that any dent in value will send shockwaves across the whole domestic market.

The fall suggests that despite the government’s best efforts to boost China’s technology industries, particularly those which harness the power of AI, the domestic economy does not have the power to sustain a booming market.

The Chinese government has invested heavily into AI, including a 60bn yuan state-backed AI investment fund which started pumping money into domestic developers this month. But Chinese consumers have proved stubbornly reluctant to part with their cash in many parts of the economy – including technology – meaning that many tech companies struggle to turn a profit.
The lack of profits is one of several reasons for the sell-off. Another is the threat of western countries, especially the US, extending bans on Chinese technology.

“This year, the profit margin is not as good as expected. And the US is raising rates. And China’s domestic demand is so weak,” said Dan Wang, the China director for the Eurasia Group. She said that there was a “general anxiety” among technology companies about whether or not the state-backed model would work in the face of weak consumer demand.

The US has banned humanoid robots from China, citing national security risks, and is thought to be considering a ban on Chinese components in data centres. China is heavily reliant on exports and restrictions in the US hurt its domestic companies, which struggle to sell enough products at home.

As China races with the US to pull ahead in AI, Beijing has doubled down on robotics – also known as embodied AI – as the key to rolling out the technology across society. Robotics is also seen as the answer to China’s demographic problems, such as the ageing population and the shrinking workforce.

But the demand for robotics is being driven by government agencies and research institutions, rather than everyday consumers, for whom the products are still too expensive and not yet practical for home use. Humanoid robotics and robotic dogs have been popular in the entertainment industry but are yet to be useful in home settings.
Shares in Unitree, China’s leading robot-maker, have halved since they started trading in August.

“It doesn’t look like embodied intelligence could turn into profits in the in the mass market,” said Wang. Thin profit margins, rising rates in the US, and weak domestic demand were all contributing to a “general anxiety” among technology companies, she said.

China’s government wants local investors to invest their money domestically. China has in recent months restricted overseas investment, with more regulations taking effect from 1 December, but these moves have not led to greater investment in the Chinese markets.

Wang added that there was still optimism in other technology sectors, such as AI research and satellites, the latter because their links to the military indicates long term state support for the sector. And globally the AI boom is expected to last for at least another year.

On Monday, US AI company Anthropic, which makes the chatbot Claude, filed paperwork ahead of a planned IPO that could be the biggest stock market debuts of all time. The company is expected to bring in as much as $100bn.

China has no such blockbuster IPOs on the horizon. And despite pressure on policymakers to introduce stimulus measures to boost investment, none are expected to be announced during a politically sensitive period in China.

This week the top officials in the Chinese Communist party are gathering for the fifth plenum, an important meeting that will lay the groundwork for next year’s 21st Party Congress. The Congress is expected to anoint Xi Jinping, China’s leader, for a fourth term. There is no appetite for risky or potentially destabilising policy measures before then, even if there is a chance they could boost the economy.
Any stimulus measure would be “high risk”, Wang said. “What if it doesn’t work out? Then whoever came up with that policy, that guy would be held accountable”.

articles.title: Australian politics live: Coalition tells Albanese to ‘stop the spin’ on $6m golf grant; Labor promises ‘swift response’ on MP safety
articles.author: Achol Arok (now) and Kat Wong (earlier)

paras.en: Opposition continues pressure over golf club grant
paras.zh: 反对派继续对高尔夫俱乐部拨款施加压力

paras.en: The manager of opposition business in the house, Dan Tehan returns and asks the prime minister to “stop the spin and admit he was wrong”.
paras.zh: 房子里的反对派业务经理Dan Tehan回来了，并要求总理“停止旋转并承认他错了”。

paras.en: It’s met with much grumblings from the government benches and the speaker, Milton Dick, asks Tehan to refer to a point, saying he does not want to set a precedent where “you can just do a statement, and then that’s a question”. Anthony Albanese answers:
paras.zh: 政府长椅上有很多抱怨，发言人米尔顿·迪克（ Milton Dick ）要求特汉（ Tehan ）提及一点，称他不想开创一个“你可以发表声明，然后这是一个问题”的先例。Anthony Albanese回答：

paras.en: After we made the commitment to the club which included fixing this issue - which has been an issue since 1947 - the state government have stepped in. That is a good thing.
paras.zh: 在我们向俱乐部做出承诺，包括解决这个自1947年以来一直存在的问题之后，州政府介入了。这是一件好事。

paras.en: WA government sets out ambitious renewable targets for state’s electricity grid
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚州政府为州电网制定了雄心勃勃的可再生能源目标

paras.en: Australia’s mining state will pursue an ambitious renewable energy target, as it attempts to drive down soaring energy costs and boost business investment, AAP reports.
paras.zh: 据AAP报道，澳大利亚矿业州将追求雄心勃勃的可再生能源目标，因为它试图降低飙升的能源成本并促进商业投资。

paras.en: Western Australia’s government wants 75% of electricity in the state’s southwest grid to be generated from renewables by 2030/31.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚州政府希望到2030/31年，该州西南电网中75%的电力由可再生能源发电。

paras.en: Premier Roger Cook says the so-called affordable energy plan will put “maximum downward pressure on energy bills”. He told reporters on Tuesday:
paras.zh: 总理罗杰·库克(Roger Cook)表示，所谓的“负担得起的能源计划”将“给能源账单带来最大的下行压力”。他周二告诉记者：

paras.en: Without our plan for affordable energy, energy prices for businesses could increase by 89 per cent by 2032.
paras.zh: 如果没有我们负担得起的能源计划，到2032年，企业的能源价格可能会上涨89%。

paras.en: Delivering affordable energy to businesses is a fundamental part of my government’s objectives to diversify WA’s economy and create more jobs.
paras.zh: 为企业提供负担得起的能源是我国政府实现西澳大利亚州经济多元化和创造更多就业机会的目标的基本组成部分。

paras.en: The plan also includes more support for households to invest in solar, batteries, and electric vehicles; and continued support for WA’s domestic gas reservation policy and gas production. Cook said:
paras.zh: 该计划还包括为家庭投资太阳能、电池和电动汽车提供更多支持；并继续支持西澳大利亚州的国内天然气储备政策和天然气生产。库克说：

paras.en: Ask any WA household that has solar panels or batteries, they will tell you solar is the cheapest energy that is available.
paras.zh: 询问任何拥有太阳能电池板或电池的西澳大利亚州家庭，他们会告诉你，太阳能是最便宜的能源。

paras.en: Without the plan, we’ll be reliant on aging coal-fired power stations, and that is just not the way of the future.
paras.zh: 如果没有这个计划，我们将依赖老化的燃煤电站，这不是未来的方式。

paras.en: TGA announces new sunscreen rules following SPF saga
paras.zh: TGA宣布遵循SPF SAGA的新防晒规则

paras.en: The Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) has proposed strengthening sun protection factor (SPF) requirements following a review prompted by revelations that several popular sunscreens were failing to meet the SPF factor advertised.
paras.zh: 美国治疗用品管理局（ TGA ）建议加强防晒系数（ SPF ）要求，此前有消息称，几种流行的防晒霜未能达到宣传的SPF系数。

paras.en: The medicines regulator announced today it would progress the reforms to strengthen consumer confidence and ensure that sunscreen companies and manufacturers understand their obligations.
paras.zh: 药品监管机构今天宣布，它将推进改革，以加强消费者信心，并确保防晒霜公司和制造商了解他们的义务。

paras.en: The proposed reforms follow a three-month consultation period this year, which the TGA said drew 120 responses.
paras.zh: 拟议的改革是在今年为期三个月的咨询期之后进行的， TGA表示已收到120份回复。

paras.en: Among the TGA’s proposed new rules is that brands would have to test the SPF of their finished product – and not just the base formula – before listing it on the medicines register.
paras.zh: TGA提出的新规则之一是，品牌必须测试其成品的SPF （而不仅仅是基本配方） ，然后才能将其列入药品登记册。

paras.en: Additionally, the TGA is planning to limit the SPF claims that cosmetic sunscreens can make so that there is clear distinction for consumers between them and sunscreens that are used for a primary purpose of sun protection.
paras.zh: 此外， TGA计划限制化妆品防晒霜可以产生的SPF声明，以便消费者与主要用于防晒目的的防晒霜之间有明确的区别。

paras.en: The TGA’s review came after testing by the consumer advocacy organisation Choice found 16 of 20 brands failed to provide the level of skin protection advertised on their bottles.
paras.zh: TGA的审查是在消费者权益组织Choice进行测试后进行的，结果发现20个品牌中有16个未能提供其瓶子上广告的皮肤保护水平。

paras.en: Choice has broadly welcomed the proposed reforms but said the TGA should go further. Andy Kelly, Choice’s consumer impact director, said:
paras.zh: Choice广泛欢迎拟议的改革，但表示TGA应该走得更远。Choice消费者影响总监Andy Kelly表示：

paras.en: We’re pleased to see the TGA has proposed stricter rules. However, the TGA is not proposing to routinely monitor and evaluate test results.
paras.zh: 我们很高兴看到TGA提出了更严格的规则。然而， TGA并不建议常规监测和评估测试结果。

paras.en: Sunscreen brands would also only be required to provide test results confidentially to the TGA.
paras.zh: 防晒霜品牌也只需要保密地向TGA提供测试结果。

paras.en: In the interest of transparency and public safety, we believe these results should be made available to everyone and that the TGA should routinely monitor test results, as well as conduct its own compliance testing program.
paras.zh: 为了提高透明度和公共安全，我们认为这些结果应向所有人提供， TGA应定期监控测试结果，并开展自己的合规性测试计划。

paras.en: The opposition continually pushed the prime minister to “admit he was wrong” after he previously said a $6m grant for the Marrickville golf club was to fix sewerage flows into the Cooks River.
paras.zh: 反对派不断敦促总理“承认自己错了” ，此前他曾表示，为马里克维尔高尔夫俱乐部提供600万美元的赠款是为了修复流入库克斯河的污水。

paras.en: Labor MPs also answered dixers on a digital duty of care, migration, small businesses, veterans and more.
paras.zh: 工党议员还回答了数字关怀责任、移民、小企业、退伍军人等问题。

paras.en: The rising cost of living remained a key line of questioning for the opposition and crossbench, as was the government’s treatment of non-citizens who have committed crimes.
paras.zh: 生活费用上涨仍然是反对派和十字法庭的一个关键问题，政府对犯罪的非公民的待遇也是如此。

paras.en: Despite much talk yesterday about civility and respect in political debate, QT seemed to have revived much of its previous rambunctiousness, with one MP ejected and more warned.
paras.zh: 尽管昨天在政治辩论中谈论了很多关于礼貌和尊重的话题，但QT似乎恢复了之前的大部分喧嚣，一名议员被驱逐，更多议员受到警告。

paras.en: Labor’s Peter Khalil ejected after interrupting Angus Taylor’s question
paras.zh: 工党的彼得·哈利勒（ Peter Khalil ）在打断安格斯·泰勒（ Angus Taylor ）的问题

paras.en: And just like that, we have an ejection.
paras.zh: 就像这样，我们有一个弹射。

paras.en: The member for Wills, Peter Khalil, has been ejected from the chamber after reacting to a question from Angus Taylor.
paras.zh: 威尔斯的成员彼得·哈利勒（ Peter Khalil ）在回应安格斯·泰勒（ Angus Taylor ）的问题后被驱逐出会议厅。

paras.en: While kicking him out, the speaker, Milton Dick, said:
paras.zh: 演讲者米尔顿·迪克（ Milton Dick ）在把他赶出去时说：

paras.en: The leader of the opposition is entitled to be heard in silence and shown the same respect as any other member. To give commentary like that, with remarks that I just said, is completely out of order.
paras.zh: 反对派领导人有权在沉默中发表意见，并与任何其他成员一样受到尊重。这样的评论，加上我刚才说的话，是完全不合时宜的。

paras.en: Nationals deputy targets PM’s ‘failure’ on energy bills
paras.zh: 国民代表瞄准总理在能源账单上的“失败”

paras.en: Pointing to interest rate rises, and the prime minister’s “failure to deliver the $275 reduction in household energy bills he promised”, the deputy leader of the Nationals, Darren Chester, asks:
paras.zh: 国民党副领袖达伦·切斯特（ Darren Chester ）指出利率上升，以及总理“未能实现他承诺的家庭能源账单减少275 $” ，他问道：

paras.en: Why do Australians always pay the price because the prime minister won’t ever admit he’s made a mistake?
paras.zh: 为什么澳大利亚人总是付出代价，因为总理永远不会承认他犯了错误？

paras.en: Anthony Albanese responds he is “stunned” at the opposition raising issues of migration and access to the labour market and said his government had brought down the level of overseas migration by 45%.
paras.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯（ Anthony Albanese ）回应说，他对反对派提出移民和进入劳动力市场的问题感到“震惊” ，并表示他的政府已将海外移民水平降低了45 ％。

paras.en: The offer has been there for other reforms, that would further help to bring down the migration numbers, and do so in a way that had no impact at all on the labour market.
paras.zh: 这项提议是为了进行其他改革，这将进一步帮助减少移民人数，并且不会对劳动力市场产生任何影响。

paras.en: Wells calls for unity over combating online harms, including threats of violence
paras.zh: 威尔斯呼吁团结一致打击在线危害，包括暴力威胁

paras.en: The dixer is about how the digital duty of care protects Australians from “serious harm online, such as threats of violence and menacing or harassing behaviour”.
paras.zh: 数字关怀义务如何保护澳大利亚人免受“严重的在线伤害，如暴力威胁和威胁或骚扰行为”。

paras.en: The communications minister, Anika Wells, uses the opportunity to offer a reminder to unite MPs:
paras.zh: 通讯部长阿妮卡·威尔斯（ Anika Wells ）借此机会提醒国会议员团结起来：

paras.en: It’s not good enough to wait until threats escalate or a person gets hurt.
paras.zh: 等到威胁升级或某人受伤是不够的。

paras.en: This is not about censoring political debate, this is not about avoiding the criticism of policy, this is not about misinformation or disinformation.
paras.zh: 这不是关于审查政治辩论，这不是关于避免对政策的批评，这不是关于错误信息或虚假信息。

paras.en: If social media platforms, forums, online games, or AI [chatbot companies] know that the tools they make money from can be used to seriously harm Australians, they should put systems in place to stop it. We don’t always agree in this place, but surely we can agree on this.
Dan Tehan asks the prime minister to table the document he was reading from during his answer. Albanese shakes his head and presents the paper to have it tabled.
MPs from both side begin raising their voices, forcing the speaker, Milton Dick, to call order multiple times as he attempts to allow the member for Griffith to ask her dixer. He says:
I want to hear her question, and I’d like everyone to show her some respect while she asks the question.
Opposition continues pressure over golf club grant
paras.zh: 反对派继续对高尔夫俱乐部拨款施加压力

paras.en: The manager of opposition business in the house, Dan Tehan returns and asks the prime minister to “stop the spin and admit he was wrong”.
paras.zh: 房子里的反对派业务经理Dan Tehan回来了，并要求总理“停止旋转并承认他错了”。

paras.en: It’s met with much grumblings from the government benches and the speaker, Milton Dick, asks Tehan to refer to a point, saying he does not want to set a precedent where “you can just do a statement, and then that’s a question”. Anthony Albanese answers:
paras.zh: 政府长椅上有很多抱怨，发言人米尔顿·迪克（ Milton Dick ）要求特汉（ Tehan ）提及一点，称他不想开创一个“你可以发表声明，然后这是一个问题”的先例。Anthony Albanese回答：

paras.en: After we made the commitment to the club which included fixing this issue - which has been an issue since 1947 - the state government have stepped in. That is a good thing.
paras.zh: 在我们向俱乐部做出承诺，包括解决这个自1947年以来一直存在的问题之后，州政府介入了。这是一件好事。

paras.en: The chamber is certainly livelier than yesterday. Each “hear hear” feels more spirited, and answers are met with louder sneers of discontent from the other side of the political aisle.
Dan Tehan demands ‘straight answer’ from PM over $6m golf club grant
The manager of opposition business in the House, Dan Tehan, has kicked off question time by returning to the $6m grant to the Marrickville golf club. He asks:

On 9 September 2026, the prime minister told this house, his $6m taxpayer-funded grant … was to fix sewerage flows into the Cooks River. On 10 September 2026, the prime minister doubled down on this claim in this house.
Last week, the Department of Infrastructure confirmed to a Senate inquiry, sewerage works were not in the scope of the $6m grant. This was confirmed again at Senate estimates last night.
Will the prime minister give Australians a straight answer, admit he misled the House, and correct the record?

The prime minister said it was a matter for the Department of Infrastructure, noted the council was finalising the design of the project – which includes improvements to the clubhouse, stormwater harvesting, a new toilet, and landscaping – and pointed to funding the NSW government later committed to addressing sewerage at the club.
After much talk about civility and respect in parliament, following the alleged attack on Helen Haines, yesterday’s QT was a relatively subdued affair.
Dementia responsible for more than a tenth of deaths in 2025: ABS

Dementia, including Alzheimer’s disease, accounted for just over 10% (19,019) of all deaths in 2025, according to the latest causes of death data released by the Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS).
The ABS head of mortality statistics, Lauren Moran, said: “This is the first time that dementia has accounted for more than 10% of all deaths in Australia”. It is the leading cause of death.
Investment in dementia services, supports and prevention have not kept the same pace, Dementia Australia’s CEO, Prof Tanya Buchanan, said.
The other leading causes of death in 2025 were ischaemic heart diseases, cerebrovasculardiseases (such as stroke), lung cancer and chronic respiratory diseases.
The data reveals the highest number of asthma deaths recorded in 10 years. There were 484 Australians who died from asthma in 2025, up from 478 deaths in 2024.
Women account for almost two-thirds of asthma deaths, and almost to two-thirds of all dementia deaths.
Asthma Australia’s CEO, Kate Miranda, said poorly controlled asthma increases the risk:
We have effective treatments and clear clinical guidelines, yet too many Australians are not getting the care they need to stay well.
Fatima Payman clashes with Don Farrell over office staffing allocation – video

At a late-night Senate estimates hearing, the independent senator Fatima Payman accused the prime minister of being “petty” by not granting her additional staff members after she defected from Labor in 2024.
Queensland minister defends decision to slash legal centre’s funding
The Queensland minister for youth justice, Laura Gerber, has been pressed on her decision to slash funding for one of the government’s chief critics.
Greens MP Michael Berkman asked Gerber why the 45-year-old Youth Advocacy Service had lost its funding for bail support services in question time this morning.
Gerber said 13 organisations had been approved for funding under a new bail program. She said:

The Youth Advocacy Service was not successful in that. They delivered the former Labor government’s failed bail programs. They delivered a program that saw youth offenders on bail reoffend 60% of the time, and when it came to serious repeat offenders, it got even worse.

YAC was responsible only for children in Brisbane, not the rest of the state. Other organisations that provided services under the previous scheme will continue to be funded, including Anglicare, which will take over YAC’s funding.
Berkman said a recent state government evaluation had shown the YAC scheme was effective in reducing the frequency and seriousness of offending.

articles.title: Israel election live: polls open in most consequential vote in country’s history
articles.author: Jonathan Yerushalmy

paras.en: Hello and welcome to our coverage of the Israeli elections. Polls have opened in the first election since the Hamas-led attacks of 7 October 2023, Israel’s subsequent destruction of Gaza, and the launch of its war with the US against Iran.
paras.zh: 您好，欢迎收看我们对以色列选举的报道。自2023年10月7日哈马斯领导的袭击、以色列随后对加沙的破坏以及与美国对伊朗发动战争以来，民意调查已经开始。

paras.en: Most polling shows prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition will lose its majority in the 120-seat Knesset, but the opposition bloc will probably also fall short of the 61 seats needed to form a government.
paras.zh: 大多数民意调查显示，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）的联盟将在120个席位的议会中失去多数席位，但反对派集团也可能没有达到组建政府所需的61个席位。

paras.en: For Netanyahu, 76, who has led the most far-right government in Israel’s history, the stakes are both political and personal. He is on trial for corruption in three separate cases, despite interventions from Donald Trump, who called for a pre-emptive pardon in the long-running saga and even wrote to Israeli president Isaac Herzog on Netanyahu’s behalf. The cases are ongoing.
paras.zh: 76岁的内塔尼亚胡领导了以色列历史上最极右的政府，他认为这既是政治上的，也是个人上的。尽管唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）在长期的传奇故事中呼吁先发制人地赦免，甚至代表内塔尼亚胡写信给以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格（ Isaac Herzog ） ，但他仍在三个不同的案件中接受腐败审判。这些案件正在审理中。

paras.en: It was on Netanyahu’s watch that Hamas militants broke out from Gaza three years ago to kill nearly 1,200 people, the majority of them civilians, on the deadliest day in Israel’s history. This election is widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu’s leadership since those attacks.
paras.zh: 正是在内塔尼亚胡的监督下，哈马斯武装分子三年前从加沙爆发，在以色列历史上最致命的一天杀害了近1200人，其中大多数是平民。自那次袭击以来，这次选举被广泛视为对内塔尼亚胡领导层的全民公决。

paras.en: Three years of regional conflict followed the 7 October attacks, including this year’s war on Iran, which sparked an ongoing global energy crisis and has killed thousands of people, mainly in Lebanon and Iran.
paras.zh: 在10月7日袭击事件发生后，包括今年对伊朗的战争在内的三年地区冲突引发了持续的全球能源危机，造成数千人死亡，主要在黎巴嫩和伊朗。

paras.en: What is more, under Netanyahu’s government there has been an unprecedented, aggressive surge of deadly extremist settler violence to bolster Israeli control in the occupied West Bank, as settler militants and their political backers – who have propped up Netanyahu’s government – exploited their seat at the cabinet table and expanded with impunity.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，在内塔尼亚胡政府领导下，致命的极端主义定居者暴力事件前所未有地激增，以加强以色列对被占领的约旦河西岸的控制，因为定居者武装分子及其政治支持者–他们支持内塔尼亚胡政府–利用他们在内阁议席上的席位并肆无忌惮地扩张。

paras.en: Indeed, settlement expansion has been a key feature of Netanyahu’s re-election campaign. However, it is also a driving force behind Israel’s growing international isolation, with many of its traditional allies condemning “settler terrorists” and announcing plans to impose sanctions.
paras.zh: 事实上，扩大定居点一直是内塔尼亚胡连任竞选活动的一个关键特征。然而，它也是以色列日益严重的国际孤立背后的驱动力，其许多传统盟友谴责“定居者恐怖分子”并宣布实施制裁的计划。

paras.en: Explainer: What you need to know about the most consequential election in Israel’s history
paras.zh: 解释者：关于以色列历史上最重要的选举，您需要了解什么

paras.en: Israel is holding its first election since the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks, the deadliest day in the country’s history, which resulted in the deaths of about 1,200 people, the majority of them civilians.
paras.zh: 以色列正在举行自2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击以来的首次选举，这是该国历史上最致命的一天，导致约1200人死亡，其中大多数是平民。

paras.en: Since then Israel has pursued a war of annihilation in Gaza, launched two inconclusive wars with Iran, and intensified a campaign of state-backed ethnic cleansing in theoccupiedWest Bank.
paras.zh: 从那时起，以色列在加沙发动了一场毁灭战争，与伊朗发动了两场没有结果的战争，并在被占领的西岸加强了一场国家支持的种族清洗运动。

paras.en: Domestically the coalition formed by Benjamin Netanyahu has taken aim at democratic institutions, including the supreme court. Many Israelis have described this election as the most consequential in their country’s history.
paras.zh: 在国内，本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）组建的联盟瞄准了民主机构，包括最高法院。许多以色列人将这次选举描述为他们国家历史上最重要的选举。

paras.en: Here, Emma runs through everything you need to know – from the key players and issues, to when we can expect the results:
paras.zh: 在这里， Emma详细介绍了您需要了解的所有内容，从主要参与者和问题，到我们可以期待结果的时间：

paras.en: Hello and welcome to our coverage of the Israeli elections. Polls have opened in the first election since the Hamas-led attacks of 7 October 2023, Israel’s subsequent destruction of Gaza, and the launch of its war with the US against Iran.
paras.zh: 您好，欢迎收看我们对以色列选举的报道。自2023年10月7日哈马斯领导的袭击、以色列随后对加沙的破坏以及与美国对伊朗发动战争以来，民意调查已经开始。

paras.en: Most polling shows prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition will lose its majority in the 120-seat Knesset, but the opposition bloc will probably also fall short of the 61 seats needed to form a government.
paras.zh: 大多数民意调查显示，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）的联盟将在120个席位的议会中失去多数席位，但反对派集团也可能没有达到组建政府所需的61个席位。

paras.en: For Netanyahu, 76, who has led the most far-right government in Israel’s history, the stakes are both political and personal. He is on trial for corruption in three separate cases, despite interventions from Donald Trump, who called for a pre-emptive pardon in the long-running saga and even wrote to Israeli president Isaac Herzog on Netanyahu’s behalf. The cases are ongoing.
paras.zh: 76岁的内塔尼亚胡领导了以色列历史上最极右的政府，他认为这既是政治上的，也是个人上的。尽管唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）在长期的传奇故事中呼吁先发制人地赦免，甚至代表内塔尼亚胡写信给以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格（ Isaac Herzog ） ，但他仍在三个不同的案件中接受腐败审判。这些案件正在审理中。

paras.en: It was on Netanyahu’s watch that Hamas militants broke out from Gaza three years ago to kill nearly 1,200 people, the majority of them civilians, on the deadliest day in Israel’s history. This election is widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu’s leadership since those attacks.
paras.zh: 正是在内塔尼亚胡的监督下，哈马斯武装分子三年前从加沙爆发，在以色列历史上最致命的一天杀害了近1200人，其中大多数是平民。自那次袭击以来，这次选举被广泛视为对内塔尼亚胡领导层的全民公决。

paras.en: Three years of regional conflict followed the 7 October attacks, including this year’s war on Iran, which sparked an ongoing global energy crisis and has killed thousands of people, mainly in Lebanon and Iran.
paras.zh: 在10月7日袭击事件发生后，包括今年对伊朗的战争在内的三年地区冲突引发了持续的全球能源危机，造成数千人死亡，主要在黎巴嫩和伊朗。

paras.en: What is more, under Netanyahu’s government there has been an unprecedented, aggressive surge of deadly extremist settler violence to bolster Israeli control in the occupied West Bank, as settler militants and their political backers – who have propped up Netanyahu’s government – exploited their seat at the cabinet table and expanded with impunity.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，在内塔尼亚胡政府领导下，致命的极端主义定居者暴力事件前所未有地激增，以加强以色列对被占领的约旦河西岸的控制，因为定居者武装分子及其政治支持者–他们支持内塔尼亚胡政府–利用他们在内阁议席上的席位并肆无忌惮地扩张。

paras.en: Indeed, settlement expansion has been a key feature of Netanyahu’s re-election campaign. However, it is also a driving force behind Israel’s growing international isolation, with many of its traditional allies condemning “settler terrorists” and announcing plans to impose sanctions.
paras.zh: 事实上，扩大定居点一直是内塔尼亚胡连任竞选活动的一个关键特征。然而，它也是以色列日益严重的国际孤立背后的驱动力，其许多传统盟友谴责“定居者恐怖分子”并宣布实施制裁的计划。

articles.title: Jordan carries out deadly strike in Syria in retaliation for church attack

paras.en: Jordan has struck what its military says were "terrorist organisations" in Syria in retaliation for an attack on a Christian funeral last week that killed nine people.
paras.zh: 约旦已经打击了其军方所说的叙利亚“恐怖组织” ，以报复上周对基督教葬礼的袭击，该葬礼造成9人死亡。

paras.en: Syrian health officials told state media five people, including women, children and an elderly man, were killed in the strike on a village in the southern Daraa province. Jordan said its fighter jets had killed and wounded "several terrorists", without giving further details.
paras.zh: 叙利亚卫生官员告诉国家媒体，包括妇女、儿童和一名老人在内的五人在德拉省南部一个村庄的罢工中丧生。约旦说，其战斗机打死打伤了“几名恐怖分子” ，但没有提供进一步的细节。

paras.en: Jordan said it had co-ordinated with the Syrian government. Syria said it had not been notified of Monday's attack.
paras.zh: 约旦表示已与叙利亚政府协调。叙利亚表示，它没有收到周一袭击的通知。

paras.en: It comes after a nine people were killed and 34 injured in a shooting at a funeral in a Greek Orthodox church in Karak on Friday.
paras.zh: 上周五，在卡拉克一座希腊东正教教堂的葬礼上，一场枪击事件造成9人死亡， 34人受伤。

paras.en: In response to the strike, Syria said it had closed a border crossing with Jordan.
paras.zh: 作为对罢工的回应，叙利亚表示已关闭与约旦的边界过境点。

paras.en: "The decision includes the complete suspension of passenger and commercial traffic in both directions, to ensure the safety of travellers and workers at the crossing," Syrian authorities said in a statement carried by state media.
paras.zh: 叙利亚当局在国家媒体发表的一份声明中表示： “该决定包括完全暂停双向客运和商业交通，以确保过境点旅客和工人的安全。”

paras.en: It added that it had "opened direct channels of communication" with Jordanian officials and had launched "comprehensive investigations to establish the full circumstances of the targeting".
paras.zh: 它补充说，它“打开了与约旦官员的直接沟通渠道” ，并开展了“全面调查，以确定目标的全部情况”。

paras.en: Nassib is the only passenger and commercial border crossing between Jordan and Syria.
paras.zh: 纳西布是约旦和叙利亚之间唯一的客运和商业过境点。

paras.en: Earlier on Monday, senior government security officials said Jordanian security forces had arrested two brothers and their brother-in-law over the church attack.
paras.zh: 周一早些时候，政府高级安全官员表示，约旦安全部队在教堂袭击事件中逮捕了两名兄弟和他们的姐夫。

paras.en: The Public Security Directorate (PSD) said the unnamed "terrorists" were found hiding in an abandoned house in Karak before dawn.
paras.zh: 公安局（ PSD ）表示，未透露姓名的“恐怖分子”在黎明前被发现躲藏在卡拉克的一所废弃房屋中。

paras.en: Jordan's Interior Minister Mazen al-Faraya told state-affiliated TV the attackers were all Jordanians and "had been holed up in a building in one of the villages near the site of the attack".
paras.zh: 约旦内政部长马赞·法拉亚（ Mazen al-Faraya ）告诉国家电视台，袭击者都是约旦人， “被躲在袭击现场附近的一个村庄的一栋建筑物里”。

articles.title: Meghan to co-host Junior MasterChef Australia

paras.en: The Duchess of Sussex has been confirmed as a co-host of the new season of Junior MasterChef Australia.
paras.zh: 苏塞克斯公爵夫人已被确认为澳大利亚初级厨艺大师新赛季的联合主持人。

paras.en: Meghan will join the 2027 series as a "special guest" with fellow host Poh Ling Yeow, according to Australia's Channel 10.
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚第10频道报道， Meghan将作为“特别嘉宾”与其他房东Poh Ling Yeow一起参加2027系列节目。

paras.en: The duchess said she "can't wait" to take part in the programme after an appearance as a guest judge on MasterChef Australia last year. It was the show's largest Sunday audience since 2023, according to the statement from Paramount ANZ.
paras.zh: 公爵夫人说，去年在澳大利亚MasterChef担任嘉宾评委后，她“迫不及待”地想参加这个节目。根据派拉蒙澳新银行的声明，这是该节目自2023年以来最大的周日观众。

paras.en: The announcement comes as Meghan faces increased scrutiny due to her father Thomas Markle being accused of child sexual abuse. He denies the allegations.
paras.zh: 由于她的父亲托马斯·马克尔（ Thomas Markle ）被指控对儿童进行性虐待，梅根面临越来越多的审查。他否认了这些指控。

paras.en: The BBC understands Meghan broke contact with her father last year, telling him she and authorities knew he had abused young girls.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司了解到，梅根去年与她的父亲断绝了联系，告诉他她和当局知道他虐待过年轻女孩。

paras.en: Markle has strongly rejected the accusations as "lies" which are being used to destroy his reputation.
paras.zh: 马克尔强烈反对这些指控，认为这些指控是“谎言” ，被用来破坏他的声誉。

paras.en: Meghan's return to Australia follows a four-day tour of the country she and Prince Harry undertook in April.
paras.zh: 梅根在4月份对她和哈里王子进行了为期四天的澳大利亚之旅后返回澳大利亚。

paras.en: Meghan's MasterChef debut was announced on the second day of the tour, a Wednesday on which the duchess had been notably absent from public-facing appearances. That evening, it was revealed she had been filming an episode of the programme.
paras.zh: Meghan的MasterChef首次亮相是在巡演的第二天宣布的，周三公爵夫人明显缺席了面向公众的露面。那天晚上，据透露，她一直在拍摄该节目的一集。

paras.en: It is understood she was not paid for her appearance. Australia's Network 10, which airs the series as part of Paramount ANZ, did not respond to a question from the BBC about whether Meghan would be paid for co-hosting the Junior MasterChef season.
paras.zh: 据了解，她的外表没有得到报酬。作为派拉蒙澳新(Paramount ANZ)的一部分播出该剧的澳大利亚第10网络(Network 10)没有回答英国广播公司(BBC)关于梅根是否会因共同主办初级厨艺大师赛季而获得报酬的问题。

paras.en: "I love cooking with my own kids, so seeing what these young stars create in the kitchen is going to be a lot of fun," Meghan said in a statement.
paras.zh: 梅根在一份声明中说： “我喜欢和自己的孩子一起烹饪，所以看看这些年轻明星在厨房里创造的东西会很有趣。”

paras.en: In August, the Sussexes announced they were moving back to the UK from California. The couple left the UK and stepped back from their royal duties in early 2020, before settling in California in March that year.
paras.zh: 8月，苏塞克斯夫妇宣布他们将从加利福尼亚搬回英国。这对夫妇于2020年初离开英国，辞去了王室职务，然后于当年3月在加利福尼亚州定居。

paras.en: They embarked on media careers which included a high-profile interview with Oprah Winfrey and a deal with Netflix and Spotify.
paras.zh: 他们开始了媒体生涯，其中包括对奥普拉·温弗瑞的高调采访以及与Netflix和Spotify的交易。

paras.en: Meghan's lifestyle and cookery show on Netflix, With Love, Meghan, ran for two series and a Christmas special but did not perform well with audiences.
paras.zh: Meghan在Netflix上的生活方式和烹饪节目With Love ， Meghan参加了两个系列和圣诞特别节目，但在观众中表现不佳。

paras.en: She also launched lifestyle brand As Ever, which includes a food range, but in March it ended its partnership with the streaming platform.
paras.zh: 她还推出了包括食品系列在内的生活方式品牌As Ever ，但在3月份结束了与该流媒体平台的合作关系。

paras.en: Last year her trademark was registered in more than a dozen product categories in Australia, including cookware and table linen.
paras.zh: 去年，她的商标在澳大利亚注册了十几个产品类别，包括炊具和桌布。

articles.title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show

paras.en: Rapper Jay-Z will perform at the Super Bowl half-time show in February, the NFL has announced.
paras.zh: NFL宣布，说唱歌手Jay-Z将在2月的超级碗半场表演中表演。

paras.en: Jay-Z's company Roc Nation has produced the half-time show since 2019, and he plays a key role in selecting each year's performer but he has not performed before at the NFL championship game.
paras.zh: Jay-Z的公司Roc Nation自2019年以来一直制作半场表演，他在选择每年的表演者方面发挥着关键作用，但他以前从未在NFL锦标赛中表演过。

paras.en: "Anticipation as to who Jay-Z might have guest star at halftime for the big game will now kick off," the NFL said in a statement. "Of course, his wife, BeyoncÃ©, will be atop the list."
paras.zh: 美国国家橄榄球联盟在一份声明中说： “关于Jay-Z可能在半场结束时为大型比赛带来客串明星的预期现在开始了。” “当然，他的妻子碧昂丝会名列前茅。”

paras.en: Next year's Super Bowl LXI will take place on 14 February near Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 明年的超级碗LXI将于2月14日在洛杉矶附近举行。

paras.en: The hip-hop star will follow in the footsteps of other recent half-time performers including Bad Bunny, Kendrick Lamar, Usher, Rihanna and The Weeknd.
paras.zh: 这位嘻哈明星将跟随其他近期半场表演者的脚步，包括Bad Bunny、Kendrick Lamar、Usher、Rihanna和The Weeknd。

paras.en: The musical performance draws global attention while the sport is watched by tens of millions of people in the US.
paras.zh: 音乐表演吸引了全球的关注，而这项运动在美国有数千万人观看。

paras.en: Kendrick Lamar's 2025 performance was the most watched Super Bowl half-time show in history and won the Emmy award for outstanding music direction.
paras.zh: 肯德里克·拉马尔（ Kendrick Lamar ）的2025年表演是历史上观看次数最多的超级碗半场表演，并获得了艾美奖杰出音乐指导奖

paras.en: The announcement was made after Jay-Z, whose real name is Shawn Carter, performed two shows last weekend at the Los Angeles stadium where the Super Bowl will be played.
paras.zh: 这一消息是在Jay-Z （真名为Shawn Carter ）上周末在洛杉矶体育场进行了两场表演之后宣布的，超级碗将在那里举行。

paras.en: The LA shows were part of a tour to celebrate the 30th anniversary of his debut album Reasonable Doubt.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶演出是他首张专辑《Reasonable Doubt》30周年巡演的一部分。

paras.en: "From 'Reasonable Doubt' to standing on the Super Bowl halftime stage, this has been a journey," said Jay-Z, whose real name is Shawn Carter.
paras.zh: “从'合理怀疑'到站在超级碗半场，这是一段旅程，” Jay-Z说，他的真名是Shawn Carter。

paras.en: "Thirty years of music, work, and culture on the world's biggest stage. This run continues to be a dream come true."
paras.zh: “在世界上最大的舞台上度过了30年的音乐、工作和文化时光。这场比赛仍然是梦想成真。”

paras.en: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said he "couldn't be more excited for fans around the world to experience the artistry, creativity and cultural impact he will bring".
paras.zh: NFL专员罗杰·古德尔（ Roger Goodell ）表示，他“对世界各地的球迷能够体验到他将带来的艺术性，创造力和文化影响感到无比兴奋”。

paras.en: "When we first reached an agreement with Roc Nation to produce the show, I had just one request: that Jay-Z take the stage himself one day, whenever the moment felt right to him," Goodell said.
paras.zh: 古德尔说： “当我们第一次与Roc Nation达成协议制作该节目时，我只有一个要求：有一天，只要他觉得这一刻合适， Jay-Z就自己上台。”

paras.en: The star's accolades include being the first rapper inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame, 25 Grammy awards and being inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2021.
paras.zh: 这位明星的荣誉包括成为首位入选作曲家名人堂的说唱歌手，获得25项格莱美奖，并于2021年入选摇滚名人堂。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

(MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.

Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).

“We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.

EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.

Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

(MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.

"We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.

articles.title: Protech Joins Opus IVS ADAS MAP Pro Network
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Opus IVS announced that Protech Automotive Solutions has joined its ADAS MAP Pro connected provider network as a Premier ADAS Calibration Provider, expanding access to Protech’s nationwide diagnostic and calibration service capabilities for collision repairers.

The Premier Provider designation recognizes Protech’s extensive technical expertise, established national service network and ability to support repairers with increasingly complex vehicle diagnostics and ADAS calibration requirements. As part of the ADAS MAP Pro network, Protech brings a range of advanced automotive services to repair facilities seeking specialized support.

As vehicle technology evolves, collision repairers face growing demands for advanced diagnostics, ADAS calibrations and specialized technical expertise. The partnership connects Opus’ technology for identifying advanced service requirements with Protech’s field expertise and national service network, helping repairers connect with the services needed to complete the work.

“Vehicle technology is becoming increasingly complex, and repairers need solutions that help them manage that complexity efficiently,” said Ryan Simpson, president of Opus IVS. “Protech brings extensive technical expertise, nationwide reach and established service capabilities to our connected provider network. Their Premier Provider designation reflects those strengths and our shared commitment to helping repairers access the specialized services they need.”

Through the partnership, Opus IVS customers can access Protech’s service capabilities, including advanced vehicle diagnostics, ADAS calibrations, module programming and mobile field services. Protech’s service model helps reduce coordination challenges, minimize unnecessary vehicle movement and keep repair work moving efficiently.

“For independent repairers, keeping pace with increasingly sophisticated vehicle technology can be challenging, especially when the right expertise or equipment isn’t readily available,” said Jon Webber, senior vice president of Protech Automotive Solutions. “That’s where Protech makes a difference. We bring advanced diagnostic and calibration capabilities directly to the repair process, helping shops expand what they can confidently take on without having to build every capability themselves. Our partnership with Opus makes it easier for repairers to connect with those services when and where they need them.”

articles.title: TechForce Foundation Names Brandon Zollner Chief Development Officer

paras.en: TechForce Foundation, a national nonprofit championing students to and through technical education and into skilled technician careers, has announced Brandon Zollner as its new chief development officer.

Zollner joins TechForce Foundation from Western Governors University, where he served as executive director of development. He brings experience building philanthropic and corporate partnerships at the intersection of education, workforce development and economic mobility.

“Brandon joins TechForce at an exciting point in our growth,” said Jennifer Maher, CEO of TechForce Foundation. “Our work has grown beyond any single program. We are building an ecosystem that connects students, schools, industry and working technicians to help more people successfully navigate the path from career exploration through education and into the workforce. Brandon understands how philanthropy and industry partnership can accelerate that kind of systemic change, and we are thrilled to have him on our leadership team.”

articles.title: Magnaflow President Dan Paolone on the ‘Long-Term Play’
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Dan Paolone, president, Magnaflow.

Paolone said Magnaflow’s family-owned heritage has shaped both its culture and its long-term approach to the market. Founded in 1981 by his uncle, Jerry Paolone, the company has operated around a “build it and stand by it” philosophy while emphasizing lasting relationships and accountability from design through manufacturing. While Magnaflow is widely associated with performance exhaust, Paolone emphasized that the company is fundamentally an emissions and exhaust business, with approximately 10,000 SKUs across catalytic converters and BRExhaust. That breadth, combined with its premium performance brands, gives Magnaflow a much broader aftermarket presence than its performance reputation alone might suggest, he explained.

paras.en: Vertical integration is another key part of Magnaflow’s strategy. Paolone said the company invests consistently in employees, infrastructure and capital to maintain greater control from research and development through manufacturing and distribution. That approach also extends to data, an area where Magnaflow has made significant investments. By controlling more of the process and supply chain, Paolone said the company gains flexibility while supporting its long-term strategy. That philosophy reflects Magnaflow’s broader approach to business: Rather than managing quarter to quarter, the company views each quarter as another step toward executing a plan measured in years and decades.

The company models vehicle trends through 2040 and expects hybrids, which still require catalytic converters and exhaust systems, to create additional opportunities. BRExhaust is also expanding by offering complete installation kits for repair shops that eliminate the need for welding, cutting or pipe bending, helping technicians complete more repairs in-house. On the OE side, Magnaflow sees an opportunity to serve lower-volume platforms, particularly vehicles in the 10,000- to 20,000-unit range, where its infrastructure and consumer-facing brand can make it an attractive partner.

articles.title: Hyundai on child safety seat education

paras.en: Hyundai recently joined the Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) to highlight the program’s impact and provide families with hands-on safety education.

“Every parent and caregiver deserves access to reliable information and resources that help keep their children safe while traveling,” said Benjamin Michajlyszyn, Hyundai Motor North America safety test and investigations laboratory director, in a Hyundai press release. “Our work with Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia helps connect families with expert guidance and hands-on support, making child passenger safety education more accessible throughout the community.”
According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), nearly half of child safety seats are installed incorrectly or used improperly.
NHTSA says the most common misuse errors are:

Securing children properly in age- and size-appropriate car seats can reduce the risk of fatal injury by 71% for infants younger than 1 year old and by 54% for 1- to 4-year-olds, according to NHTSA’s data.
Last week, Hyundai Hope, Hyundai Motor America’s corporate social responsibility initiative, donated $50,000 to CHOP’s Car Seat Safety for Kids program.
The investment supports child passenger safety education, car seat inspections, and resources for families in the region, according to the release.

“CHOP’s Car Seat Safety for Kids program teaches families how to properly install and use child safety seats through education, inspections, and one-on-one guidance from certified child passenger safety technicians,” the release states. “During child safety seat check events, technicians inspect seats for expiration dates, manufacturer recalls, and proper fit while providing hands-on instruction to parents and caregivers. Families in need may also receive replacement seats, helping to ensure children travel safely. Hyundai’s support helps expand access to these critical resources and reinforces safe transportation practices for children across the community.”

paras.en: Hyundai says Hyundai Hope is committed to the principle of “progress for humanity and the goal of improving the well-being of society.” It dedicates time and supplies resources to nonprofit organizations to help support the health and safety of individuals and positive growth in communities.

Since 2022, Hyundai’s support has helped CHOP provide more than 21,000 new car seats and booster seats to families in need and has helped conduct more than 2,600 child safety seat inspections, according to the release.

“Child passenger safety is one of the most important steps families can take to protect children every time they travel,” said Gina Duchossois, CHOP’s injury prevention manager, in the release. “Hyundai’s support enables us to provide personalized assistance to caregivers, helping ensure more children are riding safely in the right seat for their age, size, and stage of development.”
In August, Hyundai Hope also made $25,000 donations to child safety seat programs in Massachusetts and Washington, as well as in Metro Detroit last month and Washington, D.C., in July.

A new law took effect in Colorado earlier this year that requires insurance policies to cover the replacement of child restraint systems involved in a collision. It also requires insurers to ask a claimant if a child restraint system was in the vehicle at the time of a collision.
Colorado Gov. Jared Polis signed HB 25-1179 into law in April 2025. The Colorado Division of Insurance’s Department of Regulatory Agencies later issued a guidance bulletin to insurance companies.
Several presentations given at the 2025 SEMA Show highlighted the importance of post-collision seatbelt, steering column, and airbag inspections.

Collision Advice’s Mike Anderson said repairers must inspect the seatbelt webbing and mounting locations. For example, this includes the latch systems — the triangle piece that mounts to the package tray where child safety seats are installed.

“Every single vehicle manufacturer says seatbelts must be inspected after a collision,” Anderson said. “Sometimes it’s not limited to just the seatbelt that was in use during the accident, but any seatbelts as well that were not in use, as well as child safety seat latches or the tether points.”

articles.title: Kansas to elect insurance commissioner Nov. 3
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Voters in Kansas have three candidates to choose from for insurance commissioner in the midterm election.
The four-year position has no term limits. Vicki Schmidt, a Republican, has served in the role since 2019. She did not run again so she could pursue the Republican nomination for governor.
The candidates include Dinah Sykes, Democrat minority leader of the Kansas Senate, Daniel Hawkins, Republican speaker of the Kansas House of Representatives and Libertarian Ric Koehn.
Sykes spent the last nine years in the Kansas legislature, according to her LinkedIn.

“For Dinah, it all comes down to two things: fairness and affordability,” her campaign website states. “She’s tired of seeing the insurance industry denying payment or blocking treatment for consumers, so she’s making it her mission to hold the insurance industry accountable so that they play by the rules.”
She lists affordability, consumer protection, transparency, and fairness as her priorities.
Hawkins’ website states he started a career in the insurance business in 1995. He specialized in employee benefits for small businesses, according to the website.
He was elected to the Kansas House in 2013.

“As Insurance Commissioner, I will wake up early every day and get to work, making sure we have an Insurance Department that stands strong for the hardworking people of Kansas,” Hawkins says on the website. “I’ll never stop fighting to lower costs, improve transparency, and hold fraudsters accountable.”
Hawkins’ website states he will focus on lower costs, holding the powerful and fraudsters accountable, and restoring competition and choice.
Ric Koehn does not have a campaign website.
The Libertarian Party of Kansas website notes Koehn’s priority is returning the insurance industry to the free market.
The website says he opposes all taxes, subsidies, foreign wars, and public education. He supports marijuana.

articles.title: California: Storage fee, airbag regs could take effect Jan. 1; comment open on towing regulation
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Changes to the California Bureau of Automotive Repair (BAR) storage fee and airbag safety regulations are expected to take effect Jan. 1, pending approval by the Office of Administrative Law (OAL).
BAR also plans to change its towing authorization regulations, with a comment period open Oct. 30-Dec. 14.

BAR says the storage fee changes clarify how and when automotive repair dealers (ARDs) can charge the fees. Adopted changes to airbag regulations would expand repair safety in the state, including requiring ARDs to follow OEM procedures, according to BAR.
In an update given at BAR’s Advisory Group meeting on Oct. 22, the adopted storage fee changes would require ARDs to:
- Store a vehicle at its primary business address as registered with BAR;
- Provide an itemized invoice for storage fees;
- Post current daily storage fees in an area frequented by customers; and
- Report maximum daily storage rate to BAR when renewing registration.
Based on reported daily storage rates, BAR plans to launch a search tool on its website that shows the average and median rates using defined geographic areas around each ARD.

BAR held four public workshops on proposed changes, which were modified at least twice. Three comment periods were also held. BAR submitted its package on the changes to the OAL on Oct. 9 for final approval. BAR said last week the OAL deadline is Nov. 23.

The OAL previously identified several provisions where wording needed greater clarity to ensure consistent interpretation and application. In August, BAR said it withdrew the package to address the concerns.

The passage of AB1263 in 2024 gave BAR authority to address storage fees. It also allows BAR to codify its guidance and unify existing laws on the subject, which BAR says is part of the regulation changes package. The changes also include teardown disclosures.
Repairers have previously voiced concerns about language in the proposed regulations that would cap storage fees and cause shops to lose storage revenue.

Under the airbag safety regulation changes, ARDs will be required “to restore an airbag that is part of an inflatable restraint system to its original operating condition as designed by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM).”

Prohibit an ARD from manufacturing, installing, or selling any airbag or airbag part/component that has been deployed, has an electrical fault, includes a component designed to mislead the vehicle owner or operator into believing a functional airbag has been installed, or displays a mark identical or substantially similar to the genuine mark of a motor vehicle manufacturer, or a parts supplier without authorization from the OEM or supplier.
ARDs would also not be allowed to manufacture, install, or sell recalled airbags either by the OEM or the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration.
BAR states that ARDs can buy airbag replacement parts or components from OEMs; suppliers or resellers previously authorized by the appropriate OEM; or DMV-licensed automotive dismantlers.
The California Department of Consumer Affairs is reviewing the package. After that’s complete, BAR says it will file the package with OAL for final approval.

Proposed towing authorization changes would require customer authorization for towing fees before service on a separate document from repair authorizations. ARDs would also have to list any storage or towing-related charges as separate line items on the invoice. The package has been filed with the OAL.
The Advisory Group also received an update last week on BAR consumer complaints data.
Complaints have increased about 15% over the past year, with auto body making up 16% of all complaints. Engine repair complaints were highest at 35%.

articles.title: What is Caster, and How Does it Influence Tire Wear?
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Caster tire wear is usually indirect, but the alignment angle can influence how tread wears during turns. It is one of the fundamental wheel alignment angles, and while it does not directly cause tire wear, it can affect shoulder loading during cornering.
Caster is the angle of the steering axis when viewed from the side of the vehicle. That axis acts as the hinge line around which the wheel pivots when the driver turns the steering wheel.

Most vehicles use positive caster. This means the top of the steering axis tilts slightly toward the rear of the vehicle. Positive caster helps the steering return to center after a turn. It also improves straight-line stability, especially at highway speeds.
Caster Tire Wear Develops Through Camber Change
Caster changes how the wheels lean during a turn. With positive caster, the inner wheel tilts outward while the outer wheel tilts inward.
This movement shifts load across the tire contact patches and helps the vehicle corner.

Caster does not normally wear a tire by itself. Instead, it changes camber as the wheels turn, a movement often called camber roll. As the tires lean during cornering, more load can be placed on the tread shoulders. Under normal driving, the effect may be minor. Aggressive cornering, however, can accelerate shoulder wear.
Too much caster can also make steering feel heavy or harsh. For that reason, caster specifications vary by vehicle.
For tire dealers and alignment technicians, caster may not be the direct cause of an unusual wear pattern. However, it can contribute to shoulder wear by changing wheel angle during turns.

articles.title: Think Like a Technician, Test Like a Pro
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Preparing for an Automotive Service Excellence (ASE) certification exam takes more than memorizing terms and reviewing repair procedures. You need to understand how vehicle systems work, recognize diagnostic clues and apply your knowledge when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.

The good news? Many of the skills that make you a better technician can also make you a stronger test-taker. With a solid study plan and the right approach to practice questions, you can head into your ASE exam ready to tackle the challenges ahead.

Before opening a textbook or watching a training video, identify which ASE test you’re preparing to take. Each exam focuses on specific systems and service procedures, so knowing what to expect helps you use your study time effectively.
Review the official ASE study guides and task lists to identify the topics covered. Then compare those topics with your current knowledge and hands-on experience.

For example, if you’re preparing for the A6 Electrical/Electronic Systems test, you might feel comfortable testing batteries and charging systems but need additional practice interpreting wiring diagrams. Spend more time on the topics that challenge you instead of repeatedly reviewing material you already know.
Practice Thinking Through Diagnostic Questions
ASE exams aren’t just about recalling facts. Many questions present a vehicle symptom or service problem and ask you to identify the most likely cause or appropriate diagnostic step.

Imagine a vehicle arrives with a battery that repeatedly goes dead overnight. You might immediately suspect a failing battery. But what if the charging system operates correctly and the battery passes its tests?

A good technician considers other possibilities, including an excessive parasitic draw. That same diagnostic thinking helps you work through ASE-style questions.Read each question carefully, identify the relevant symptoms and evaluate the available answers. Don’t jump to conclusions based on one familiar detail.
One of the most useful ASE test-taking skills is recognizing why an answer doesn’t fit.
When facing a multiple-choice question, start by identifying what the question is actually asking. Is it looking for the most likely cause, the next diagnostic step or the correct repair procedure?

Next, eliminate answers that conflict with the symptoms or accepted service procedures. Even when you’re unsure of the correct response, narrowing your choices can improve your chances of selecting the right answer.
This approach is especially helpful with Technician A and Technician B questions, which require you to evaluate two separate statements before choosing an answer.
Use Video Training and Practice Tests Together
Different study methods reinforce different skills. Reading helps you review technical information, while videos can make complicated procedures easier to understand.

The free ASE Study Center offers video-based instruction and ASE-style practice questions to help technicians prepare. Its training modules focus on test-related topics and encourage learners to understand the reasoning behind correct answers.
Instead of simply watching a video and moving on, pause and explain the procedure in your own words. Then use practice questions to check whether you can apply what you’ve learned.
When you miss a question, review the explanation. Understanding why an answer is incorrect can teach you just as much as getting one right.

Knowing the material is important, but managing your time matters, too. ASE certification exams are timed, making it useful to practice answering questions without spending too long on any single problem.

Try completing a set of practice questions under timed conditions. Review your results afterward and identify whether mistakes came from unfamiliar material, misreading questions or second-guessing yourself.
As test day approaches, focus on reviewing weak areas, getting adequate rest and arriving prepared to concentrate.
Turn Test Preparation Into Shop-Ready Skills
ASE preparation should do more than help you pass an exam. It should strengthen the habits you’ll use every day in the service bay.
Learning to identify symptoms, eliminate incorrect possibilities and verify your conclusions makes you a more capable technician.

The next time you face a challenging practice question, approach it like a vehicle diagnosis: Gather the facts, think through the problem and trust the process. Those are skills worth carrying well beyond test day.
