paras.zh: 遗传分析以及对真菌物理特征的仔细检查表明，这一发现代表的不仅仅是以前未知的物种。它与已知的真菌有很大不同，需要在 Xylariales 目中创建一个新属和一个全新的科（Dianjunaceae）。

paras.en: The researchers named the species Dianjunus rex, drawing inspiration from its impressive size and the ancient Dian kingdom. Its nickname, 'D-rex', reflects its exceptional stature among related fungi.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这种物种命名为“Dianjunus rex”，其灵感来自于其令人印象深刻的体型和古滇王国。它的绰号“D-rex”反映了它在相关真菌中的特殊地位。

paras.en: Its closest known relative is Graphostroma platystoma, a fungus that grows on dead hardwood throughout the Northern Hemisphere. That species is the sole representative of its own family, Graphostromataceae.
paras.zh: 其最接近的已知亲戚是 Graphostroma platystoma，这是一种生长在北半球枯死硬木上的真菌。该物种是其所属科 Graphostromataceae 的唯一代表。

paras.en: Members of the order Xylariales are known for producing a variety of specialized chemical compounds and enzymes capable of breaking down complex molecules in plants. Researchers believe similar enzymes may allow 'D-rex' to decompose dead wood and obtain nutrients from it.
paras.zh: Xylariales 目成员因产生各种能够分解植物中复杂分子的特殊化合物和酶而闻名。研究人员认为，类似的酶可能会让“D-rex”分解枯木并从中获取营养。

paras.en: A 65-Million-Year Connection to Dinosaur Extinction
paras.zh: 恐龙灭绝与 6500 万年的联系

paras.en: One of the most intriguing findings concerns the ancient evolutionary origins of the newly identified fungal family.
paras.zh: 最有趣的发现之一涉及新发现的真菌家族的古代进化起源。

paras.en: Using a technique known as a 'molecular clock', the scientists compared the fungus's DNA with genomic information from hundreds of other fungi whose evolutionary histories have been established. This analysis allowed them to estimate when the Dianjunaceae family first appeared.
paras.zh: 科学家们利用一种被称为“分子钟”的技术，将这种真菌的 DNA 与数百种其他已确定进化历史的真菌的基因组信息进行了比较。这项分析使他们能够估计电君子科首次出现的时间。

paras.en: Their results suggest that the lineage originated approximately 65 million years ago, roughly one million years after the Cretaceous-Paleogene mass extinction. That catastrophic event eliminated the non-avian dinosaurs along with countless other animal and plant species.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，该谱系起源于大约 6500 万年前，即白垩纪-古近纪大规模灭绝之后大约 100 万年。那场灾难性事件消灭了非鸟类恐龙以及无数其他动植物物种。

paras.en: The timing raises the possibility that the enormous environmental changes following the extinction helped create favorable conditions for the ancestors of this unusual fungus.
paras.zh: 这一时机提出了一种可能性，即灭绝后巨大的环境变化为这种不寻常真菌的祖先创造了有利的条件。

paras.en: "This timing raises an intriguing possibility. After the mass extinction, forests experienced dramatic changes, including the sudden availability of large amounts of dead plant material," said Senanayake. "For wood-associated decomposing fungi, such environmental disruption may have created new ecological opportunities."
paras.zh: “这个时机提出了一个有趣的可能性。大规模灭绝之后，森林经历了巨大的变化，包括突然出现大量死去的植物材料，”塞纳纳亚克说。 “对于与木材相关的分解真菌来说，这种环境破坏可能创造了新的生态机会。”

paras.en: Another mystery is how and why Dianjunus rex evolved such an extraordinary size.
paras.zh: 另一个谜团是Dianjunus rex如何以及为何进化出如此非凡的体型。

paras.en: Before its discovery, the tallest known ascomycete fruiting bodies measured approximately 20 to 30 cm. The newly identified fungus can reach 50 cm, making it substantially taller than the previous record holders.
paras.zh: 在发现之前，已知最高的子囊菌子实体大约有 20 至 30 厘米。新发现的真菌可以达到50厘米，大大高于之前的纪录保持者。

paras.en: One possible explanation involves how the fungus releases and spreads its spores. By extending high above the forest floor, its reproductive structures may be better positioned to catch moving air and distribute spores through dense vegetation.
paras.zh: 一种可能的解释涉及真菌如何释放和传播其孢子。通过延伸到森林地面上方的高处，它的繁殖结构可以更好地定位以捕捉流动的空气并通过茂密的植被传播孢子。

paras.en: However, growing such a large structure also requires considerable energy. The researchers suggest that this unusual evolutionary strategy would be advantageous only in environments where the benefits of greater spore dispersal outweigh the resources needed for growth.
paras.zh: 然而，建造如此巨大的结构也需要大量的能源。研究人员认为，这种不寻常的进化策略只有在孢子传播更大的好处超过生长所需资源的环境中才会有利。

paras.en: "A fruiting body which towers above surrounding vegetation and debris could have better dispersal of spores by wind in dense forests. However, such a large structure requires substantial energy investment, suggesting that this strategy likely evolved only where the ecological benefits outweighed the costs," hypothesized Senanayake.
paras.zh: “在茂密的森林中，高出周围植被和碎片的子实体可以通过风更好地传播孢子。然而，如此巨大的结构需要大量的能源投资，这表明这种策略可能只有在生态效益超过成本的情况下才会出现，”塞纳纳亚克假设。

paras.en: China's Forests May Harbor More Undiscovered Fungi
paras.zh: 中国的森林可能蕴藏着更多未被发现的真菌

paras.en: The discovery also highlights how much remains unknown about fungal diversity in China's subtropical forests.
paras.zh: 这一发现还凸显了中国亚热带森林的真菌多样性还有多少未知之处。

paras.en: Researchers believe the region is particularly well suited to the evolution of unusual fungal species because it contains a wide variety of habitats, has experienced relatively stable climatic conditions, and supports intricate relationships among living organisms.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，该地区特别适合不寻常真菌物种的进化，因为它拥有各种各样的栖息地，经历了相对稳定的气候条件，并支持生物体之间错综复杂的关系。

paras.en: Despite these favorable conditions, many fungi in the region have received little scientific attention. Remote and difficult terrain complicates fieldwork, while the seasonal appearance and often hidden nature of fungal reproductive structures make some species especially difficult to locate. Historically, research has also concentrated heavily on fungi with commercial or practical value.
paras.zh: 尽管有这些有利的条件，该地区的许多真菌却很少受到科学关注。偏远且困难的地形使野外工作变得复杂，而真菌繁殖结构的季节性出现和往往隐藏的性质使某些物种特别难以定位。从历史上看，研究也主要集中在具有商业或实用价值的真菌上。

paras.en: The scientists expect that continued exploration of these forests will uncover additional species, potentially revealing more unexpected forms and evolutionary histories.
paras.zh: 科学家们预计，对这些森林的持续探索将发现更多物种，有可能揭示更多意想不到的形式和进化历史。

paras.en: "This region combines exceptional habitat heterogeneity, climatic stability, and complex biotic interactions that promote fungal diversification. Historically, however, fungal diversity in these ecosystems has been underestimated due to logistical difficulties in field sampling, the seasonal and cryptic nature of fungal fruiting, and a historical emphasis on economically important fungi," said Senanayake.
paras.zh: Senanayake 说：“该地区具有特殊的栖息地异质性、气候稳定性和复杂的生物相互作用，促进了真菌多样化。然而，从历史上看，由于现场采样的后勤困难、真菌结果的季节性和神秘性以及历史上对重要经济真菌的重视，这些生态系统中的真菌多样性一直被低估。”

paras.zh: 材料由前沿提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: A 2,700-year-old solar eclipse just revealed something surprising about Earth

paras.en: A 2,700-year-old solar eclipse just revealed something surprising about Earth
paras.zh: 2700年前的日食刚刚揭示了地球的一些令人惊讶的事情

paras.en: - A solar eclipse recorded more than 2,700 years ago is revealing surprising secrets about Earth's rotation and the Sun's ancient behavior. By correcting an eight-kilometer error in the location of an ancient Chinese capital, scientists were able to reconstruct a total solar eclipse that occurred in 709 BCE and obtain more accurate measurements of how fast Earth was spinning at the time.
paras.zh: - 2,700 多年前记录的日食揭示了有关地球自转和太阳古代行为的惊人秘密。通过纠正中国古都位置八公里的误差，科学家们能够重建公元前 709 年发生的日全食，并更准确地测量当时地球自转的速度。

paras.en: An international research team has revisited one of the oldest precisely dated records of a total solar eclipse, uncovering new details about how Earth's rotation has changed over thousands of years. By combining historical geography with modern astronomical calculations, the scientists reconstructed an eclipse that occurred in 709 BCE and determined how it would have appeared from Qufu, the ancient capital of China's Lu Duchy.
paras.zh: 一个国际研究小组重新审视了最古老的日全食精确记录，揭示了数千年来地球自转如何变化的新细节。通过将历史地理与现代天文学计算相结合，科学家们重建了公元前709年发生的日食，并确定了日食是如何从中国鲁国古都曲阜出现的。

paras.en: The researchers also examined an early account that may describe the solar corona, the Sun's faint outer atmosphere that becomes visible to the naked eye during a total solar eclipse. Their analysis of its possible shape suggests that the Sun was returning to a more active phase following an extended period of unusually low activity.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了可能描述日冕的早期描述，日冕是太阳微弱的外层大气，在日全食期间肉眼可见。他们对其可能形状的分析表明，太阳在经历了长时间的异常低活动之后，正在返回到更加活跃的阶段。

paras.en: Published in Astrophysical Journal Letters, the findings provide more precise evidence of Earth's rotation speed in ancient times. They also offer potential independent support for previous reconstructions of solar activity based on radiocarbon measurements.
paras.zh: 该研究结果发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上，为古代地球的自转速度提供了更精确的证据。他们还为之前基于放射性碳测量的太阳活动重建提供了潜在的独立支持。

paras.en: An Ancient Chinese Eclipse Record Holds a Crucial Clue
paras.zh: 中国古代日食记录蕴藏着重要线索

paras.en: On July 17, 709 BCE, observers at the court of the Lu Duchy witnessed a total solar eclipse. The event was preserved in the "Spring and Autumn Annals," a historical chronicle compiled approximately 200 to 300 years later. The original account stated that "the Sun was totally eclipsed."
paras.zh: 公元前709年7月17日，鲁国宫廷的观察者目睹了日全食。这一事件被记录在大约200至300年后编撰的历史编年史《春秋》中。最初的记载是“太阳完全被食”。

paras.en: An additional description appears in the "Hanshu" (Book of Han), which preserves a passage written about seven centuries after the eclipse. This later account contains an unusual observation that may refer to the Sun's corona.
paras.zh: 《汉书》中还出现了额外的描述，其中保存了日食发生后约七个世纪的一段文字。后来的叙述包含了一个不寻常的观察结果，可能涉及太阳的日冕。

paras.en: "What makes this record special isn't just its age, but also a later addendum in the 'Hanshu' (Book of Han) based on a quote written seven centuries after the eclipse. It describes the eclipsed Sun as 'completely yellow above and below.' This addendum has been traditionally associated with a record of a solar corona. If this is truly the case, it represents one of the earliest surviving written descriptions of the solar corona," explained lead author Hisashi Hayakawa, an assistant professor at Nagoya University's Institute for Space-Earth Environmental Research and Institute for Advanced Research.
paras.zh: “这个记录的特别之处不仅在于它的年代，还在于《汉书》中后来根据日食七个世纪后写下的一句话进行的补遗。它将日食描述为“上下全黄”。该附录传统上与日冕记录相关。如果情况确实如此，那么它代表了现存最早的关于日冕的书面描述之一。”主要作者、名古屋大学太空-地球环境研究所和高级研究所的助理教授 Hisashi Hayakawa 解释道。

paras.en: Initially, however, the historical account appeared to conflict with modern astronomy. When the team calculated the eclipse's path using existing estimates of Earth's ancient rotation, their results indicated that a total eclipse should not have been visible from the previously assumed location of the Lu court in Qufu.
paras.zh: 然而，最初，历史记载似乎与现代天文学相冲突。当研究小组利用现有的地球自转估计来计算日食的路径时，他们的结果表明，从之前假设的曲阜鲁苑位置看不到日全食。

paras.en: The researchers traced the discrepancy to a mistake in the city's geographic coordinates. By examining archaeological excavation reports and historical geographic evidence, they determined that earlier calculations had placed ancient Qufu approximately eight kilometers from its actual location.
paras.zh: 研究人员将这一差异归因于该城市地理坐标的错误。通过检查考古发掘报告和历史地理证据，他们确定，早期的计算表明古曲阜距其实际位置大约八公里。

paras.en: Correcting this relatively small error made it possible to reconstruct the eclipse more accurately and extract valuable information about Earth's rotation and the Sun's appearance.
paras.zh: 纠正这个相对较小的错误使得能够更准确地重建日食并提取有关地球自转和太阳外观的有价值的信息。

paras.en: "This correction allowed us to accurately measure the Earth's rotation during the total eclipse, calculate the orientation of the Sun's rotation axis, and simulate the corona's appearance," explained Hayakawa, who holds doctorates in solar physics and oriental history.
paras.zh: 拥有太阳物理学和东方历史博士学位的早川解释说：“这种校正使我们能够在日全食期间准确测量地球的自转，计算太阳自转轴的方向，并模拟日冕的外观。”

paras.en: Why Ancient China Preserved Such Detailed Astronomical Records
paras.zh: 中国古代为何保存如此详细的天文记录

paras.en: The survival of this remarkable observation reflects the importance of astronomy in ancient Chinese society. Successive dynasties employed specialists to monitor celestial events because unusual phenomena in the sky were often interpreted as omens.
paras.zh: 这一非凡观测的保存反映了天文学在中国古代社会的重要性。历代王朝都聘请专家来监测天体事件，因为天空中的异常现象通常被解释为预兆。

paras.en: This practice, known as omenology, was closely connected to political beliefs. Eclipses, auroras, and other extraordinary astronomical events were sometimes considered warnings that an emperor had acted improperly.
paras.zh: 这种做法被称为预兆学，与政治信仰密切相关。日食、极光和其他非凡的天文事件有时被认为是皇帝行为不当的警告。

paras.en: As a result, court astronomers carefully documented changes in the sky. The records maintained across successive dynasties eventually became some of the world's most valuable historical sources for studying ancient eclipses.
paras.zh: 结果，宫廷天文学家仔细记录了天空的变化。历代保存的记录最终成为世界上研究古代日食最有价值的历史资料之一。

paras.en: Even so, the researchers emphasize an important distinction between the original eclipse observation and the later description of the corona.
paras.zh: 即便如此，研究人员仍然强调最初的日食观测和后来对日冕的描述之间的重要区别。

paras.en: The 709 BCE event is regarded as the earliest explicit written record of a total solar eclipse that can be securely dated. It may also be associated with one of the oldest surviving descriptions of the solar corona, but that interpretation remains uncertain because the relevant passage appears in a source written centuries after the event.
paras.zh: 公元前 709 年的事件被认为是可以确定日期的最早明确的日全食书面记录。它也可能与现存最古老的日冕描述之一有关，但这种解释仍然不确定，因为相关段落出现在事件发生几个世纪后编写的资料中。

paras.en: Although the corona account requires caution, the established timing of the eclipse provides a reliable basis for investigating Earth's historical rotation. The possible corona description also offers a valuable comparison with other studies of ancient solar activity.
paras.zh: 尽管日冕的解释需要谨慎，但日食的既定时间为调查地球历史自转提供了可靠的基础。可能的日冕描述还提供了与古代太阳活动的其他研究的有价值的比较。

paras.en: How a 2,700-Year-Old Eclipse Reveals Earth's Faster Rotation
paras.zh: 2700 年前的日食如何揭示地球自转速度加快

paras.en: Earth does not rotate at a perfectly constant rate. Over long periods, its spin has gradually slowed, partly because of friction associated with ocean tides generated by the Moon's gravitational pull.
paras.zh: 地球并不以完全恒定的速度旋转。在很长一段时间内，它的自转速度逐渐减慢，部分原因是月球引力产生的海洋潮汐产生的摩擦力。

paras.en: Consequently, Earth rotated slightly faster 2,700 years ago than it does today.
paras.zh: 因此，2700 年前的地球自转速度比现在稍快一些。

paras.en: Using the revised position of ancient Qufu, the researchers obtained improved constraints on Earth's rotation during the period spanning the eighth through sixth centuries BCE.
paras.zh: 利用修正后的古曲阜位置，研究人员获得了公元前八世纪至六世纪期间对地球自转的改进约束。

paras.en: Their calculations placed delta T (ΔT), a measurement used to describe variations in Earth's rotation relative to a uniform time scale, between 20,264 and 21,204 seconds for the eclipse of 709 BCE.
paras.zh: 他们的计算将公元前 709 年日食的 delta T (ΔT)（一种用于描述地球自转相对于统一时间尺度的变化的测量值）置于 20,264 至 21,204 秒之间。

paras.en: "This new dataset fixes coordinate errors in previous Earth rotation studies. Additionally, it improves the accuracy of dating and reconstructing historical astronomical events," said coauthor Mitsuru Sôma of the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan.
paras.zh: 日本国家天文台的共同作者 Mitsuru Sôma 表示：“这个新数据集修复了之前地球自转研究中的坐标错误。此外，它还提高了约会和重建历史天文事件的准确性。”

paras.en: These measurements help scientists better understand changes in the length of Earth's day over thousands of years. They can also improve calculations of when and where other ancient astronomical events would have been visible.
paras.zh: 这些测量有助于科学家更好地了解数千年来地球一天长度的变化。它们还可以改进对其他古代天文事件可见的时间和地点的计算。

paras.en: Evidence That the Sun Was Awakening From a Long Quiet Period
paras.zh: 太阳从漫长的平静时期苏醒的证据

paras.en: Beyond revealing Earth's rotational history, the eclipse may provide evidence of an important transition in the Sun's activity.
paras.zh: 除了揭示地球的自转历史之外，日食还可能提供太阳活动重要转变的证据。

paras.en: Scientists have previously reconstructed ancient solar cycles by studying radiocarbon preserved in tree rings. The possible corona description from 709 BCE offers another way to examine those findings.
paras.zh: 科学家此前通过研究树木年轮中保存的放射性碳重建了古代太阳周期。公元前 709 年可能出现的日冕描述提供了另一种检验这些发现的方法。

paras.en: "This unique historical addendum for the possible solar coronal structure is critical for providing a spot reference on solar activity reconstructions from tree rings and ice cores, as well as providing independent validation of solar activity models," explained coauthor Mathew Owens, a professor of space physics at the University of Reading.
paras.zh: 共同作者、雷丁大学空间物理学教授马修·欧文斯解释说：“这一可能的太阳日冕结构的独特历史附录对于提供从树木年轮和冰芯重建太阳活动的现场参考以及提供太阳活动模型的独立验证至关重要。”

paras.en: Trees absorb carbon from the atmosphere during photosynthesis, including small amounts of radioactive carbon known as radiocarbon. Some of this material becomes locked into annual growth rings, creating a natural record that researchers can examine thousands of years later.
paras.zh: 树木在光合作用过程中从大气中吸收碳，包括少量的放射性碳，称为放射性碳。其中一些材料被锁定在年轮中，创造了研究人员可以在数千年后检查的自然记录。

paras.en: Radiocarbon levels are influenced by cosmic rays reaching Earth's atmosphere. When the Sun becomes more active, its magnetic influence generally reduces the number of cosmic rays that reach Earth, affecting radiocarbon production.
paras.zh: 放射性碳水平受到到达地球大气层的宇宙射线的影响。当太阳变得更加活跃时，其磁力影响通常会减少到达地球的宇宙射线数量，从而影响放射性碳的产生。

paras.en: By measuring changes in radiocarbon concentrations across successive tree rings, scientists can reconstruct how solar activity varied long before modern instruments existed.
paras.zh: 通过测量连续树木年轮中放射性碳浓度的变化，科学家们可以重建早在现代仪器出现之前太阳活动是如何变化的。

paras.en: The Sun normally follows an activity cycle lasting approximately 11 years, during which the number of sunspots and the strength of solar magnetic activity rise and fall.
paras.zh: 太阳通常遵循一个持续约 11 年的活动周期，在此期间太阳黑子的数量和太阳磁活动的强度会升降。

paras.en: Occasionally, however, the Sun enters much longer periods of reduced activity called "grand minima." During these intervals, sunspots become exceptionally rare, and the usual cycle is much less pronounced.
paras.zh: 然而，有时太阳会进入更长的活动减少时期，称为“极小期”。在这些间隔期间，太阳黑子变得异常罕见，并且通常的周期也不太明显。

paras.en: One such interval, known as the "Neo Assyrian Grand Minimum" or "Homer Grand Minimum," lasted from approximately 808 to 717 BCE.
paras.zh: 其中一个时期被称为“新亚述大极小期”或“荷马大极小期”，持续时间大约为公元前 808 年至 717 年。

paras.en: The eclipse of 709 BCE took place shortly after this prolonged quiet period ended.
paras.zh: 公元前 709 年的日食发生在这段漫长的平静期结束后不久。

paras.en: According to the researchers, the possible description of the solar corona is consistent with a Sun that had resumed its regular activity cycles. Its apparent structure suggests substantial magnetic activity and indicates that the Sun may have been near the peak of its approximately 11-year cycle at the time.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，对日冕的可能描述与太阳已经恢复正常活动周期是一致的。其明显的结构表明存在大量的磁活动，并表明太阳当时可能已接近其大约 11 年周期的峰值。

paras.en: This interpretation agrees with earlier solar activity reconstructions derived from radiocarbon measurements in tree rings, although the uncertainty surrounding the historical corona description means it cannot be considered definitive proof.
paras.zh: 这种解释与早期根据树木年轮放射性碳测量得出的太阳活动重建一致，尽管历史日冕描述的不确定性意味着它不能被视为明确的证据。

paras.en: Ancient Astronomers Are Still Helping Scientists Understand the Universe
paras.zh: 古代天文学家仍在帮助科学家了解宇宙

paras.en: The findings demonstrate how observations preserved for thousands of years can continue to contribute to modern scientific discoveries.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，保存了数千年的观测结果如何能够继续为现代科学发现做出贡献。

paras.en: By bringing together historical documents, archaeological evidence, geographic research, and sophisticated astronomical models, scientists can recover information that would otherwise be impossible to measure directly.
paras.zh: 通过汇集历史文献、考古证据、地理研究和复杂的天文模型，科学家可以恢复原本无法直接测量的信息。

paras.en: In this case, a correction of just eight kilometers helped transform an ancient eclipse record into a more precise source of information about Earth's rotation and a potential window into the Sun's distant past.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，仅仅八公里的修正就帮助将古老的日食记录转变为有关地球自转的更精确的信息来源，并成为了解太阳遥远过去的潜在窗口。

paras.en: "Some of our ancestors were very skilled observers," noted coauthor Dr. Meng Jin of the Lockheed Martin Solar and Astrophysics Laboratory. "When we combine their careful records with modern computational methods and historical evidence, we can potentially find new information about our planet and our star from thousands of years ago."
paras.zh: “我们的一些祖先是非常熟练的观察者，”洛克希德·马丁公司太阳能和天体物理实验室的共同作者孟金博士指出。 “当我们将他们的仔细记录与现代计算方法和历史证据结合起来时，我们有可能找到数千年前关于我们的星球和恒星的新信息。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Nagoya University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由名古屋大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Exercise doesn't just strengthen your heart. It rewires it

paras.en: Exercise doesn't just strengthen your heart. It rewires it
paras.zh: 锻炼不仅可以增强心脏功能。它重新布线

paras.en: - Regular exercise does more than strengthen the heart. New research reveals that it actually reshapes the nerves controlling how the heart functions, and the changes are surprisingly different on the left and right sides of the body.
paras.zh: - 定期锻炼不仅仅可以增强心脏功能。新的研究表明，它实际上重塑了控制心脏功能的神经，而且身体左右两侧的变化惊人地不同。

paras.en: Exercise does more than make the heart stronger. New research suggests it also physically reshapes the nerves that control the heart, revealing an unexpected difference between the left and right sides of the body.
paras.zh: 锻炼的作用不仅仅是使心脏更强健。新的研究表明，它还能在物理上重塑控制心脏的神经，揭示身体左右两侧之间意想不到的差异。

paras.en: Scientists at the University of Bristol (UK) discovered that moderate aerobic exercise changes the structure of nerve cells involved in regulating heart activity. Even more surprisingly, the changes were dramatically different on the two sides of the body. The findings, published in Autonomic Neuroscience, could eventually help doctors develop more precise treatments for irregular heartbeats, chest pain, angina, and stress-induced 'broken-heart' syndrome.
paras.zh: Scientists at the University of Bristol (UK) discovered that moderate aerobic exercise changes the structure of nerve cells involved in regulating heart activity.更令人惊讶的是，身体两侧的变化却截然不同。 The findings, published in Autonomic Neuroscience, could eventually help doctors develop more precise treatments for irregular heartbeats, chest pain, angina, and stress-induced 'broken-heart' syndrome.

paras.en: The discovery was made in rats, so further research is needed to determine whether the same changes occur in humans. Nevertheless, it offers a new perspective on how physical activity influences the nervous system that keeps the heart functioning.
paras.zh: 这一发现是在老鼠身上发现的，因此需要进一步的研究来确定人类是否也会发生同样的变化。尽管如此，它提供了关于身体活动如何影响维持心脏功能的神经系统的新视角。

paras.en: Exercise Changes the Heart's Hidden Control System
paras.zh: 运动改变心脏的隐藏控制系统

paras.en: The heart is regulated partly by the autonomic nervous system, a network of nerves that automatically manages essential functions such as heartbeat, breathing, and digestion. One branch of this system helps the heart beat faster when the body needs more oxygen, such as during exercise or stressful situations.
paras.zh: 心脏部分受到自主神经系统的调节，自主神经系统是一个自动管理心跳、呼吸和消化等基本功能的神经网络。当身体需要更多氧气时，例如在运动或有压力的情况下，该系统的一个分支可以帮助心跳加快。

paras.en: Small clusters of nerve cells called stellate ganglia play an important role in this process. Located on both sides of the lower neck and upper chest, these nerve hubs send signals that influence heart rate and other aspects of heart function.
paras.zh: 称为星状神经节的小神经细胞簇在此过程中发挥着重要作用。这些神经中枢位于下颈部和上胸部的两侧，发出影响心率和心脏功能其他方面的信号。

paras.en: The new research suggests that regular exercise changes these nerve clusters in ways scientists had not previously recognized.
paras.zh: 这项新研究表明，定期锻炼会以科学家之前未曾认识到的方式改变这些神经簇。

paras.en: Study lead author Dr. Augusto Coppi, Senior Lecturer in Veterinary Anatomy at the University of Bristol, said: "The discovery points to a previously hidden left-right pattern in the body's 'autopilot' system that helps run the heart.
paras.zh: 该研究的主要作者、布里斯托大学兽医解剖学高级讲师 Augusto Coppi 博士说：“这一发现指出了身体‘自动驾驶’系统中以前隐藏的左右模式，有助于心脏运转。

paras.en: "These nerve clusters act like the heart's dimmer switch and we've shown that regular, moderate exercise remodels that switch in a side-specific way. This could help explain why some treatments work better on one side than the other and, in future, help doctors target therapies more precisely and effectively."
paras.zh: “这些神经簇的作用就像心脏的调光开关，我们已经证明，定期、适度的运动可以以特定一侧的方式进行重塑。这可以帮助解释为什么某些治疗方法在一侧比另一侧效果更好，并且在未来帮助医生更准确、更有效地进行针对性治疗。”

paras.en: Just 10 Weeks of Exercise Produced Striking Nerve Changes
paras.zh: 仅仅 10 周的锻炼就产生了惊人的神经变化

paras.en: To investigate how exercise affects these nerve clusters, the researchers examined rats that underwent 10 weeks of moderate aerobic training. Aerobic exercise is physical activity that increases heart rate and breathing, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling.
paras.zh: 为了研究运动如何影响这些神经簇，研究人员检查了接受 10 周适度有氧训练的老鼠。有氧运动是增加心率和呼吸的身体活动，例如快走、游泳或骑自行车。

paras.en: The study involved researchers from University College London (UCL) in the UK, the University of São Paulo (USP), and the Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP) in Brazil.
paras.zh: 这项研究涉及来自英国伦敦大学学院 (UCL)、圣保罗大学 (USP) 和巴西圣保罗联邦大学 (UNIFESP) 的研究人员。

paras.en: The team used advanced three-dimensional analysis techniques known as stereology to examine the nerve cells. This approach allows scientists to estimate the number, size, and distribution of cells within tissues.
paras.zh: 该团队使用被称为体视学的先进三维分析技术来检查神经细胞。这种方法使科学家能够估计组织内细胞的数量、大小和分布。

paras.en: The results revealed an unusual imbalance between the two sides of the body. In the trained rats, the cardiovascular nerve cluster on the right contained roughly four times as many neurons as the cluster on the left, a striking difference from the pattern observed in untrained rats.
paras.zh: 结果显示身体两侧存在不寻常的不平衡。在经过训练的老鼠中，右侧心血管神经簇所含的神经元数量大约是左侧心血管神经簇的四倍，这与在未经训练的老鼠中观察到的模式存在显着差异。

paras.en: The nerve cells also changed in size, but in opposite directions. Neurons on the left nearly doubled in size, while those on the right became slightly smaller.
paras.zh: 神经细胞的大小也发生了变化，但方向相反。左侧的神经元大小几乎增加了一倍，而右侧的神经元则稍小一些。

paras.en: These findings suggest that exercise does not affect all the nerves controlling the heart equally. Instead, it produces distinct structural changes on each side, potentially providing clues about how the nervous system adapts to regular physical activity.
paras.zh: 这些发现表明，运动不会平等地影响控制心脏的所有神经。相反，它会在每一侧产生明显的结构变化，可能提供有关神经系统如何适应常规身体活动的线索。

paras.en: Could the Discovery Lead to Better Heart Treatments?
paras.zh: 这一发现能否带来更好的心脏治疗方法？

paras.en: The findings may have important implications for treating conditions involving abnormal nerve activity around the heart.
paras.zh: 这些发现可能对治疗涉及心脏周围神经活动异常的疾病具有重要意义。

paras.en: Arrhythmias occur when the heart beats too quickly, too slowly, or irregularly. Angina is chest pain or discomfort typically caused by insufficient blood flow to the heart muscle. Another condition, commonly called 'broken-heart' syndrome, involves a sudden weakening of the heart muscle that is often triggered by intense emotional or physical stress.
paras.zh: 当心脏跳动过快、过慢或不规则时，就会出现心律失常。心绞痛是一种胸痛或不适，通常是由于心肌供血不足引起的。另一种情况通常称为“心碎”综合症，涉及心肌突然衰弱，通常由强烈的情绪或身体压力引发。

paras.en: In some patients, doctors treat these problems by reducing excessive nerve signals reaching the heart. Procedures such as stellate ganglion nerve blocks temporarily interrupt nerve activity, while denervation involves disrupting certain nerve pathways.
paras.zh: 对于一些患者，医生通过减少到达心脏的过多神经信号来治疗这些问题。星状神经节神经阻滞等手术会暂时中断神经活动，而去神经术则涉及破坏某些神经通路。

paras.en: Understanding how the left and right nerve clusters differ could eventually help physicians determine which side should be targeted for the greatest benefit.
paras.zh: 了解左右神经簇的不同最终可以帮助医生确定应该针对哪一侧以获得最大的益处。

paras.en: Dr. Coppi explained: "Irregular heart rhythms, known as arrhythmias, stress-induced 'broken-heart' syndrome, and certain types of chest pain are often treated by dialing down overactive stellate ganglia -- the paired small nerve hubs in the lower neck/upper chest area that send 'go faster' signals to the heart.
paras.zh: 科皮博士解释说：“不规则的心律，即心律失常、压力引起的‘心碎’综合症和某些类型的胸痛，通常可以通过调低过度活跃的星状神经节来治疗。星状神经节是位于下颈部/上胸部区域的成对小神经中枢，向心脏发送‘走得更快’信号。

paras.en: "By mapping how exercise changes these ganglia on each side, the study offers clues that could one day fine-tune procedures like nerve blocks or denervation to the side most likely to help. The findings are early-stage and in rats, so clinical studies would need to follow."
paras.zh: “通过绘制运动如何改变两侧神经节的图谱，这项研究提供了一些线索，有一天可以对最有可能有帮助的一侧的神经阻滞或去神经术等程序进行微调。这些发现还处于早期阶段，并且是在大鼠身上进行的，因此需要进行临床研究。”

paras.en: What's Next for Exercise and Heart Research?
paras.zh: 运动和心脏研究的下一步是什么？

paras.en: Although the structural changes were substantial, scientists still need to establish exactly how they affect heart function.
paras.zh: 尽管结构变化很大，但科学家仍然需要确定它们如何影响心脏功能。

paras.en: The research team plans to investigate whether the differences between the left and right nerve clusters influence how the heart behaves during rest and physical activity. They also intend to look for similar patterns in other animal models and eventually in humans.
paras.zh: 研究小组计划调查左右神经簇之间的差异是否会影响心脏在休息和体力活动时的行为。他们还打算在其他动物模型中寻找类似的模式，并最终在人类中寻找类似的模式。

paras.en: For human studies, the researchers hope to use noninvasive markers, which could provide information about nerve activity without requiring surgery or tissue removal.
paras.zh: 对于人类研究，研究人员希望使用非侵入性标记物，它可以提供有关神经活动的信息，而无需手术或组织切除。

paras.en: If the same left-right differences are found in people, the discovery could help guide more personalized treatments for arrhythmias, difficult-to-treat angina, and stress-induced 'broken-heart' syndrome.
paras.zh: 如果在人身上也发现同样的左右差异，这一发现可能有助于指导对心律失常、难以治疗的心绞痛和压力引起的“心碎”综合症进行更个性化的治疗。

paras.en: Dr. Coppi added: "Understanding these left-right differences could help us personalize treatments for heart rhythm disorders and angina. Our next step is to test how these structural changes map onto function and whether similar patterns appear in larger animals and humans."
paras.zh: 科皮博士补充道：“了解这些左右差异可以帮助我们对心律失常和心绞痛进行个性化治疗。我们的下一步是测试这些结构变化如何映射到功能，以及类似的模式是否出现在大型动物和人类身上。”

articles.title: 'Donnie Darko' at 25: How a giant rabbit, time loops, and teen angst became a sci-fi cult classic
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: The term "cult classic" has been loosely bandied about in cinematic circles until its definition has diluted into nothingness, but never has it been more appropriately applied than to director Richard Kelly’s strange psychological sci-fi thriller, "Donnie Darko", which celebrates its milestone 25th birthday today.
paras.zh: “邪典经典”这个词在电影圈中一直被广泛使用，直到它的定义被淡化为虚无，但它最恰当的应用莫过于导演理查德·凯利的奇怪心理科幻惊悚片《唐尼·达科》，该片今天庆祝了其里程碑式的 25 岁生日。

paras.en: Starring Jake Gyllenhaal, Drew Barrymore, Mary McDonnell, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Patrick Swayze, Jena Malone, and Noah Wyle, "Donnie Darko" was released on Oct. 26, 2001, into an unstable world still shocked by the catastrophic Sept. 11 terrorist attacks less than two months earlier.
paras.zh: 由杰克·吉伦哈尔、德鲁·巴里摩尔、玛丽·麦克唐纳、玛吉·吉伦哈尔、帕特里克·斯威兹、吉娜·马龙和诺亚·怀尔主演的《唐尼·达科》于 2001 年 10 月 26 日上映，当时的世界仍因不到两个月前的 9 月 11 日灾难性恐怖袭击而感到震惊。

paras.en: The thrust of the narrative revolves around an alternative universe accidentally forming via a supernatural anomaly after a jet engine falls off a commercial airliner and crashes through the roof of a suburban Virginia home, landing in the bedroom of our troubled title character.
paras.zh: 故事的主线围绕着一个超自然异常意外形成的另一个宇宙，一架喷气发动机从一架商用客机上掉下来，坠毁在弗吉尼亚郊区一栋住宅的屋顶上，降落在我们陷入困境的主人公的卧室里。

paras.en: As the frightening phantom of Frank the Bunny warns, this parallel reality has a ticking clock that’ll result in its imminent collapse in just 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, and 12 seconds.
paras.zh: 正如兔子弗兰克的可怕幽灵所警告的那样，这个平行现实有一个滴答作响的时钟，它将在短短 28 天 6 小时 42 分 12 秒内导致其即将崩溃。

paras.en: From the haunting voice telling our heroic teen, "Wake up, Donnie," as the grandfather clock in the Darko residence ominously chimed midnight, to its exploration of the nature of mental illness, time travel paradoxes, fraudulent motivational speakers, teenage angst in the 1980s, and the logistics of interdimensional portals, "Donnie Darko" became an ideal parable for turbulent times.
paras.zh: 当达科住所的老钟在午夜不祥地敲响时，那令人难以忘怀的声音告诉我们英雄的青少年“醒醒吧，唐尼”，到它对精神疾病本质、时间旅行悖论、欺诈性励志演讲者、20世纪80年代青少年焦虑以及跨维度门户的后勤的探索，《唐尼·达科》成为动荡时代的理想寓言。

paras.en: But Kelly's post-modern sci-fi fantasy emerged on the big screen when there existed a pervading fear of gathering in large groups as America was just beginning to recover and process the atrocities committed on 9/11. Newmarket Films was perplexed on precisely how to market the movie, as it is such a unique combination of genres that forges something far greater than the sum of its parts.
paras.zh: 但凯利的后现代科幻幻想出现在大银幕上，当时美国刚刚开始恢复和处理 9/11 所犯下的暴行，人们普遍担心大规模聚集。纽马基特电影公司对如何营销这部电影感到困惑，因为它是如此独特的类型组合，所创造的东西远远大于各个部分的总和。

paras.en: Throughout that entire fall, "Donnie Darko" came and went in multiplexes with barely a whisper, pulling in just over $500K off of a meager $4.5 million budget. Years later, it would become a bona fide word-of-mouth sensation via several re-releases, home video editions, and further experiences in regularly sold-out midnight screenings on its way to earning cult status.
paras.zh: 整个秋天，《唐尼·达科》在多厅影院里悄无声息地进进出出，从微薄的 450 万美元预算中赚取了超过 50 万美元的收入。多年后，通过多次重新发行、家庭视频版本以及在经常售罄的午夜放映中的进一步体验，它成为真正的口碑轰动，从而赢得了邪教地位。

paras.en: It's a deeply personal film that will affect any viewer who allows its meticulously slow build to seduce them into its dreamlike sphere. Much has been debated and discussed about its many metaphors and symbolism, which employed elements of a splintered universe long before the multiverse was hijacked by Hollywood superhero spectacles. It’s a raw meditation on death more than anything, and its labyrinth of quantum entanglements feeds our existential core.
paras.zh: 这是一部非常个人化的电影，它会影响任何一个愿意让其精心缓慢的构建引诱他们进入梦幻般领域的观众。关于它的许多隐喻和象征意义已经引起了很多争论和讨论，早在多元宇宙被好莱坞超级英雄奇观劫持之前，它们就使用了分裂宇宙的元素。这是对死亡的原始冥想，而不是任何东西，它的量子纠缠迷宫滋养了我们存在的核心。

paras.en: "I remember pulling over to the side of the road to finish reading Richard's script and being mesmerized," Gyllenhaal told The Guardian. "It was clearly influenced by classic directors—Ron Howard, Steven Spielberg—but with this strange psychosis. It beautifully captured the experience of moving into adulthood: the world that felt so solid becoming movable and liquid. I thought, “This is what my adolescence felt like,” although I don’t speak, and have never spoken to, rabbits."
paras.zh: “我记得把车停在路边读完理查德的剧本，我被迷住了，”吉伦哈尔告诉《卫报》。 “它显然受到了经典导演——朗·霍华德、史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格——的影响，但带有一种奇怪的精神病。它完美地捕捉到了进入成年期的经历：感觉如此坚实的世界变得可移动和流动。我想，“这就是我青春期的感觉，”尽管我不会说话，也从未和兔子说过话。”

paras.en: Kelly was just 23 years old when he penned the "Donnie Darko" screenplay in only 28 days based on his own adolescence growing up in Virginia during the ‘80s. Coincidentally, that is the exact number of days Frank the Bunny declares will mark the end of the world, and it is also the same amount of time taken to complete the Southern California production shoot in 2000.
paras.zh: 凯利仅用 28 天就根据自己 80 年代在弗吉尼亚长大的青春期写出了《唐尼·达科》的剧本，当时他只有 23 岁。巧合的是，这正是弗兰克兔子宣布的世界末日的确切天数，也与完成 2000 年南加州拍摄所需的时间相同。

paras.en: Layered with ‘80s pop anthems like Echo & the Bunnymen's "The Killing Moon," Tears for Fears' "Head Over Heels," The Church's "Under the Milky Way," and Gary Jules' melancholy cover of Tears for Fears' "Mad World," Kelly's mysterious coming-of-age masterpiece still offers up a lucid nightmare tinged with a touch of consuming dread that lingers long after any screening.
paras.zh: 凯利这部神秘的成长杰作中夹杂着 80 年代的流行歌曲，如 Echo & the Bunnymen 的《The Killing Moon》、Tears for Fears 的《Head Over Heels》、The Church 的《Under the Milky Way》以及 Gary Jules 忧郁翻唱的 Tears for Fears 的《Mad World》。任何筛查。

paras.en: Kelly did release a director's cut in 2004 that adds extra footage and alters the soundtrack, but we recommend the original theatrical cut for the purist’s version of this classic!
paras.zh: 凯利确实在 2004 年发布了导演剪辑版，添加了额外的镜头并改变了配乐，但我们推荐这部经典的纯粹主义版本的原始戏剧剪辑版！

paras.en: Considering today’s political strife, climate change concerns, AI paranoia, pharmaceutical overlords, and alienated youth culture, "Donnie Darko" and its 1988 election year setting still seems to have its finger on the zeitgeist's pulse, continuing to present provocative questions.
paras.zh: 考虑到当今的政治冲突、气候变化问题、人工智能偏执、制药霸主和疏远的青年文化，《唐尼·达科》及其 1988 年选举年的背景似乎仍然抓住了时代精神的脉搏，继续提出挑衅性的问题。

paras.en: This Halloween, check out "Donnie Darko's" mind-warping weirdness on this 25th anniversary occasion and let no one ever question your commitment to Sparkle Motion ever again!
paras.zh: 这个万圣节，在这个 25 周年纪念日上看看“Donnie Darko”令人心智扭曲的怪异行为，让任何人都不再质疑您对 Sparkle Motion 的承诺！

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: NASA ends Swift space telescope mission after failed rescue attempt
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: NASA has officially ended the mission of its Swift space telescope, after a private satellite failed in its bold bid to rescue the aging spacecraft.
paras.zh: 在一颗私人卫星拯救老化航天器的大胆尝试失败后，美国宇航局正式结束了雨燕太空望远镜的任务。

paras.en: That rescue mission was led by the Arizona company Katalyst Space Technologies, whose LINK spacecraft tried to meet up with Swift this summer to boost its orbit.
paras.zh: 这次救援任务是由亚利桑那州 Katalyst Space Technologies 公司领导的，该公司的 LINK 航天器今年夏天试图与 Swift 会合以提升其轨道。

paras.en: That didn't work out, however, so Swift continues its fall back toward Earth. The telescope is expected to reenter Earth's atmosphere "in the next few weeks," NASA said in a statement on Friday (Oct. 23).
paras.zh: 然而，这并没有成功，所以斯威夫特继续向地球坠落。 NASA 在周五（10 月 23 日）的一份声明中表示，该望远镜预计将在“未来几周内”重新进入地球大气层。

paras.en: That statement served primarily to announce the end of the Swift mission after more than 20 very productive years.
paras.zh: 该声明主要是为了宣布 Swift 任务在 20 多年的卓有成效之后结束。

paras.en: The telescope launched to Earth orbit in November 2004, tasked with studying gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) — the most powerful explosions in the cosmos. Swift was designed to operate for two years, but it continued studying the high-energy universe for more than two decades.
paras.zh: 该望远镜于 2004 年 11 月发射到地球轨道，任务是研究伽马射线爆发（GRB）——宇宙中最强大的爆炸。斯威夫特的设计运行时间为两年，但它对高能宇宙的研究持续了二十多年。

paras.en: "In that time, Swift played a major role in advancing our understanding of the changing universe and was part of a revolution in astrophysics that showed how critical rapid-response observations are to the entire community," Shawn Domagal-Goldman, director of the Astrophysics Division at NASA Headquarters in Washington, said in the statement.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部天体物理学部主任肖恩·多马加尔-戈德曼在声明中表示：“当时，斯威夫特在增进我们对不断变化的宇宙的理解方面发挥了重要作用，并且是天体物理学革命的一部分，这场革命表明快速响应观测对整个社区有多么重要。”

paras.en: NASA had hoped to keep Swift going even longer. In September 2025, the agency awarded a contract to the Arizona company Katalyst Space Technologies to rescue the observatory, which was falling back to Earth thanks to atmospheric drag.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局曾希望让斯威夫特继续运行得更久。 2025 年 9 月，该机构向亚利桑那州 Katalyst Space Technologies 公司授予了一份合同，以营救该天文台，该天文台因大气阻力而落回地球。

paras.en: Swift has no thrusters capable of counteracting this drag. So Katalyst built a refrigerator-sized spacecraft called LINK, which aimed to rendezvous with Swift, grapple it with three robotic arms and boost it to a higher orbit, allowing the observatory to continue its science work.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特没有能够抵消这种阻力的推进器。因此，Katalyst 建造了一艘名为 LINK 的冰箱大小的航天器，旨在与 Swift 会合，用三个机械臂抓住它，并将其提升到更高的轨道，使天文台能够继续其科学工作。

paras.en: NASA and Katalyst stressed from the start that success was far from guaranteed. After all, LINK's mission was unprecedented: No private spacecraft had ever captured and boosted a satellite that wasn't designed to be serviced in this way. And the rate of Swift's orbital decay demanded a rapid timeline: LINK launched on July 3, a little over nine months after Katalyst won the $30 million NASA Swift-rescue contract.
paras.zh: NASA 和 Katalyst 从一开始就强调，成功还远未得到保证。毕竟，LINK 的任务是史无前例的：没有任何私人航天器捕获并升压过不是为以这种方式提供服务而设计的卫星。 Swift 的轨道衰变速度需要一个快速的时间表：LINK 于 7 月 3 日发射，距离 Katalyst 赢得 NASA 价值 3000 万美元的 Swift 救援合同仅九个多月。

paras.en: LINK was not able to execute its very challenging mission. About three weeks after liftoff, it suffered problems with its propulsion system and orientation-maintaining reaction wheels, which caused it to start spinning at an unexpected rate. These issues prevented LINK from capturing and boosting Swift, but the private craft did manage to get within 7.5 to 9.3 miles (12 to 15 kilometers) of the observatory and photograph it.
paras.zh: LINK 无法执行其极具挑战性的任务。升空大约三周后，它的推进系统和保持方向的反作用轮出现问题，导致它开始以意想不到的速度旋转。这些问题导致 LINK 无法捕获并助推雨燕，但私人飞船确实设法进入距离天文台 7.5 至 9.3 英里（12 至 15 公里）的范围并对其进行拍摄。

paras.en: "From the beginning, this was a high-risk, high-reward mission," Domagal-Goldman said in a statement on Sept. 25, the day that LINK fell back to Earth.
paras.zh: “从一开始，这就是一项高风险、高回报的任务，”多马加尔-戈德曼在 9 月 25 日（LINK 坠落到地球的那一天）的一份声明中说道。

paras.en: "And while we'll be sad to see Swift's mission come to a close, we knew this boost effort would be worthwhile either way — advancing U.S. spacecraft servicing technology, challenging us to meet unprecedented mission timelines, and testing how we operate satellites to extend their time in low Earth orbit," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充道：“虽然看到雨燕号的任务结束我们会感到难过，但我们知道无论怎样，这种推进努力都是值得的——推进美国航天器维修技术，挑战我们满足前所未有的任务时间表，并测试我们如何操作卫星以延长它们在近地轨道的时间。”

paras.en: Swift — which was officially renamed the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory in 2018, after its first principal investigator, who died a year earlier — gathered its last scientific data on Oct. 20, according to NASA's Friday update.
paras.zh: 根据 NASA 周五发布的最新消息，Swift 于 10 月 20 日收集了最后的科学数据，该天文台于 2018 年正式更名为 Neil Gehrels Swift 天文台，因其第一位首席研究员一年前去世。

paras.en: During its long and storied career, the space telescope observed more than 2,000 GRBs. And it did other work, too, studying more than 1,400 supernova explosions, as well as eyeing asteroids, comets and black holes and conducting an all-sky survey in X-ray light. The mission's data has contributed to about 7,000 published scientific papers to date, according to NASA officials.
paras.zh: 在其漫长而传奇的职业生涯中，这台太空望远镜观测到了 2000 多个伽玛暴。它还做了其他工作，研究了 1,400 多次超新星爆炸，观察小行星、彗星和黑洞，并利用 X 射线进行全天空调查。据 NASA 官员称，迄今为止，该任务的数据已为约 7,000 篇已发表的科学论文做出了贡献。

paras.en: And that number is sure to keep rising far into the future.
paras.zh: 而且这个数字在未来肯定会继续上升。

paras.en: "Swift leaves us with an extraordinary archive of multiwavelength observations that will fuel new discoveries for decades more," Domagal-Goldman said in the Oct. 23 statement.
paras.zh: 多马加尔-戈德曼在 10 月 23 日的声明中表示：“斯威夫特为我们留下了非凡的多波长观测档案，这将为未来几十年的新发现提供动力。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Agile Space Industries Expands to Seattle Area with New Bellevue Office
articles.author: Agile Space Industries

paras.en: BELLEVUE, Wash., Oct. 15, 2026 — Agile Space Industries, a leading provider of in-space chemical propulsion solutions, has expanded into the Seattle metropolitan area with the opening of a new office in Bellevue, Washington. The expansion builds on Agile’s continued growth, extending its engineering capabilities and strengthening its presence in one of the nation’s most established aerospace and technology markets.
paras.zh: 华盛顿州贝尔维尤，2026 年 10 月 15 日 — 领先的太空化学推进解决方案提供商 Agile Space Industries 已将业务扩展到西雅图大都市区，在华盛顿州贝尔维尤开设了新办事处。此次扩张建立在敏捷公司持续增长的基础上，扩大了其工程能力，并加强了其在美国最成熟的航空航天和技术市场之一的影响力。

paras.en: Located at Sunset North in Bellevue, the new 5,470-square-foot office will initially accommodate 7 employees, with the capacity to grow to approximately 30 as Agile expands its regional operations. Agile Chief Technology Officer Jake Mills will be based at the Bellevue office, reinforcing the company’s commitment to establishing a strong engineering and leadership presence in the region.
paras.zh: 位于贝尔维尤 Sunset North 的新办公室占地 5,470 平方英尺，最初可容纳 7 名员工，随着 Agile 扩大其区域业务，其容量将增至约 30 名员工。 Agile 首席技术官 Jake Mills 将常驻贝尔维尤办事处，强化公司在该地区建立强大的工程和领导力的承诺。

paras.en: “Seattle has a remarkable concentration of aerospace talent, innovative companies and organizations advancing the space industry,” said Jake Mills, chief technology officer at Agile Space Industries. “Establishing a presence here allows us to tap into that expertise, strengthen industry relationships and build on the capabilities we’re developing across Agile to support our customers and their missions.”
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 首席技术官杰克·米尔斯 (Jake Mills) 表示：“西雅图集中了航空航天人才、推动航天工业发展的创新公司和组织。” “在这里建立业务使我们能够利用这些专业知识，加强行业关系，并利用我们在敏捷开发中的能力来支持我们的客户及其使命。”

paras.en: The Bellevue office will focus on engineering and program management, supporting the development and delivery of advanced propulsion systems for government and commercial space missions. As the team grows, Agile expects to broaden its technical expertise and support an expanding range of propulsion programs.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尤办事处将专注于工程和项目管理，支持政府和商业太空任务的先进推进系统的开发和交付。随着团队的成长，Agile 希望扩大其技术专业知识并支持不断扩大的推进项目。

paras.en: Beyond its engineering talent, the Seattle region offers an established network of aerospace companies, industry partners and investors. Agile’s presence in this ecosystem creates opportunities to strengthen customer relationships, develop new partnerships and engage with the broader business and investment community as the company pursues its long-term growth objectives.
paras.zh: 除了工程人才之外，西雅图地区还拥有成熟的航空航天公司、行业合作伙伴和投资者网络。在公司追求其长期增长目标的过程中，敏捷在这个生态系统中的存在创造了加强客户关系、发展新的合作伙伴关系以及与更广泛的商业和投资社区互动的机会。

paras.en: The expansion also creates opportunities for experienced aerospace professionals looking to work on complex propulsion challenges in a collaborative, hands-on engineering environment. Agile’s teams contribute to programs spanning early development through qualified flight hardware, with the opportunity to help shape technologies supporting the next generation of space missions.
paras.zh: 此次扩建还为经验丰富的航空航天专业人士创造了机会，让他们能够在协作的实践工程环境中应对复杂的推进挑战。 Agile 的团队通过合格的飞行硬件为早期开发项目做出贡献，并有机会帮助塑造支持下一代太空任务的技术。

paras.en: The Bellevue office joins Agile’s headquarters in Durango, Colorado, and operations in Pennsylvania and Oklahoma. Together, these locations support Agile’s growing capabilities in propulsion design, manufacturing and testing, positioning the company to serve an expanding range of commercial and government space customers.
paras.zh: 贝尔维尤办事处与敏捷公司位于科罗拉多州杜兰戈的总部以及宾夕法尼亚州和俄克拉荷马州的业务部门一起成立。这些地点共同支持敏捷在推进设计、制造和测试方面不断增长的能力，使该公司能够为不断扩大的商业和政府航天客户提供服务。

paras.en: Agile Space Industries develops advanced chemical propulsion solutions that enable spacecraft to move, maneuver, and operate in space. From early concepts to qualified flight hardware, Agile brings together propulsion expertise, additive manufacturing, and in-house testing to rapidly solve complex challenges and accelerate development. Agile partners with leading aerospace companies and the U.S. Government on spacecraft and launch vehicle programs. Learn more at agilespaceindustries.com.
paras.zh: Agile Space Industries 开发先进的化学推进解决方案，使航天器能够在太空中移动、机动和运行。从早期概念到合格的飞行硬件，敏捷汇集了推进专业知识、增材制造和内部测试，以快速解决复杂的挑战并加速开发。 Agile 与领先的航空航天公司和美国政府就航天器和运载火箭项目开展合作。请访问agilespaceindustries.com 了解更多信息。

articles.title: How NASA is thinking about a moon base
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with NASA’s Shatel Bhakta, the principal systems engineer for Moon Base, about what’s needed between now and 2028 and the incremental steps to the future.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 NASA 月球基地首席系统工程师 Shatel Bhakta 讨论了从现在到 2028 年的需求以及未来的渐进步骤。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.

articles.title: Astranis Upgrades Falcon 9 Launch Contract to Dedicated Mission for Entire Block 4 Production Run of Satellites
articles.author: Astranis

paras.en: SAN FRANCISCO —October 26, 2026—Today, Astranis announced it has upgraded its 4th launch to a dedicated mission aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket set to launch in 2028, allowing it to carry all of the “Block 4” production run of Astranis MicroGEO satellites.
paras.zh: 旧金山 — 2026 年 10 月 26 日 — 今天，Astranis 宣布已将其第四次发射升级为由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭执行的专用任务，该火箭定于 2028 年发射，使其能够运载 Astranis MicroGEO 卫星的所有“Block 4”生产运行。

paras.en: The mission will carry six MicroGEO satellites, placed directly into GEO via direct-inject using an Impulse Helios upper stage. These new satellites expand Astranis’ capacity to serve commercial and government customers around the world. The launch will bring Astranis’ total fleet size to 16, adding to the 10 satellites built across Blocks 1, 2, and 3. Astranis has already signed a number of initial customers for Block 4, to be announced at a later date. This is an amendment to an initial contract Astranis signed with SpaceX in late 2024 that gives Astranis the full payload capacity on the mission.
paras.zh: 该任务将携带六颗 MicroGEO 卫星，使用 Impulse Helios 上级通过直接注入直接放入 GEO。这些新卫星扩大了 Astranis 为全球商业和政府客户提供服务的能力。这次发射将使 Astranis 的总卫星规模达到 16 颗，在 Block 1、2 和 3 中建造的 10 颗卫星中又增加了。Astranis 已经签署了 Block 4 的一些初始客户，具体信息将在稍后公布。这是对 Astranis 于 2024 年底与 SpaceX 签署的初始合同的修订，该合同赋予 Astranis 任务中的全部有效载荷能力。

paras.en: Securing launches for multi-satellite blocks is a core benefit of Astranis’ responsive business model and provides the capacity needed to support the increased demand for dedicated space infrastructure.
paras.zh: 确保多卫星块的发射是 Astranis 响应式业务模式的核心优势，并提供支持专用空间基础设施不断增长的需求所需的容量。

paras.en: Governments and enterprises around the world are increasingly seeking dedicated space infrastructure for communications and other missions such as space domain awareness that they can fully control, rather than relying on shared capacity. Higher orbits like GEO are uniquely suited for this requirement.
paras.zh: 世界各地的政府和企业越来越多地寻求用于通信和其他任务的专用空间基础设施，例如他们可以完全控制的空间域意识，而不是依赖共享能力。像 GEO 这样的更高轨道非常适合这一要求。

paras.en: “We’ve only just begun to ramp up production to meet the demand we are seeing for commercial and national security missions,” said John Gedmark, CEO and co-founder of Astranis. “This launch means we can accelerate the critical infrastructure we’re building for customers in GEO and other higher orbits.”
paras.zh: Astranis 首席执行官兼联合创始人约翰·格德马克 (John Gedmark) 表示：“我们才刚刚开始提高产量，以满足商业和国家安全任务的需求。” “这次发射意味着我们可以加速为 GEO 和其他更高轨道的客户构建的关键基础设施。”

paras.en: This contract marks another step in Astranis’ continued expansion of high-orbit infrastructure and follows the recent introduction of Perceptor, which extends the company’s reach beyond communications into space domain awareness and maneuverability for commercial and national security missions. Astranis first proved that high-performance GEO satellites could be built faster and at scale. The company is now developing broader high-orbit platforms to connect, safeguard, and sustain critical infrastructure in GEO.
paras.zh: 该合同标志着 Astranis 持续扩展高轨道基础设施的又一步，之前推出了 Perceptor，将公司的业务范围从通信扩展到商业和国家安全任务的空间域感知和机动性。 Astranis 首先证明了高性能 GEO 卫星可以更快、更大规模地建造。该公司目前正在开发更广泛的高轨道平台，以连接、保护和维持地球静止轨道的关键基础设施。

paras.en: Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe — large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.
paras.zh: Astranis 为高轨道建造先进的卫星，将人类的触角扩展到太阳系。如今，Atranis 卫星为全球高度复杂的客户（大型企业、主权政府和美国军方）提供专用、安全的网络。

paras.en: With multiple satellites now on orbit serving customers around the world, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.
paras.zh: 目前，该公司有多颗卫星在轨运行，为世界各地的客户提供服务，并正在为积压的超过 10 亿美元的商业合同提供服务。 Astranis 是对正常运行时间、数据安全、网络可见性和定制有严格要求的买家的首选卫星通信合作伙伴。

paras.en: Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.
paras.zh: Astranis 已从安德森霍洛维茨 (Andreessen Horowitz)、贝莱德 (BlackRock)、富达 (Fidelity)、富兰克林邓普顿 (Franklin Templeton) 和 Snowpoint 等全球最佳投资者处筹集了超过 12 亿美元，并拥有一支由 500 名工程师和企业家组成的团队。 Astranis 在其位于美国北加州 153,000 平方英尺的总部设计、建造和运营其卫星。

articles.title: Ebola: UN officials condemn killing of nurse in DR Congo

paras.en: Ebola: UN officials condemn killing of nurse in DR Congo
paras.zh: 埃博拉：联合国官员谴责刚果民主共和国护士遇害事件

paras.en: The UN’s Ebola coordinator and the head of the World Health Organization (WHO) have deplored the killing of a nurse working to halt the spread of the disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).
paras.zh: 联合国埃博拉协调员和世界卫生组织（WHO）负责人对刚果民主共和国（DRC）一名致力于阻止埃博拉病毒传播的护士被杀表示遗憾。

paras.en: The nurse was killed by protesters in Bafwasende, a rural town in Tshopo province, on Saturday while responding to an Ebola alert.
paras.zh: 周六，这名护士在乔波省乡村小镇巴夫瓦森德响应埃博拉警报时被抗议者杀害。

paras.en: A health worker was also severely injured in the attack and remains in hospital.
paras.zh: 一名卫生工作者也在袭击中受重伤，目前仍在医院接受治疗。

paras.en: Julien Harneis, UN Senior Ebola Response Coordinator, issued a statement extending condolences to the nurse’s family and colleagues.
paras.zh: 联合国埃博拉应对高级协调员朱利安·哈尼斯发表声明，向这名护士的家人和同事表示哀悼。

paras.en: “I strongly condemn this attack and call for a thorough investigation,” he said. “I urge communities to protect health workers and allow them to carry out their work safely”.
paras.zh: 他说：“我强烈谴责这次袭击，并呼吁进行彻底调查。” “我敦促社区保护卫生工作者，让他们安全地开展工作”。

paras.en: The WHO Director-General, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, expressed his condolences in a post on social media. He also wished a swift and full recovery to the injured health worker.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞在社交媒体上发帖表达哀悼。他还祝愿受伤的卫生工作者迅速全面康复。

paras.en: “Everyone working to protect communities from this deadly disease must be able to work in dignity and safety,” he wrote on X. “Healthcare must always be protected.”
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“每个致力于保护社区免受这种致命疾病侵害的人都必须能够有尊严和安全地工作。医疗保健必须始终受到保护。”

paras.en: The deadly incident occurred amid ongoing efforts to contain the spread of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus for which there currently is no approved vaccine.
paras.zh: 这起致命事件发生时，正在努力遏制由本迪布焦病毒引起的埃博拉疾病的传播，目前尚无批准的疫苗。

paras.en: More than 9,760 cases and some 4,727 deaths have been recorded in the DRC since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, according to recent WHO figures.
paras.zh: 根据世卫组织最新数据，自 5 月 15 日宣布疫情爆发以来，刚果民主共和国已记录超过 9,760 例病例，约 4,727 人死亡。

paras.en: The outbreak is the deadliest in the country’s history. It was first reported in the volatile eastern region and has now reached eight provinces: Bas-Uélé, Haut-Uélé, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud Ubangi, Tshopo and Nord-Ubangi.
paras.zh: 这次疫情是该国历史上最致命的一次。疫情首先在动荡的东部地区报告，现已蔓延到八个省份：下韦莱省、上韦莱省、伊图里省、北基伍省、南基伍省、南乌班吉省、乔波省和北乌班吉省。

paras.en: Uganda also confronted a smaller Ebola outbreak which was declared defeated in August, while France, Kenya and Nigeria have reported cases.
paras.zh: 乌干达还遭遇了规模较小的埃博拉疫情，并于八月宣布被击败，而法国、肯尼亚和尼日利亚也报告了病例。

paras.en: Nigeria confirmed its first case last week – a woman who had travelled from Uganda.
paras.zh: 尼日利亚上周确认了第一例病例——一名来自乌干达的女性。

paras.en: She and a contact, who is her husband, were medically evacuated to Switzerland on Monday morning, WHO said, explaining that both are Swiss citizens and that the patient is clinically stable.
paras.zh: 世卫组织表示，她和一名联系人（即她的丈夫）已于周一上午接受医疗疏散至瑞士，并解释说，两人都是瑞士公民，患者临床情况稳定。

paras.en: “The Nigerian medical team successfully managed her through the acute phase of the illness and stabilized her condition,” the WHO regional director for Africa, Dr. Mohamed Janabi, wrote on X.
paras.zh: 世卫组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比博士在 X 上写道：“尼日利亚医疗队成功地帮助她度过了疾病的急性期，并稳定了她的病情。”

paras.en: He congratulated the Nigerian Government, health workers, clinicians, emergency responders and all those involved in the response.
paras.zh: 他向尼日利亚政府、卫生工作者、临床医生、应急人员以及所有参与应对工作的人员表示祝贺。

paras.en: “This is a remarkable achievement and a testament to what Africa can accomplish when we work together,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是一项了不起的成就，证明了我们共同努力非洲可以取得的成就。”

paras.en: Dr. Janabi noted that the evacuation means Nigeria currently has no Ebola cases, “however, vigilance remains critical”.
paras.zh: 贾纳比博士指出，撤离意味着尼日利亚目前没有埃博拉病例，“但是，保持警惕仍然至关重要”。

paras.en: Nigeria will continue to monitor 52 contacts, he said, while Switzerland will assume responsibility for the patient’s continued care and follow-up of her husband.
paras.zh: 他说，尼日利亚将继续监测 52 名接触者，而瑞士将负责患者的持续护理和对其丈夫的随访。

articles.title: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation

paras.en: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation
paras.zh: 在埃及，古特雷斯警告伊朗与美国不要升级

paras.en: “I want to send a loud and clear message to the parties. We need maximum restraint and diplomatic solutions,” he said.
paras.zh: “我想向各方发出响亮而明确的信息。我们需要最大限度的克制和外交解决方案，”他说。

paras.en: “If the sabre-rattling we are witnessing now translates itself into a major escalation, the situation in the region can get out of control.”
paras.zh: “如果我们现在看到的武力威胁演变成局势的重大升级，该地区的局势可能会失控。”

paras.en: Moreover, navigational rights and freedoms must be fully restored in and around the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb Strait at the mouth of the Red Sea – critical maritime corridors for global trade.
paras.zh: 此外，必须全面恢复霍尔木兹海峡和红海口曼德海峡及其周边地区的航行权利和自由，这两个海峡是全球贸易的关键海上走廊。

paras.en: He commended Egypt for its mediation role in helping to create the conditions for dialogue between the sides.
paras.zh: 他赞扬埃及在帮助创造双方对话条件方面发挥的调解作用。

paras.en: The Secretary-General was speaking alongside Egypt’s Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty following meetings focused on this and other crises in the Middle East and Africa.
paras.zh: 在就这一危机以及中东和非洲的其他危机举行会议后，秘书长与埃及外交部长巴德尔·阿卜杜拉蒂一起发表了讲话。

paras.en: “Egypt is a pillar of multilateralism,” he said. “And at a time when divisions are deepening, it is critical to keep the channels of diplomacy open.”
paras.zh: “埃及是多边主义的支柱，”他说。 “在分歧加深之际，保持外交渠道畅通至关重要。”

paras.en: On Gaza, Mr. Guterres expressed profound appreciation for Egypt’s indispensable role, noting that the country has been central to mediation and humanitarian efforts since the beginning of the conflict.
paras.zh: 关于加沙，古特雷斯先生对埃及不可或缺的作用深表赞赏，并指出自冲突开始以来，该国一直是调解和人道主义努力的核心。

paras.en: He commended continued support in facilitating life-saving aid, medical evacuations and the work of humanitarian partners such as the Egyptian Red Crescent.
paras.zh: 他赞扬埃及红新月会等人道主义合作伙伴在促进救生援助、医疗后送和工作方面的持续支持。

paras.en: The Secretary-General called for Israeli restrictions on humanitarian assistance to be lifted and obstacles blocking implementation of the UN Security Council-endorsed comprehensive plan to end the Gaza conflict to be removed.
paras.zh: 秘书长呼吁以色列取消对人道主义援助的限制，并消除阻碍执行联合国安理会批准的结束加沙冲突全面计划的障碍。

paras.en: “Civilians must be protected and international law must be respected,” he said.
paras.zh: “平民必须受到保护，国际法必须得到尊重，”他说。

paras.en: The UN chief said he was also deeply alarmed by Israeli actions in the occupied West Bank, pointing to expanding settlements, “unrelenting” evictions, surging violence, assaults, and attacks against journalists and diplomats.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长表示，他还对以色列在被占领的约旦河西岸的行动深感震惊，并指出以色列不断扩大定居点、“无情”驱逐、暴力事件激增、袭击记者和外交官。

paras.en: “We are seeing an increasingly coercive environment with the spectre of ethnic cleansing looming ever larger. This must end,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们看到一个越来越具有胁迫性的环境，种族清洗的幽灵越来越大。这种情况必须结束，”他说。

paras.en: Moreover, there can be no durable peace in the Middle East without the realization of the legitimate rights of the Palestinian people to self-determination, he said, once again upholding the two-State solution.
paras.zh: 此外，如果巴勒斯坦人民不实现合法的自决权利，中东就不可能实现持久和平，他再次支持两国解决方案。

paras.en: The Secretary-General also addressed the war in Sudan. He said that “the fighting must stop”, adding that the country’s future “must belong to the Sudanese people through an inclusive pro-political process that preserves its unity, sovereignty, and territorial integrity”.
paras.zh: 秘书长还谈到了苏丹战争。他说，“战斗必须停止”，并补充说，该国的未来“必须通过包容性的亲政治进程，维护苏丹的统一、主权和领土完整，属于苏丹人民”。

paras.en: Regarding Libya, he said that “it is time to build on political momentum, unify institutions and pave the way for national elections, finally bringing the prolonged transition to an end.”
paras.zh: 关于利比亚，他表示，“现在是巩固政治势头、统一机构、为全国选举铺平道路、最终结束漫长过渡的时候了。”

paras.en: The UN chief leaves office at the end of the year and this marked his ninth visit to Egypt since being appointed in 2017.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长将于今年年底卸任，这是他自 2017 年被任命以来第九次访问埃及。

paras.en: Mr. Guterres began his remarks by explaining that he has come back repeatedly “because when this region and our world have faced some of the most difficult moments, Egypt has consistently worked to open space for diplomacy”.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯先生在讲话开始时解释说，他多次回来“是因为当这个地区和我们的世界面临一些最困难的时刻时，埃及一直致力于为外交打开空间”。

articles.title: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians

paras.en: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians
paras.zh: 乌克兰：调查人员发现俄罗斯针对平民犯下战争罪

paras.en: Top human rights experts investigating Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine said on Monday that the Russian authorities had committed war crimes and crimes against humanity by attacking civilians and vital energy infrastructure, among other violations of international law.
paras.zh: 调查俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰的高级人权专家周一表示，俄罗斯当局袭击平民和重要能源基础设施等违反国际法的行为，犯下了战争罪和反人类罪。

paras.en: In its latest report, the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine, noted that attacks on power plants have intensified “once again” across Ukraine, where temperatures plunged to -21°C last winter.
paras.zh: 乌克兰问题独立国际调查委员会在其最新报告中指出，乌克兰各地对发电厂的袭击“再次”加剧，去年冬天乌克兰气温骤降至-21°C。

paras.en: “The scariest thing was to fall asleep and not to wake up; it was like torture to be scared of dying from cold,” said one 53-year-old man cited in the report, which reiterated the war’s serious negative impact on older people, too.
paras.zh: 报告中援引一名 53 岁男子的话说：“最可怕的是睡着了就醒不来；害怕冻死就像一种折磨。”报告还重申了战争对老年人的严重负面影响。

paras.en: “I lay cold and hungry, without medicine, without anything,” said a 74-year-old woman from Kyiv, who like many senior citizens is unable to use stairs and too afraid to use lifts, making it impossible to reach a safe place during air raid alerts.
paras.zh: “我又冷又饿，没有药物，什么也没有，”一位来自基辅的 74 岁妇女说。她和许多老年人一样，无法使用楼梯，也不敢使用电梯，因此在空袭警报期间无法到达安全地点。

paras.en: “This means that they must remain in unheated dwellings without electricity or water, with no access to life support devices or essential services,” the report’s authors insisted.
paras.zh: 该报告的作者坚称：“这意味着他们必须留在没有暖气、没有电或水的住宅中，无法获得生命支持设备或基本服务。”

paras.en: Russian commanders ordering the attacks knew full well that the heating facilities they were targeting “were indispensable to the civilian population, particularly during the winter”, the report notes.
paras.zh: 报告指出，下令发动袭击的俄罗斯指挥官非常清楚，他们所针对的供暖设施“对平民来说是不可或缺的，尤其是在冬天”。

paras.en: “Russian authorities have made official declarations concerning further attacks and referred to a plan to carry them out. The independent investigators concluded that they committed war crimes of intentionally directing attacks against civilian objects.”
paras.zh: “俄罗斯当局已就进一步袭击发表正式声明，并提到了实施这些袭击的计划。独立调查人员得出的结论是，他们犯下了故意针对民用物体进行袭击的战争罪。”

paras.en: The Commission was appointed by the UN Human Rights Council in March 2022, shortly after Russian troops entered Ukrainian territory.
paras.zh: 该委员会于 2022 年 3 月俄罗斯军队进入乌克兰领土后不久由联合国人权理事会任命。

paras.en: For its latest report, the three-person panel relied on the accounts of 255 persons who endured winter amid dire conditions in Dnipro, Kyiv, Kharkiv, Kherson, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Poltava, Zaporizhzhia and Zhytomyr oblasts, as well as Ukrainian authorities, medical doctors and non-governmental organisations.
paras.zh: 该三人小组的最新报告参考了第聂伯罗、基辅、哈尔科夫、赫尔松、尼古拉耶夫、敖德萨、波尔塔瓦、扎波罗热和日托米尔州 255 名在恶劣条件下度过冬季的人以及乌克兰当局、医生和非政府组织的叙述。

paras.en: The Commission also examined attacks by Ukrainian armed forces on energy infrastructure in Russia and in occupied areas of Ukraine. But the panel’s investigators – Erik Møse, Pablo de Greiff and Vrinda Grover – were unable to investigate the impact of these strikes in Russia as the authorities did not allow access or respond to requests for information.
paras.zh: 委员会还审查了乌克兰武装部队对俄罗斯和乌克兰被占领地区能源基础设施的袭击。但该小组的调查人员——埃里克·莫斯（Erik Møse）、巴勃罗·德·格雷夫（Pablo de Greiff）和弗林达·格罗弗（Vrinda Grover）——无法调查这些袭击对俄罗斯的影响，因为当局不允许访问或回应信息请求。

paras.en: The Commission also cited “compelling evidence” that the Russian authorities recruited men trafficked from 29 countries into the armed forces, in violation of international human rights law.
paras.zh: 委员会还引用了“令人信服的证据”，表明俄罗斯当局招募了来自 29 个国家的贩运人口加入武装部队，这违反了国际人权法。

paras.en: The new recruits have been deployed on the front lines in Ukraine “and assigned dangerous tasks. Many have been killed or have gone missing, others have surrendered or were captured by the Ukrainian armed forces, thereby acquiring the status of prisoners of war,” the report notes.
paras.zh: 报告指出，新兵被部署在乌克兰前线，“执行危险任务。许多人被杀或失踪，其他人投降或被乌克兰武装部队俘虏，从而获得战俘地位”。

paras.en: It highlights how the trafficking happened using “deception and coercion”, in coordination with agents operating in different countries; and how soon after arrival, the men were forced to sign contracts in Russian with the Ministry of Defence.
paras.zh: 它强调了人口贩运是如何通过与不同国家的特工协调“欺骗和胁迫”进行的；抵达后不久，这些人被迫用俄语与国防部签订合同。

paras.en: The report recounts the testimony of a 35-year-old woman, the wife of a man who was recruited from the Caribbean, who said: “They took his passport and just told him to sign here, here and here on the contract. It was only in Russian. He was totally pressured and had no choice.”
paras.zh: 报告援引了一名 35 岁妇女的证词，她是一名从加勒比海招募的男子的妻子，她说：“他们拿走了他的护照，只是告诉他在合同上在这里、这里和这里签字。只有俄语。他完全受到压力，别无选择。”

paras.en: It calls for all the trafficked persons to be discharged from the Russian armed forces.
paras.zh: 它呼吁所有被贩运者从俄罗斯武装部队中退役。

paras.en: The UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine is an independent body mandated by the UN Human Rights Council to investigate all alleged violations and abuses of human rights and violations of international humanitarian law, and related crimes in the context of the aggression against Ukraine by the Russian Federation. The Commission’s members are not UN staff nor are they paid for their work.
paras.zh: 联合国乌克兰问题独立国际调查委员会是联合国人权理事会授权的一个独立机构，负责调查俄罗斯联邦侵略乌克兰期间所有涉嫌侵犯和践踏人权、违反国际人道主义法的行为以及相关犯罪行为。该委员会的成员不是联合国工作人员，他们的工作也没有报酬。

articles.title: Fearnley retires injured to give Fery victory at Vienna Open

paras.en: Jacob Fearnley retires hurt against Arthur Fery at Vienna Open as Harriet Dart extends winning run
paras.zh: 雅各布·费恩利 (Jacob Fearnley) 在维也纳公开赛对阵阿瑟·费里 (Arthur Fery) 时受伤退赛，哈里特·达特 (Harriet Dart) 延续连胜纪录

paras.en: Arthur Fery is into the second round of the Vienna Open after fellow Brit Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury in the first set; Harriet Dart has won her third successive match at the Guangzhou Open; watch WTA and ATP Tours live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: 亚瑟·费里 (Arthur Fery) 进入维也纳公开赛第二轮，英国同胞雅各布·费恩利 (Jacob Fearnley) 在第一盘受伤退赛。哈丽雅特·达特 (Harriet Dart) 在广州公开赛上取得三连胜；观看天空体育直播 WTA 和 ATP 巡回赛

paras.en: Jacob Fearnley retired with an injury after losing 5-1 in the first set against Arthur Fery to give his fellow countryman a place in the second round at the Vienna Open.
paras.zh: 雅各布·费恩利 (Jacob Fearnley) 在首盘以 5-1 输给阿瑟·费里 (Arthur Fery) 后因伤退赛，为他的同胞赢得了维也纳公开赛第二轮的席位。

paras.en: Fearnley was broken by Fery in just his second service game, with the British No 1 winning the next two games on the bounce and looking set to consign his opponent to a comprehensive first-set loss.
paras.zh: 费恩利在他的第二个发球局中就被费里破发，这位英国头号选手在接下来的两局比赛中迅速获胜，并有望让对手在第一盘全面失利。

paras.en: Fearnley, though, then put a stop to the contest, shaking the umpire's hand and retiring with an unspecified injury, allowing Fery safe passage to the next stage of the competition.
paras.zh: 不过，费恩利随后终止了比赛，与裁判握手并因伤退场，费里的伤势不明，这让费里安全进入了比赛的下一阶段。

paras.en: - Boulter loses in Japan Open semis but will return to British No 1
paras.zh: - 博尔特在日本公开赛半决赛中失利，但将重返英国第一

paras.en: - Tennis scores, results and schedule from around the world
paras.zh: - 世界各地的网球比分、结果和赛程表

paras.en: - Download Sky Sports app for analysis, news, video and more
paras.zh: - 下载天空体育应用程序以获取分析、新闻、视频等

paras.en: Fery will face the winner of No 6 seed Francis Tiafoe and Lorenzo Musetti - the latter of whom he lost against in straight sets at the US Open - in the second round.
paras.zh: 费里将在第二轮面对六号种子弗朗西斯·蒂亚福和洛伦佐·穆塞蒂的冠军——后者在美国公开赛上直落两盘落败。

paras.en: Dart extends winning run in Guangzhou Open
paras.zh: 达特在广州公开赛延续连胜纪录

paras.en: Harriet Dart maintained her winning form at the Guangzhou Open in China as she beat Russian qualifier Tatiana Prozorova 6-4 2-6 6-2 to reach the second round.
paras.zh: 哈丽雅特·达特 (Harriet Dart) 在中国广州公开赛上继续保持胜利状态，以 6-4 2-6 6-2 击败俄罗斯资格赛选手塔蒂亚娜·普罗佐罗娃 (Tatiana Prozorova)，进入第二轮。

paras.en: Dart, who also came through two qualifiers, will next face Uzbekistan's Polina Kudermetova or Indonesia's Janice Tjen in the last 16 after winning a see-saw battle against world number 123 Prozorova.
paras.zh: 达特也通过了两场预选赛，在与世界排名第 123 名的普罗佐罗娃的拉锯战中获胜后，接下来将在 16 强赛中对阵乌兹别克斯坦选手波琳娜·库德梅托娃或印度尼西亚选手珍妮丝·詹恩。

paras.en: Both players struggled to hold serve, but the British number five broke three times in the decider to open up a 5-2 lead and served out to seal victory in two hours and 15 minutes.
paras.zh: 两位选手都难以保住发球局，但英国五号选手在决胜盘中三次破发，以5-2领先，并在2小时15分钟的发球局中锁定胜局。

paras.en: British teenager Mika Stojsavljevic slipped to a heavy first-round defeat at the Toray Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, losing 6-1 6-2 to Filipino world number 19 Alexandra Eala in one hour and 15 minutes.
paras.zh: 英国小将米卡·斯托伊萨夫列维奇(Mika Stojsavljevic)在东京举行的东丽泛太平洋公开赛首轮惨败，用时1小时15分钟以1-6、2-6不敌世界排名第19位的菲律宾选手亚历山德拉·伊拉(Alexandra Eala)。

paras.en: Stojsavljevic, 17, who won the girls' US Open singles title at the 2024 US Open, was broken twice in both sets by the world number 19 after being given a wildcard into the WTA 500 tournament.
paras.zh: 17岁的斯托伊萨夫列维奇在2024年美国公开赛上赢得了女子美国公开赛单打冠军，但在获得WTA 500赛事的外卡后，她在两盘比赛中都被世界排名第19的选手两次破发。
