paras.zh: 这个长篇介绍年利率对于大额余额（想想任何 5,000 美元以上的东西）特别方便。促销窗口越长，您每月需要支付的费用就越少，无需支付利息即可结清余额。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges no annual fee, so it costs nothing to keep in your wallet. For anyone building credit history -- or, like me, holding onto a top credit card for the long haul -- that's a real plus.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取年费，因此放在钱包中无需支付任何费用。对于任何建立信用记录的人来说——或者像我一样长期持有顶级信用卡——这是一个真正的优势。

paras.en: Keeping the card open can help your credit score by lengthening your average credit history over time.
paras.zh: 保持信用卡开放可以随着时间的推移延长您的平均信用记录，从而提高您的信用评分。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card includes cellphone protection when you pay your monthly phone bill with the card. It covers up to $600 per claim for theft or damage, with a $25 deductible, and you can file up to two claims per 12-month period.
paras.zh: 当您使用Wells Fargo Reflect ®卡支付每月电话账单时，该卡包含手机保护。每项盗窃或损坏索赔最多可赔偿600美元，免赔额为25美元，您每12个月最多可以提交两项索赔。

paras.en: I've never had to use cellphone insurance, but as a frequent phone-dropper and generally clumsy person, I've always loved having it in my back pocket.
paras.zh: 我从来没有使用过手机保险，但作为一个经常丢手机而且通常很笨拙的人，我一直喜欢把它放在我的后口袋里。

paras.en: We recommend comparing options to ensure the card you're selecting is the best fit for you. To make your search easier, here's a short list of standout credit cards.
paras.zh: 我们建议比较选项，以确保您选择的卡最适合您。为了让您的搜索更容易，这里列出了一些优秀的信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card earns no rewards. If you want a card with long-term perks like cash back or travel points, this isn't it.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不赚取任何奖励。如果您想要一张具有现金返还或旅行积分等长期福利的卡，那么这张卡不合适。

paras.en: A strong alternative is the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card (rates and fees), which earns a flat 2% cash rewards on purchases for a $0 annual fee. It's our Best Overall Credit Card of 2026, and a fan favorite for flat-rate rewards.
paras.zh: 一个强有力的替代方案是 Wells Fargo Active Cash® 卡（费率和费用），该卡以 0 美元年费购买即可获得 2% 的固定现金奖励。这是我们 2026 年最佳综合信用卡，也是粉丝最喜欢的统一费率奖励信用卡。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a balance transfer fee of 5%, min: $5 -- this is on the high side for a balance transfer card.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 5% 的余额转账费用，最低 5 美元——这对于余额转账卡来说偏高。

paras.en: If you move a $10,000 balance, you'd owe a $500 fee, even though you'd pay the balance off at 0% during the intro period.
paras.zh: 如果您转移 10,000 美元的余额，则需要支付 500 美元的费用，即使您在介绍期内以 0% 的利率还清余额。

paras.en: Run the math before you transfer, because the fee should cost less than the interest you'd otherwise pay. If you won't clear the balance within the 0% APR period, then an alternative balance transfer card with a lower transfer fee may serve you better.
paras.zh: 在转账之前先计算一下，因为费用应该低于您原本支付的利息。如果您无法在 0% 年利率期间清除余额，那么转账费用较低的替代余额转账卡可能会为您提供更好的服务。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee, so you'll pay extra on purchases made outside the U.S. If you travel abroad and want to skip that cost, consider one of our favorite travel credit cards.
paras.zh: Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡收取 3% 的国外交易费，因此您在美国境外购物时需要支付额外费用。如果您出国旅行并想跳过这笔费用，请考虑我们最喜欢的旅行信用卡之一。

paras.en: It also has no purchase protection or extended warranty on purchases.
paras.zh: 它也没有购买保护或延长购买保修。

paras.en: You'll generally need good to excellent credit (Motley Fool Money estimates this to be a FICO® Score of about 670 or higher) to qualify for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card. Wells Fargo doesn't publish an official cutoff, and applicants closer to 700 tend to be the best-qualified candidates.
paras.zh: 您通常需要良好到优秀的信用（Motley Fool Money 估计 FICO® 分数约为 670 或更高）才有资格获得 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡。富国银行没有公布官方截止日期，接近 700 名的申请者往往是最合格的候选人。

paras.en: Keep in mind, your score isn't the only factor. Wells Fargo also weighs your income, existing debt, and overall credit history. You can check for pre-selected offers on Wells Fargo's site without a hard inquiry to gauge your chances first.
paras.zh: 请记住，您的分数并不是唯一的因素。富国银行还会衡量您的收入、现有债务和整体信用记录。您可以在富国银行网站上查看预先选定的优惠，无需进行严格询问即可首先评估您的机会。

paras.en: The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card comes with a minimum credit limit of $1,000, and higher scores and income generally earn higher limits. Wells Fargo sets your limit individually based on your full credit profile, so two applicants can get very different lines of credit.
paras.zh: 富国银行Reflect ®卡的最低信用额度为$ 1,000 ，分数和收入越高，信用额度越高。富国银行根据您的完整信用档案单独设置您的限额，因此两位申请人可以获得非常不同的信用额度。

paras.en: Your starting limit isn't permanent, though. Once your account is open and in good standing, usually after six to 12 months, you can request an increase. Or, Wells Fargo may raise it automatically for on-time payments and low utilization.
paras.zh: 不过，您的起始限制并不是永久的。一旦您的账户开设且信誉良好，通常在 6 到 12 个月后，您就可以请求增加金额。或者，富国银行可能会因按时付款和利用率低而自动提高费用。

paras.en: To get the 0% intro APR for 21 months from account opening on qualifying balance transfers (then 17.74%, 24.24%, or 28.49% Variable APR), you must complete qualifying transfers within 120 days of opening your account.
paras.zh: 要在开户后 21 个月内通过合格余额转账获得 0% 初始年利率（然后是 17.74%、24.24% 或 28.49% 可变年利率），您必须在开户后 120 天内完成合格转账。

paras.en: I recommend starting the transfer online or by phone as soon as you're approved. Having your old account details ready speeds things up.
paras.zh: 我建议您在获得批准后立即开始在线或通过电话转移。准备好旧帐户详细信息可以加快速度。

paras.en: One important note: you can't transfer a balance from another Wells Fargo or affiliated card. Transfers have to come from a different issuer, and the 5%, min: $5 transfer fee applies to each one.
paras.zh: 一个重要的注意事项：您无法从另一张富国银行或附属卡转移余额。转账必须来自不同的发行人，并且每笔转账均需缴纳 5%（最低 5 美元）的转账费。

paras.en: Applying for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is quick. Here's what to do:
paras.zh: 申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡的速度很快。该怎么做：

paras.en: Approvals are usually instant, but can take a few days if Wells Fargo needs to verify some of your information.
paras.zh: 批准通常是即时的，但如果富国银行需要验证您的某些信息，则可能需要几天的时间。

paras.en: Yes, the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card is worth it if your priority is paying off debt or financing a large purchase without interest. Very few cards give you a long no-interest runway like this.
paras.zh: 是的，如果您的首要任务是偿还债务或为大额购买提供无息融资，那么 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡是值得的。很少有卡可以给你这样一条漫长的无息跑道。

paras.en: It's not worth it if you want rewards or perks after the intro period, since it offers neither.
paras.zh: 如果您在介绍期后想要奖励或福利，那么这是不值得的，因为它两者都没有提供。

paras.en: Ready to make a dent in your debt? Apply for the Wells Fargo Reflect® Card today -- awarded Motley Fool Money's Best 0% Intro APR Card of 2026.
paras.zh: 准备好减少债务了吗？立即申请 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡 - 荣获 Motley Fool Money 2026 年最佳 0% 年利率介绍卡。

paras.en: When the 0% intro APR period ends, any remaining balance starts accruing interest at your regular variable APR from that point forward. The Wells Fargo Reflect® Card doesn't charge deferred or retroactive interest, so you only pay on what's left -- not on the full original balance.
paras.zh: 当 0% 介绍年利率期结束时，任何剩余余额将开始按照您的常规可变年利率计息。 Wells Fargo Reflect® 卡不收取递延或追溯利息，因此您只需支付剩余金额，而不是全额原始余额。

paras.en: No, the 0% intro APR does not cover cash advances. Cash advances start accruing interest immediately at a separate, higher APR and come with their own fee. The intro offer only applies to purchases and qualifying balance transfers.
paras.zh: 不可以，0% 的年利率不包括现金预支。现金预支立即开始以单独的、较高的年利率计息，并收取自己的费用。介绍优惠仅适用于购买和符合条件的余额转账。

paras.en: Keeping the card open is usually the better move, even after your balance hits $0. If it has no annual fee, it costs nothing to hold, and the open account helps your credit score by supporting your total available credit and length of history.
paras.zh: 即使您的余额达到 0 美元，保持卡打开通常是更好的选择。如果它没有年费，那么持有它就不需要任何成本，并且开放账户通过支持您的总可用信用和历史长度来帮助您的信用评分。

articles.title: The most beautiful sections of China's Great Wall

paras.en: Editor’s Note: Monthly Ticket is a CNN Travel series that spotlights some of the most fascinating topics in the travel world. In September, we’re celebrating superlatives as we look at some of the world’s biggest, tallest and most expensive attractions and destinations.
paras.zh: 编者注：《月票》是 CNN 的旅游系列节目，重点关注旅游界一些最有趣的话题。九月，当我们参观世界上一些最大、最高和最昂贵的景点和目的地时，我们正在庆祝最高级。

paras.en: Having lived in Beijing for almost 12 years, I’ve had plenty of time to travel widely in China.
paras.zh: 在北京生活了近12年，我有足够的时间去中国各地旅行。

paras.en: I’ve visited more than 100 cities, not to mention countless towns and villages throughout the mainland’s 31 provinces.
paras.zh: 我去过100多个城市，更不用说遍布大陆31个省份的无数城镇和村庄。

paras.en: Looking back, I’ve come to realize it was my frequent visits to different parts of the Great Wall in Beijing that were a driving force behind my desire to explore the rest of the country and, along with it, the many sections of wall that lie outside the capital’s boundaries.
paras.zh: 回想起来，我逐渐意识到，正是我对北京长城不同部分的频繁访问，推动了我探索中国其他地区以及首都边界之外的许多长城的愿望。

paras.en: Work on the Great Wall began more than 2,500 years ago, its origins dating back to China’s Spring and Autumn Period of around 770 BCE to 476 BCE. Various sections were added in subsequent eras as competing dynasties and factions sought to exert their control.
paras.zh: 长城的修建始于 2500 多年前，其起源可以追溯到公元前 770 年至公元前 476 年左右的中国春秋时期。在随后的时代中，随着相互竞争的王朝和派系试图施加控制，各个部分被添加。

paras.en: Work eventually stopped in the 17th century.
paras.zh: 工程最终于 17 世纪停止。

paras.en: Though not a single, unbroken structure, the wall spans over 21,000 kilometers, winding through 15 provinces, 97 prefectures and 404 counties.
paras.zh: 长城虽然不是一个完整的结构，但全长超过 21,000 公里，蜿蜒穿过 15 个省、97 个地区和 404 个县。

paras.en: And while certain sections have been incredibly popular among tourists, many parts have slipped into obscurity, disrepair and sometimes oblivion.
paras.zh: 虽然某些部分非常受游客欢迎，但许多部分却变得默默无闻、年久失修，有时甚至被遗忘。

paras.en: Whether you’re planning to visit the Great Wall for the first time or the 50th, the following destinations are sure to make your trip to China even more worthwhile. (Check out the above video for dramatic aerial footage of some of these amazing sites.)
paras.zh: 无论您是第一次还是第 50 次游览长城，以下目的地一定会让您的中国之旅更加值得。 （查看上面的视频，了解其中一些令人惊叹的景点的戏剧性航拍镜头。）

paras.en: The Great Wall is not simply a brick and mortar bulwark; in certain places, towers on jagged mountain peaks, fortress towns or even wide rivers count as sections of “wall.”
paras.zh: 长城不仅仅是一座砖砌的堡垒，更是一座砖砌的堡垒。在某些地方，锯齿状山峰上的塔楼、要塞城镇甚至宽阔的河流都算作“墙”的一部分。

paras.en: The Turtle City, built in the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) as part of the Great Wall’s “Yellow River Defense Line,” was completed in 1608 and was home to around 2,000 infantrymen and 500 cavalry units during peak use.
paras.zh: 龟城建于明朝（1368-1644 年），是长城“黄河防线”的一部分，于 1608 年竣工，在高峰期可容纳约 2,000 名步兵和 500 名骑兵。

paras.en: Today, this fortress city is located in the Sitan Township of Jingtai County in north central Gansu province.
paras.zh: 如今，这座要塞城市位于甘肃省中北部景泰县泗滩乡。

paras.en: While there aren’t many real turtles in the “Turtle City,” the garrison town got its nickname due to its unique shape.
paras.zh: 虽然“龟城”中真正的乌龟不多，但这座驻军小镇因其独特的造型而得名。

paras.en: The south gate acts as the head and the west and east gates as the flippers. The town’s oval wall is the body, while the north gate acts as its tail. As one of the most well-preserved and truly authentic walled cities left in China today, it’s definitely worth your time.
paras.zh: 南门为头，西门、东门为脚蹼。椭圆形城墙为城身，北门为城尾。作为当今中国保存最完好、最真实的城墙之一，这里绝对值得您花时间。

paras.en: Staying in the Jingtai County center is recommended. The ancient city is only a 30-minute cab ride from your lodgings, so you can visit whenever the light is best for photos.
paras.zh: 推荐住在景泰县城中心。从您的住处乘坐出租车仅需 30 分钟即可到达古城，因此您可以在光线最适合拍照的时候前往游览。

paras.en: When in Jingtai, try local specialties such as the five Buddha tofu and the Jingtai cold mixed noodles – both are spicy vegetarian dishes. A walk through the sprawling night market in Jingtai County People’s Square, which boasts more than 50 snack stalls, is also recommended for adventurous foodies.
paras.zh: 到了景泰，一定要尝尝当地的特色菜，比如五佛豆腐和景泰冷拌面——都是麻辣素菜。景泰县人民广场的夜市拥有 50 多个小吃摊位，值得喜欢冒险的美食家们前往逛一逛。

paras.en: Getting there: Lanzhou, the capital of Gansu province, has a major international airport and high-speed train connections from many cities in China. The drive to Yongtai Turtle City from downtown Lanzhou takes about 2.5 hours (195 kilometers). From Lanzhou Zhongchuan Airport, it’s only 1.5 hours (125 kilometers).
paras.zh: 交通：兰州是甘肃省的省会，拥有一个主要的国际机场和连接中国许多城市的高速列车。从兰州市区驾车至永泰龟城，车程约2.5小时（195公里）。距兰州中川机场仅1.5小时（125公里）。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are two parts of the same Stone Dragon – two contiguous sections of the Great Wall that together stretch for roughly 25 kilometers along Beijing’s mountaintops.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口是同一条石龙的两个部分——长城的两个连续部分，沿着北京的山顶绵延约 25 公里。

paras.en: Historical records show that millions of men spent centuries constructing the Great Wall. Stand atop the wall at either Mutianyu or Jiankou, and you’ll begin to comprehend the gravity of this statement.
paras.zh: 历史记录表明，数百万人花费了几个世纪的时间建造长城。站在慕田峪或剑口的城墙上，你就会开始理解这句话的严重性。

paras.en: These two sections are arguably the two most classic examples of Ming Dynasty Great Wall surviving today, and climbing either is guaranteed to be a life-changing experience.
paras.zh: 这两段可以说是现存明代长城中最经典的两个例子，攀登其中任何一段都将是一次改变人生的经历。

paras.en: Mutianyu is the best portion of the “tourist wall.” Restored in the 1980s, it’s very commercial but also superbly beautiful. Visitors not up for the hike can take a cable car to the top.
paras.zh: 慕田峪是“旅游墙”中最好的部分。它于 20 世纪 80 年代修复，非常商业化，但也非常美丽。不适合徒步的游客可以乘坐缆车到达山顶。

paras.en: To the west of Mutianyu, Jiankou is colloquially known as the “wild wall” – no ticket needed and not commercialized. That being said, as of 2020, hiking at Jiankou has become somewhat frowned upon by the local government because of safety concerns.
paras.zh: 慕田峪以西的剑口俗称“野墙”，不需门票，不商业化。尽管如此，从2020年开始，出于安全考虑，当地政府对剑口徒步有些不满。

paras.en: Mutianyu and Jiankou are less than a 90-minute drive (without traffic) from downtown Beijing, yet it’s highly recommended to enjoy a night in the countryside if time allows.
paras.zh: 慕田峪和剑口距离北京市中心不到 90 分钟车程（不堵车），但如果时间允许，强烈建议在乡村享受一晚。

paras.en: Jiankou can be accessed via Xizhazi village; if dates align, you might even be able to spend a few days with William Lindesay, world-renowned Great Wall historian, and his wonderful family at The Barracks, their wall-side courtyard home.
paras.zh: 经西栅子村可到达剑口；如果日期一致，您甚至可以与世界著名的长城历史学家威廉·林德赛 (William Lindesay) 和他的家人一起在军营 (The Barracks) 度过几天，这是他们位于墙边的庭院住宅。

paras.en: For lodgings around Mutianyu, The Brickyard is a superbly comfortable choice.
paras.zh: 对于慕田峪周边的住宿而言，瓦厂是一个非常舒适的选择。

paras.en: In fall and spring, shades of the wall’s gray brick contrast with nature’s vibrant colors. Peak autumn foliage and spring cherry blossoms provide stunning backdrops for photos.
paras.zh: 在秋季和春季，灰色砖墙的色调与大自然鲜艳的色彩形成鲜明对比。秋天的枫叶和春天的樱花为照片提供了令人惊叹的背景。

paras.en: For winter sports enthusiasts, there’s skiing and skating next to the Wall at locations not far from Mutianyu.
paras.zh: 对于冬季运动爱好者来说，距离慕田峪不远的长城旁有滑雪场和滑冰场。

paras.en: Getting to Mutianyu: Restrictions on applying for temporary driving licenses in China were relaxed in September 2019, so renting a car as a foreign tourist is entirely possible. (International driving licenses are not accepted in China.)
paras.zh: 前往慕田峪：2019年9月，中国放宽了申请临时驾驶执照的限制，因此外国游客完全可以租车。 （中国不接受国际驾照。）

paras.en: You can also hire a car with a driver for the day or take the Mutianyu Special Tourism Bus from the Dongzhimen Wai Bus Station.
paras.zh: 您也可以当天租一辆带司机的汽车，或者从东直门外汽车站乘坐慕田峪旅游专线巴士。

paras.en: Getting to Jiankou: Renting a car or booking private transport is recommended. As Xizhazi is a small village, buses are scarce so it can take up to five hours to get there by public transport, as opposed to 90 minutes by car.
paras.zh: 前往剑口：建议租车或预订私人交通工具。由于西栅子是一个小村庄，公交车很少，因此乘坐公共交通工具最多需要 5 个小时才能到达那里，而开车则需要 90 分钟。

paras.en: Bataizi village sits just inside the Motianling section of the Great Wall and is home to the ruins of a Gothic church built in 1876 under the direction of a German missionary.
paras.zh: 八台子村位于磨天岭长城内，是一座哥特式教堂的遗址，这座教堂建于 1876 年，由一位德国传教士主持建造。

paras.en: The church has been damaged and repaired numerous times in its nearly 150-year history; the bell tower is the only part still standing.
paras.zh: 这座教堂在近150年的历史中曾多次遭到损坏和修复。钟楼是唯一仍然矗立的部分。

paras.en: The juxtaposition of its ruins against the rammed-earth Great Wall makes Bataizi a unique place to spend a morning or afternoon.
paras.zh: 其遗址与夯土长城并列，使八台子成为度过早晨或下午的独特场所。

paras.en: After finishing your hike along the wall and visiting the church ruins, drop in to the village’s “new” church to say hello to Father Pan; if you speak Chinese, he can answer any questions about the village’s long connection with Catholicism.
paras.zh: 完成沿着城墙的徒步旅行并参观教堂遗址后，顺便去村里的“新”教堂向潘神父问好；如果你会说中文，他可以回答任何有关该村与天主教的悠久联系的问题。

paras.en: Besides Bataizi, Datong should also be on your tourist map; visiting the Yungang Grottoes (a UNESCO world heritage site) and the Hengshan Hanging Temple will make your trip even more memorable.
paras.zh: 除了八台子，大同也应该出现在你的旅游地图上；参观云冈石窟（联合国教科文组织世界遗产）和恒山悬空寺将使您的旅行更加难忘。

paras.en: Late summer is an ideal time to visit Bataizi, as you’ll see a wonderful contrast between the Great Wall and the lush green hills.
paras.zh: 夏末是游览八台子的理想时机，因为您会看到长城和郁郁葱葱的青山之间的美妙对比。

paras.en: Getting there: Bataizi village is 80 kilometers west of Datong, one of Shanxi province’s largest and most famous cities. Zuoyun County is only 22 kilometers away from Bataizi – about a 35-minute drive.
paras.zh: 交通：八台子村位于山西省最大、最著名的城市之一大同以西 80 公里处。左云县距八台子仅22公里，车程约35分钟。

paras.en: Datong is easily accessible by plane or high-speed train from other cities in China; a taxi from downtown Datong to Bataizi should cost roughly 300 yuan (about $43).
paras.zh: 从中国其他城市乘坐飞机或高铁可轻松抵达大同；从大同市中心到八台子的出租车费用约为 300 元（约合 43 美元）。

paras.en: Alternatively, you can make your way to Zuoyun County by bus then hop in a taxi.
paras.zh: 或者，您也可以乘坐巴士前往左云县，然后乘坐出租车。

paras.en: In Datong, luxury seekers will want to head for the five-star Yunzhong Traditional Courtyard Hotel. Zuoyun County has one hotel that can accept foreigners: Zuoyun Jinshan International Hotel. Both can be found on popular hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: 在大同，追求奢华的游客将会前往五星级的云中传统四合院酒店。左云县有一家可以接待外国人的酒店：左云金山国际酒店。两者都可以在热门酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Laoniuwan (aka the Old Ox Bend Great Wall)
paras.zh: 老牛湾（又名老牛弯长城）

paras.en: As the locals say, Laoniuwan is where the Great Wall and the mighty Yellow River shake hands.
paras.zh: 当地人说，老牛湾是长城与浩瀚黄河握手的地方。

paras.en: The Laoniuwan Fortress was built in 1467, while the most famous tower of the Great Wall in this area, Wanghe Tower (literally meaning river-watching tower), was constructed in 1544.
paras.zh: 老牛湾城建于1467年，而该地区最著名的长城塔望河楼则建于1544年。

paras.en: Laoniuwan village is located in Pianguan County, part of Xinzhou city in Shanxi province, just across the river from Inner Mongolia.
paras.zh: 老牛湾村位于山西省忻州市偏关县，与内蒙古隔江相望。

paras.en: Late summer or early fall is a great time to visit, as you’ll avoid the potentially dangerous mountain roads during spring rainstorms, or being uncomfortably cold in a place without great infrastructure.
paras.zh: 夏末或初秋是游览的好时机，因为您可以避开春季暴雨期间潜在危险的山路，或者在没有良好基础设施的地方感到不舒服的寒冷。

paras.en: Along the Great Wall, there are only a few places where it meets bodies of water; of all those, this is the most stunning.
paras.zh: 长城沿线只有少数地方与水体交汇；其中，这是最令人惊叹的。

paras.en: A boat ride along the river is highly recommended. You’ll be able to soak in the natural beauty of the Yellow River Gorge while marveling at the steadfast resolve of these ancient architects.
paras.zh: 强烈推荐沿河乘船游览。您将能够沉浸在黄河峡谷的自然美景中，同时惊叹于这些古代建筑师的坚定决心。

paras.en: Getting there: Laoniuwan is difficult to get to by public transportation. The best option is to rent or book a car to take you from Datong to Laoniuwan via Bataizi – this way, you’ll be able to see two incredible locations along the Great Wall in one trip.
paras.zh: 交通：老牛湾乘坐公共交通不太方便。最好的选择是租赁或预订一辆车，从大同经八台子前往老牛湾——这样，您将能够在一次旅行中看到长城沿线的两个令人难以置信的景点。

paras.en: Pianguan is the nearest city, about one hour away. Pianguan does not have a train station or an airport. The only option is to arrive by bus. Shuozhou, 140 kilometers from Laoniuwan, has an airport opening later this year.
paras.zh: 偏关是最近的城市，大约一小时车程。偏关没有火车站和机场。唯一的选择是乘坐巴士到达。距离老牛湾 140 公里的朔州机场将于今年晚些时候开业。

paras.en: Construction on the Great Wall in Simatai began in 1373. It was expanded and reinforced periodically throughout the Ming Dynasty.
paras.zh: 司马台长城始建于 1373 年。明代期间不断扩建和加固。

paras.en: The Fairy Tower is one of the best-known towers of the wall at Simatai but also one of the least visited due to how difficult it is to access.
paras.zh: 仙塔是司马台最著名的城墙塔楼之一，但由于难以进入，也是参观人数最少的塔楼之一。

paras.en: Instead, aim to take in incredible views of the Fairy Tower from Wangjing Tower (just a few hundred meters away). It’s a journey that will satiate even the most adventurous hikers, yet can be done without any ropes, ladders or other essential safety gear.
paras.zh: 相反，您的目标是从望京塔（仅数百米外）欣赏仙女塔的壮丽景色。这是一次即使是最具冒险精神的徒步旅行者也能满足的旅程，而且无需任何绳索、梯子或其他必要的安全装备即可完成。

paras.en: As with a visit to Mutianyu/Jiankou, this section of wall is guaranteed to deliver stunning views any time of year. My only suggestion is to wait for a clear day (usually visibility is great the day after it rains or snows), as the view from Wangjing Tower is unobstructed in every direction.
paras.zh: 与游览慕田峪/剑口一样，这一段城墙保证在一年中的任何时候都能呈现出令人惊叹的景色。我唯一的建议是等待晴天（通常下雨或下雪后的第二天能见度很好），因为从望京塔的各个方向都一览无余。

paras.en: The hike to the Fairy Tower will leave you in awe of the Northern Barbarians’ supposed determination to reach the capital; the mountains are nearly impassable on foot, let alone by horse, with sheer cliff faces on either side.
paras.zh: 徒步前往仙塔，会让您对北蛮人到达首都的决心感到敬畏；这些山脉几乎无法步行通过，更不用说骑马了，两侧都是陡峭的悬崖。

paras.en: It makes for absolutely world-class hiking and an interesting history lesson.
paras.zh: 它绝对是世界一流的徒步旅行和有趣的历史课。

paras.en: Five-star lodgings are available at Hobo Farm; they also have an incredible restaurant that serves delicious Western and Chinese fare. For 4.5 star lodgings with a lower price tag, try Yatou’s Homestay. Both can be found on major hotel booking sites.
paras.zh: Hobo农场提供五星级住宿；他们还有一家令人难以置信的餐厅，供应美味的西餐和中餐。如果想要价格较低的 4.5 星级住宿，可以试试丫头民宿。两者都可以在主要的酒店预订网站上找到。

paras.en: Getting there: Both the Fairy Tower and Wangjing Tower should be accessed via Tangjiazhai village, located in Beijing’s Miyun district.
paras.zh: 交通：仙女塔和望京塔均需经由位于北京密云区的唐家寨村到达。

paras.en: Tangjiazhai village is 140 kilometers from downtown Beijing, depending on your route. Booking a private car from the city is probably the most time-effective way to get there.
paras.zh: 唐家寨距离北京市中心 140 公里，具体取决于您的路线。从市区预订私家车可能是到达那里最省时的方式。

paras.en: You can also take a high-speed train from Beijing Station to Miyun district and switch to a bus or taxi from there.
paras.zh: 您也可以从北京站乘坐高铁到密云区，然后从那里换乘公交车或出租车。

paras.en: Constructed during the reign of Emperor Jiajing (1507-1567), this single-wall section stands seven meters tall in some spots – no small feat considering it was made by piling stones.
paras.zh: 这座单墙建筑建于嘉靖年间（1507-1567 年），有些地方高达 7 米，考虑到它是用石头堆砌而成，这可不是一件小事。

paras.en: It’s located just across the road from the town of Dushikou, in Chicheng in Hebei province.
paras.zh: 它位于河北省赤城独市口镇的马路对面。

paras.en: The piled-stone wall at Dushikou is unique, as many other sections of the Great Wall close to Beijing were constructed using kiln-fired bricks.
paras.zh: 独市口的石堆墙是独一无二的，因为许多靠近北京的长城都是用窑烧砖建造的。

paras.en: Dushikou is best visited in the summer, specifically July and August, when the rolling hills of the surrounding grasslands are peak green. Cool evenings make for perfect outdoor barbecue/bonfire weather.
paras.zh: 独石口的最佳旅游时间是夏季，特别是七月和八月，此时周围草原连绵起伏的山丘呈现出翠绿的景色。凉爽的夜晚是完美的户外烧烤/篝火天气。

paras.en: You’ll be able to find clean and comfortable farmhouse lodgings in Dushikou town; alternatively, Chicheng, 45 minutes away, has a range of hotels to choose from.
paras.zh: 在都市口镇你可以找到干净舒适的农家住宿；或者，距酒店 45 分钟路程的赤城也有多家酒店可供选择。

paras.en: Lamb skewers and roast leg of lamb are specialties in these parts, as this part of Hebei is very close to the border with Inner Mongolia. Noodle lovers should also try the local oat noodles, which are delicious.
paras.zh: 河北这一地区靠近内蒙古边境，羊肉串、烤羊腿是这些地区的特色菜。喜欢吃面食的人还应该尝尝当地的燕麦面，味道鲜美。

paras.en: Getting there: Thanks to all the infrastructure built for the 2022 Winter Olympics, the drive to Dushikou has been shortened by almost two hours. If you prefer not to drive, hop on a bus to Chicheng from the Liuliqiao Transport Hub in Beijing and take a 45-minute taxi ride to Dushikou.
paras.zh: 交通：得益于为 2022 年冬奥会建设的所有基础设施，前往都市口的车程缩短了近两个小时。如果您不想开车，可以从北京六里桥交通枢纽搭乘巴士前往赤城，然后乘坐出租车 45 分钟即可到达独市口。

paras.en: Note that public transportation will take one or two hours longer than private car.
paras.zh: 请注意，公共交通会比私家车多花一两个小时。

articles.title: Netanyahu fights for political future as Israel heads to polls with Iran threat looming

paras.en: Ahead of Israel’s Oct. 27 national vote, U.S. President Donald Trump issued a sweeping endorsement of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s reelection bid, calling him a "great warrior," an "even greater partner for peace" and an ally in the confrontation with Iran.
paras.zh: 在以色列10月27日全国投票之前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的连任表示全面支持，称他是“伟大的战士”、“更伟大的和平伙伴”以及对抗伊朗的盟友。

paras.en: The backing could give Israel’s longest-serving prime minister a boost ahead of the country’s first national vote since the Hamas-led Oct. 7, 2023, massacre. The election is widely viewed in Israel as a referendum on whether to grant Netanyahu another term to pursue his war objectives, including disarming Hamas and Hezbollah and countering the nuclear threat from the Islamic Republic.
paras.zh: 这种支持可能会在以色列自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的大屠杀以来首次全国投票之前为以色列任期最长的总理带来提振。以色列普遍认为这次选举是一次公投，决定是否允许内塔尼亚胡连任以实现其战争目标，包括解除哈马斯和真主党的武装以及应对伊斯兰共和国的核威胁。

paras.en: In response, Netanyahu thanked Trump for his "extraordinary endorsement." "Together we will never let Iran’s regime get nuclear weapons," he said.
paras.zh: 作为回应，内塔尼亚胡感谢特朗普的“非凡支持”。 “我们将永远不会让伊朗政权获得核武器，”他说。

paras.en: Addressing the endorsement, Doron Spielman, international spokesman for the Israeli Prime Minister’s Office, told Fox News Digital that no personal or professional bond in the history of U.S.-Israel relations compares with the current partnership.
paras.zh: 以色列总理办公室国际发言人多伦·斯皮尔曼在谈到此次支持时对福克斯新闻数字频道表示，美以关系历史上没有任何个人或职业纽带可以与目前的伙伴关系相比。

paras.en: "Israel and the U.S. have stood together as the two countries bearing the torch for the West, and that is a direct result of the incredible relationship between President Trump and Netanyahu," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“以色列和美国作为向西方传递火炬的两个国家站在一起，这是特朗普总统和内塔尼亚胡之间令人难以置信的关系的直接结果。”

paras.en: He reiterated Netanyahu’s longstanding foreign-policy priority and central campaign promise: ensuring that Iran does not acquire atomic bombs under his watch.
paras.zh: 他重申了内塔尼亚胡长期以来的外交政策优先事项和核心竞选承诺：确保伊朗不会在他的监督下获得原子弹。

paras.en: "Israel prefers to do this with the U.S., which has been our greatest ally and friend, and who has already entered the front with us twice. But already at the time of Operation Rising Lion, Israel showed that it was willing to act alone. Israel acted for over a week before the U.S. joined," he said, in reference to the June 2025 military mission against Iran.
paras.zh: 他在谈到 2025 年 6 月针对伊朗的军事任务时表示，“以色列更愿意与美国合作，美国一直是我们最伟大的盟友和朋友，美国已经两次与我们一起上前线。但在‘雄狮行动’时，以色列就表明愿意单独行动。在美国加入之前，以色列已经采取了一周多的行动。”

paras.en: Israel’s longest-serving prime minister, with roughly 20 years in office, Netanyahu began his diplomatic career in 1982 as deputy chief of mission at Israel’s embassy in Washington, D.C. He served as Israel’s ambassador to the United Nations from 1984 to 1988 before entering politics with Likud. He became the party’s chairman in 1993 and was first elected premier in 1996.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡是以色列任职时间最长的总理，任期约 20 年。他于 1982 年担任以色列驻华盛顿大使馆副团长，开始了自己的外交生涯。1984 年至 1988 年，他担任以色列驻联合国大使，随后随利库德集团进入政界。他于1993年成为该党主席，并于1996年首次当选总理。

paras.en: After losing the 1999 election, Netanyahu returned to government in 2002 as foreign minister and later served as finance minister. He returned to the premiership in 2009, serving until 2021 and again from late 2022. He is widely credited with liberalizing Israel’s economy and helping transform the country into a global high-tech hub.
paras.zh: 1999年大选失败后，内塔尼亚胡于2002年重返政府，担任外交部长，后来又担任财政部长。他于 2009 年重返总理职位，任期至 2021 年，并从 2022 年底起再次担任总理。他因实现以色列经济自由化和帮助该国转变为全球高科技中心而受到广泛赞誉。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s current political allies include Itamar Ben-Gvir’s Otzma Yehudit, Bezalel Smotrich’s Religious Zionism-Zehut, and the ultra-Orthodox parties Shas and United Torah Judaism. The newcomer Amcha Yisrael, led by Ofer Winter, could also join the bloc, although Winter is currently feuding with Likud over concerns that his party, which is hovering near the electoral threshold, could split the right-wing vote and potentially "waste" tens of thousands of ballots.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡目前的政治盟友包括伊塔马尔·本·格维尔的奥兹玛·耶胡迪特、贝扎勒·斯莫特里奇的宗教犹太复国主义-泽胡特以及极端正统政党沙斯党和联合托拉犹太教。奥弗·温特(Ofer Winter)领导的新人阿姆查·伊斯雷尔(Amcha Yisrael)也可能加入该集团，尽管温特目前与利库德集团不和，担心他的政党徘徊在选举门槛附近，可能会分裂右翼选票，并可能“浪费”数万张选票。

paras.en: According to most Hebrew-language media polls, neither Netanyahu’s bloc nor the opposition led by Gadi Eisenkot currently has a clear path to securing the 61 Knesset seats needed to form a government.
paras.zh: 根据大多数希伯来语媒体的民意调查，内塔尼亚胡的集团和加迪·艾森科特领导的反对派目前都没有明确的途径来获得组建政府所需的 61 个议会席位。

paras.en: If no candidate can assemble a governing coalition, Israel could head to another election, repeating the cycle of political instability that saw the country hold four national votes between April 2019 and March 2021.
paras.zh: 如果没有候选人能够组建执政联盟，以色列可能会再次举行选举，从而重复该国在 2019 年 4 月至 2021 年 3 月期间举行四次全国大选的政治不稳定循环。

paras.en: Dan Diker, president of the Jerusalem Center for Security and Foreign Affairs, told Fox News Digital that any incoming government will face the same formidable security challenges as the current one, with few prospects for quick victories.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷安全与外交事务中心主席丹·迪克对福克斯新闻数字频道表示，任何即将上任的政府都将面临与现任政府同样严峻的安全挑战，而且几乎没有快速获胜的前景。

paras.en: "The major challenge in this election will be what Netanyahu discussed in terms of adjusting the national security concept to prioritize prevention. That means taking very serious, assertive and aggressive military counterterrorism and nonmilitary actions against our enemies," Diker said.
paras.zh: 迪克说：“这次选举的主要挑战将是内塔尼亚胡所讨论的调整国家安全理念，将预防放在首位。这意味着对我们的敌人采取非常严肃、果断和积极的军事反恐和非军事行动。”

paras.en: The Israeli left, center and even far-right believe Netanyahu has failed to meet the expectations associated with his image as "Mr. Security," according to Prof. Tamar Hermann, a senior researcher at the Israel Democracy Institute.
paras.zh: 以色列民主研究所高级研究员塔马尔·​​赫尔曼教授表示，以色列左派、中派甚至极右派都认为内塔尼亚胡未能达到人们对其“安全先生”形象的期望。

paras.en: "He promised to topple the Iranian regime, he promised to dismantle Hamas, he promised to crush Hezbollah. None of it was achieved," Hermann told Fox News Digital. "He gave a green light to not punishing vigilantes in the settlements who act against Palestinians. He also gave too much to the ultra-Orthodox parties, giving up on the idea of universal conscription."
paras.zh: “他承诺推翻伊朗政权，他承诺解散哈马斯，他承诺镇压真主党。但这些都没有实现，”赫尔曼告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。 “他为不惩罚定居点里针对巴勒斯坦人的自卫队开了绿灯。他还给了极端正统派政党太多的支持，放弃了全民征兵的想法。”

paras.en: Hermann said that Netanyahu’s current term has been his least successful, beginning with the judicial reform push, which triggered mass protests in 2023, and followed by the Palestinian terror attacks on Oct. 7. Netanyahu subsequently faced public anger over his handling of the hostage crisis, although, in coordination with Trump and his envoys, he ultimately secured the return of all the captives.
paras.zh: 赫尔曼表示，内塔尼亚胡的本届任期是他最不成功的，首先是推动司法改革，引发了2023年的大规模抗议，然后是10月7日的巴勒斯坦恐怖袭击。内塔尼亚胡随后因其对人质危机的处理而面临公众的愤怒，尽管在特朗普及其特使的协调下，他最终确保了所有俘虏的返回。

paras.en: "In the eyes of some, his legacy will be that he inflicted a huge disaster upon Israel in terms of what happened to civilians on Oct. 7 and the deterioration of Israel’s international image," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“在一些人看来，他的遗产将是他给以色列带来了一场巨大的灾难，包括10月7日发生在平民身上的事情以及以色列国际形象的恶化。”

paras.en: Michael Oren, a former Israeli ambassador to the United States, framed the upcoming election in terms of legacy and how Netanyahu will be remembered 50 years from now.
paras.zh: 前以色列驻美国大使迈克尔·奥伦 (Michael Oren) 从遗产以及内塔尼亚胡 50 年后如何被人们铭记的角度来规划即将到来的选举。

paras.en: "There are two types of leaders: leaders in history and leaders of history," he told Fox News Digital. "There are leaders who go into office and perform as best they can, and there are leaders who go into office and see themselves as transformative, as having a historical role like Abraham Lincoln, Roosevelt or Churchill. Benjamin Netanyahu belongs to this category."
paras.zh: “有两种类型的领导者：历史上的领导者和历史上的领导者，”他告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。 “有些领导人上任后尽其所能地表现出色，有些领导人上任后认为自己具有变革性，具有像亚伯拉罕·林肯、罗斯福或丘吉尔这样的历史角色。本杰明·内塔尼亚胡就属于这一类。”

paras.en: Oren said Netanyahu sees his mission as saving Israel from existential threats, foremost among them Iran, a goal he has yet to achieve.
paras.zh: 奥伦表示，内塔尼亚胡认为他的使命是拯救以色列免受生存威胁，其中最重要的是伊朗，但他尚未实现这一目标。

paras.en: "He is willing to endure virtually limitless criticism and condemnation around the world, as well as mass demonstrations against him, to fulfill this one role," he said. "To understand that is to understand Benjamin Netanyahu: He is a leader of history."
paras.zh: 他说：“为了履行这一职责，他愿意忍受世界各地几乎无限的批评和谴责，以及针对他的大规模示威活动。” “理解这一点就是理解本杰明·内塔尼亚胡：他是历史的领导者。”

articles.title: Lincoln Riley’s USC tenure could end with loss against Ohio State’s backup quarterback, and $70m buyout

paras.en: Should Lincoln Riley’s tenure at USC come down to what happens this weekend against an Ohio State team playing with a backup quarterback in what was supposed to be a marquee matchup for the Trojans?
paras.zh: 林肯·莱利在南加州大学的任期是否应该归结为本周末对阵俄亥俄州立大学队与替补四分卫的比赛中所发生的事情，这场比赛本来应该是特洛伊人队的一场大对决？

paras.en: One way or another, everything could come to a head Saturday night in Los Angeles for a USC team coming off an embarrassing loss to Wisconsin in Madison.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，周六晚上在洛杉矶，南加州大学队在麦迪逊惨败给威斯康星州队后，一切都可能达到高潮。

paras.en: This was supposed to be the year for Lincoln Riley to have his team in the college football playoff and compete for a national championship. The pieces appeared to be in place, with quarterback Jayden Maiava leading an offense expected to rank among the Big Ten’s best.
paras.zh: 今年本应是林肯莱利带领他的球队参加大学橄榄球季后赛并争夺全国冠军的一年。一切似乎都已就位，四分卫杰登·迈亚瓦（Jayden Maiava）领导的进攻预计将跻身十大联盟最佳之列。

paras.en: Throw in a defense led by Gary Patterson, and the recipe for success was being put together inside the Trojans' football complex.
paras.zh: 再加上加里·帕特森领导的防守，成功的秘诀就是在特洛伊足球场内整合起来。

paras.en: Unfortunately for the USC fans that were praying for some type of return on investment after showing up on a weekly basis, sometimes in the blistering California heat, we are once again on the brink of total implosion for Lincoln Riley.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，对于南加州大学的球迷来说，他们每周都会出现，有时甚至在加州酷热的天气下祈祷某种类型的投资回报，我们再次处于林肯·莱利彻底崩溃的边缘。

paras.en: And, the head coach had the nerve to sit at the podium after losing to Wisconsin and discuss a win at Penn State just two weeks prior.
paras.zh: 而且，在输给威斯康星州后，主教练有勇气坐在领奖台上，讨论两周前对阵宾夕法尼亚州立大学的胜利。

paras.en: "You have to own it, this is the same team that played a way different brand of football at Penn State two weeks ago and we're very capable of doing that again in the coming weeks," Lincoln Riley said after the Wisconsin loss.
paras.zh: “你必须拥有它，这支球队两周前在宾夕法尼亚州立大学打出了完全不同的足球风格，我们非常有能力在未来几周内再次做到这一点，”林肯莱利在威斯康星州失利后说道。

paras.en: "But we gotta do it, and it's gonna take all of coaches and players to do it, and that's what we're gonna do."
paras.zh: “但我们必须这么做，这需要所有教练和球员都去做，这就是我们要做的。”

paras.en: Sorry, that isn’t going to make Trojan fans feel any better that you went on the road and beat a Big Ten team earlier in the month, then to turn around and lose to a Wisconsin team that was not on the same level when it comes to talent.
paras.zh: 抱歉，这并不会让特洛伊球迷感觉更好，因为你在本月早些时候在客场击败了一支十大球队，然后又输给了一支在天赋方面不在同一水平的威斯康星州球队。

paras.en: A lifeless effort that saw the Trojans score just seven points in the game.
paras.zh: 毫无生气的努力导致特洛伊队在比赛中只得到了七分。

paras.en: Oh, and if USC fans wanted to feel even worse about the loss, Wisconsin passed for only 58 yards in the win over the Trojans.
paras.zh: 哦，如果南加州大学的球迷想对这场失利感到更难过的话，威斯康星州在战胜特洛伊队的比赛中只传出了 58 码。

paras.en: The reality is that this experiment feels all but over, and Ohio State could end up being the final nail in a coffin that has been in the process of being assembled for over a year.
paras.zh: 现实情况是，这个实验感觉已经结束了，俄亥俄州立大学最终可能成为已经组装了一年多的棺材上的最后一颗钉子。

paras.en: Pay for the buyout or pray Lincoln Riley takes another job?
paras.zh: 支付买断费用还是祈祷林肯莱利接受另一份工作？

paras.en: You wanna see things get contentious around USC?
paras.zh: 您想看到南加州大学周围的事情变得有争议吗？

paras.en: Have the administration get into a standoff with Riley and his agent over the reported $70 million buyout that USC would owe the head coach if he were to be fired.
paras.zh: 据报道，如果莱利被解雇，南加州大学将欠主教练7000万美元的买断金，政府是否会与莱利及其经纪人陷入僵局。

paras.en: But in this era of college athletics, schools can no longer afford to sit around and pray it gets better. Okay, maybe Florida State can penny-pinch and hold off on firing Mike Norvell until they raise enough money by passing around the offering plate to boosters on a Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 但在这个大学体育盛行的时代，学校不能再坐等事情变​​得更好了。好吧，也许佛罗里达州可以精打细算，推迟解雇迈克·诺维尔，直到他们在周日早上将募集资金传递给支持者，筹集到足够的资金。

paras.en: Not USC, and not during one of the most chaotic times in college athletics. If Lincoln Riley could not win with Caleb Williams slinging the football, what makes fans think he can win now?
paras.zh: 不是南加州大学，也不是在大学体育最混乱的时期之一。如果林肯·莱利（Lincoln Riley）无法在凯莱布·威廉姆斯（Caleb Williams）投球的情况下获胜，那么是什么让球迷认为他现在可以获胜呢？

paras.en: We are also past the point of excuses. There is no conceivable reason why USC should have lost to a football team that passed for a total of 58 yards. And, there's no reason why the Trojans' season should come down to a game against Ohio State this weekend.
paras.zh: 我们也已经不再找借口了。南加州大学没有任何理由会输给一支总传球码数为 58 码的橄榄球队。而且，特洛伊队的赛季没有理由归结为本周末对阵俄亥俄州立大学的比赛。

paras.en: Remember, the Trojans still have to play Ohio State, Indiana, Maryland and UCLA to finish out the 2026 season, and there is no wiggle-room for a loss thanks to that performance against Wisconsin.
paras.zh: 请记住，特洛伊队仍需对阵俄亥俄州立大学、印第安纳大学、马里兰大学和加州大学洛杉矶分校才能完成 2026 年赛季，而且由于对阵威斯康星大学的表现，他们没有输球的余地。

paras.en: So, if things continue trending in the wrong way this weekend and Ohio State rolls into Los Angeles with a backup quarterback to beat the Trojans, it could be time for Lincoln Riley to finally waive the white flag.
paras.zh: 因此，如果本周末事情继续朝着错误的方向发展，俄亥俄州立大学带着替补四分卫进入洛杉矶击败特洛伊队，那么林肯莱利可能是时候最终放弃白旗了。

paras.en: We all know he's a competitor, but leaving USC for a return to the Big 12 at a school like Baylor might not be the worst thing for a head coach who is hanging on by a thread at his current employer.
paras.zh: 我们都知道他是一个竞争者，但离开南加州大学，回到像贝勒这样的学校重返 Big 12，对于一个在现任雇主中命悬一线的主教练来说，可能并不是最糟糕的事情。

paras.en: It's either that or forcing USC to pay the buyout that will undoubtedly be mitigated in some form or fashion.
paras.zh: 要么是这样，要么是迫使南加州大学支付买断费，这无疑会以某种形式或方式得到缓解。

paras.en: And don't forget, these high-power schools can find a way to make the situation messy in the process.
paras.zh: 而且不要忘记，这些有权有势的学校可以在这个过程中找到让局势变得混乱的方法。

paras.en: This is not what USC signed up for, or wrote massive checks they can't cash
paras.zh: 这不是南加州大学签署的协议，也不是开出无法兑现的巨额支票的内容

paras.en: The Trojans have not won more than nine games since the 2022 season, where they finished 11-3.
paras.zh: 自 2022 赛季以来，特洛伊队的胜场数还没有超过 9 场，当时他们的战绩为 11 胜 3 负。

paras.en: You think this is what USC donors had in mind when they signed Lincoln Riley to a lucrative contract that saw him leave Oklahoma?
paras.zh: 你认为这就是南加州大学捐助者在与林肯·莱利签订一份利润丰厚的合同并让他离开俄克拉荷马州时的想法吗？

paras.en: That's an easy answer. Absolutely not, and I can promise you the Big Ten conference is thinking the same.
paras.zh: 这是一个简单的答案。绝对不是，我可以向你保证十大会议也有同样的想法。

paras.en: A win against Ohio State on Saturday night would obviously keep USC within striking distance of the playoffs.
paras.zh: 周六晚上对阵俄亥俄州立大学的胜利显然将使南加州大学距离季后赛更近。

paras.en: But, they would also have to win out and beat UCLA to end the regular season, while also going on the road to Bloomington in three weeks to face Curt Cignetti's Indiana team that is still in the hunt despite a flaky offense.
paras.zh: 但是，他们还必须获胜并击败加州大学洛杉矶分校才能结束常规赛，同时还要在三周后前往布卢明顿面对柯特·西格内蒂的印第安纳队，尽管进攻不稳定，但该队仍在追逐中。

paras.en: We have come to the old fork in the road in Los Angeles, and if USC doesn’t win this weekend against the Buckeyes, that highway could lead Riley straight out of California with a nice payday to make up for the embarrassing results he produced.
paras.zh: 我们已经来到了洛杉矶的老岔路口，如果南加州大学本周末没有战胜七叶树队，这条高速公路可能会带领莱利直接离开加州，并获得不错的发薪日，以弥补他所取得的尴尬结果。

articles.title: Obama judge rules Trump DOJ illegally fired James Comey's daughter, rejects sweeping Article II claim

paras.en: An Obama-appointed New York federal judge ruled Monday that the Trump Justice Department unlawfully fired former FBI Director James Comey's daughter Maurene, rejecting the administration's sweeping claim of executive authority and warning that its argument threatened the nation's constitutional balance of power.
paras.zh: 奥巴马任命的纽约联邦法官周一裁定，特朗普司法部非法解雇前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米的女儿莫琳，驳回了政府对行政权力的全面主张，并警告称其论点威胁到国家宪法权力平衡。

paras.en: The Justice Department acknowledged in court filings that Comey's firing was not for-cause and was not based on her performance, but argued that the attorney general had the authority to remove her under Article II of the Constitution.
paras.zh: 司法部在法庭文件中承认，科米被解雇并非无故，也不是基于她的表现，但辩称司法部长有权根据宪法第二条将她免职。

paras.en: "Defendants’ argument that [Constitution] Article II bars Congress from regulating the removal of AUSAs (assistant U.S. attorneys) flies in the face of nearly two centuries of Supreme Court precedent," Judge Jesse Furman wrote, adding that accepting the administration's argument would "unsettle the very equilibrium established by this nation's constitutional system."
paras.zh: 杰西·弗曼法官写道：“被告声称[宪法]第二条禁止国会监管美国助理检察官的撤职，这与最高法院近两个世纪的先例背道而驰。”他补充说，接受政府的论点将“破坏这个国家宪法制度所建立的平衡”。

paras.en: A DOJ spokesperson told Fox News Digital the department disagreed with the decision and will appeal it in "due course." Furman ordered Comey retroactively reinstated and awarded back pay through Dec. 20, 2025, when she accepted another job.
paras.zh: 司法部发言人告诉福克斯数字新闻，该部门不同意这一决定，并将在“适当的时候”提出上诉。弗曼命令科米追溯恢复职务，并支付拖欠工资，直至 2025 年 12 月 20 日，届时她接受了另一份工作。

paras.en: While federal law gives the attorney general authority to fire assistant U.S. attorneys, Furman ruled that Congress placed limits on that power through the Civil Service Reform Act (CSRA), which generally requires cause for termination and procedural protections for government workers.
paras.zh: 虽然联邦法律赋予总检察长解雇美国助理检察官的权力，但弗曼裁定国会通过《公务员制度改革法案》(CSRA)对该权力进行限制，该法案通常要求解雇原因和对政府工作人员的程序保护。

paras.en: The judge found that Comey's firing violated those requirements, noting that the government conceded her removal was not based on misconduct or poor performance and that she received neither advance notice nor an opportunity to respond.
paras.zh: 法官认为，解雇科米违反了这些要求，并指出政府承认，解雇她并不是因为行为不当或表现不佳，而且她既没有收到提前通知，也没有机会做出回应。

paras.en: Comey had served about a decade in the prominent Southern District of New York, where she worked on some of the office’s biggest cases, including the prosecution of Ghislaine Maxwell – associate and rumored partner of Jeffrey Epstein — as well as the sex trafficking trial of rapper Sean "P. Diddy" Combs.
paras.zh: 科米在著名的纽约南区服务了大约十年，在那里她处理了该办公室一些最大的案件，包括起诉杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的助手和传闻中的搭档吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔，以及说唱歌手肖恩·“P.迪迪”·库姆斯的性贩运审判。

paras.en: Furman also recently rebuked the Trump administration during its efforts to deport pro-Palestinian Columbia University student activist Mahmoud Khalil, leading the federal government to argue for a change of venue to New Jersey.
paras.zh: 弗曼最近还谴责特朗普政府驱逐亲巴勒斯坦哥伦比亚大学学生活动人士马哈茂德·哈利勒的努力，导致联邦政府主张将地点改为新泽西。

paras.en: The judge, nominated in 2011, previously served as a federal prosecutor in the same Manhattan U.S. attorney's office where both Comeys worked during their careers. Furman's brother, Jason, served in the Obama administration as chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers.
paras.zh: 这位法官于 2011 年被提名，此前曾在科米夫妇职业生涯中工作过的曼哈顿联邦检察官办公室担任联邦检察官。弗曼的兄弟贾森曾在奥巴马政府担任经济顾问委员会主席。

paras.en: James Comey served as the top prosecutor at SDNY early in the George W. Bush administration, where he investigated President Bill Clinton’s controversial pardon of financier Marc Rich as well as interior designer Martha Stewart.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·科米 (James Comey) 在乔治·W·布什 (George W. Bush) 政府早期担任纽约纽约市最高检察官，负责调查比尔·克林顿 (Bill Clinton) 总统对金融家马克·里奇 (Marc Rich) 和室内设计师玛莎·斯图尔特 (Martha Stewart) 的有争议的赦免。

paras.en: The younger Comey was the second in her family to be fired under Trump, after the president terminated her father as FBI director in 2017 during the Russia collusion investigation.
paras.zh: 小科米是特朗普领导下家族中第二个被解雇的人，此前特朗普于 2017 年在通俄调查期间解除了她父亲联邦调查局局长的职务。

paras.en: The elder Comey later came under fire for posting a photo of seashells on a beach arranged to form the sentiment "86 47" – with critics saying "86" was a reference to killing something, such as in restaurant lingo, and "47" referred to Trump, the 47th president.
paras.zh: 老科米后来因发布一张海滩上贝壳的照片而受到批评，这些照片被排列成“86 47”的情绪——批评者称“86”指的是杀死某物，比如餐厅用语，而“47”指的是第47任总统特朗普。

paras.en: Maurene Comey’s attorneys said in a statement to The Associated Press that their victory was "hard-earned" for both their client and all civil servants.
paras.zh: 莫林·科米的律师在给美联社的一份声明中表示，他们的胜利对于他们的当事人和所有公务员来说都是“来之不易”。

paras.en: "As the court correctly held, to accept the government’s argument about unlimited executive power ‘would be to unsettle the very equilibrium established by this nation’s constitutional system.’ This decision reaffirms our bedrock system of checks and balances: the President is not above the law," they said.
paras.zh: “正如法院正确认为的那样，接受政府关于无限行政权力的论点‘将破坏这个国家宪法制度所建立的平衡’。这一决定重申了我们制衡的基石体系：总统并不凌驾于法律之上，”他们说。

articles.title: How Lula beat far-right Bolsonaro in Brazil – The Latest
articles.author: Presented by Michael Safi with Tom Phillips; produced by Angus Neale; senior producer Bryony Moore

paras.en: How Lula beat far-right Bolsonaro in Brazil – The Latest
paras.zh: 卢拉如何在巴西击败极右翼博尔索纳罗——最新消息

paras.en: Brazil’s Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won a historic fourth term as president, defeating the far-right candidate Flávio Bolsonaro in a dramatic comeback.
paras.zh: 巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦戏剧性地击败极右翼候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，历史性地第四次当选总统。

paras.en: Lula is the first candidate to win a runoff election after losing in the first round, taking victory with 51.79% of the vote to his rival’s 48.21%. His win bucks a regional trend, after the son of the former president Jair Bolsonaro had spearheaded a radical populist movement.
paras.zh: 卢拉是第一位在第一轮失利后赢得决选的候选人，以51.79%的得票率击败对手的48.21%获得胜利。在前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子带头激进民粹主义运动之后，他的胜利与地区趋势背道而驰。

paras.en: But with Flávio Bolsonaro refusing to concede defeat, what’s next for Brazil? Michael Safi speaks to Latin America correspondent Tom Phillips – watch on YouTube
paras.zh: 但随着弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗拒绝承认失败，巴西接下来会怎样？迈克尔·萨菲 (Michael Safi) 与拉丁美洲记者汤姆·菲利普斯 (Tom Phillips) 对话 – 在 YouTube 上观看

articles.title: How the streets and social media drove Lula to a historic comeback in Brazil
articles.author: Tiago Rogero in Brasília and Tom Phillips in São Paulo

paras.en: After the first round of the Brazilian presidential election three weeks ago, the leftist incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva reportedly told allies he could not understand how he finished second after a government he considered the best of his three terms.
paras.zh: 据报道，三周前巴西总统选举第一轮结束后，左翼现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦告诉盟友，他无法理解自己为何在他认为是三届任期中最好的政府之后获得第二名。

paras.en: A mood of dismay swept Brazil’s left, and because 9 million voters for the other candidates, all of them on the right, were expected to mostly transfer to senator Flávio Bolsonaro, analysts widely saw the far-right senator’s victory as certain.
paras.zh: 沮丧的情绪席卷了巴西的左翼，由于其他候选人（全都是右翼）的 900 万选民预计将大部分转向参议员弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，分析人士普遍认为这位极右翼参议员的胜利是板上钉钉的。

paras.en: Then, on the night after the election, students from the Fluminense Federal University took to the streets of Niterói, a city of 480,000 across Guanabara Bay from Rio de Janeiro, to protest against the return to power of a member of the Bolsonaro family, whose patriarch, former president Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio’s father, is under house arrest for attempting a coup.
paras.zh: 然后，在选举后的第二天晚上，弗鲁米嫩塞联邦大学的学生走上尼泰罗伊的街头，尼泰罗伊是一座与里约热内卢隔瓜纳巴拉湾相望、拥有 48 万人口的城市，抗议博尔索纳罗家族的一名成员重新掌权，该家族的族长、前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗、弗拉维奥的父亲因企图政变而被软禁。

paras.en: Two days later, another student protest took over downtown Rio and, in the days that followed, similar ones spread across the country in organic demonstrations that analysts and Lula himself agree gave new life to his campaign and played a decisive role in his historic comeback in the runoff.
paras.zh: 两天后，另一场学生抗议活动占领了里约市中心，在接下来的几天里，类似的示威活动在全国各地蔓延开来，分析人士和卢拉本人都认为，这些示威活动给他的竞选活动注入了新的活力，并在他在决选中历史性地卷土重来发挥了决定性作用。

paras.en: “I want to thank the generosity of Brazil’s young people who took to the streets to defend democracy,” Lula said in his victory speech on Sunday night after defeating Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: “我要感谢巴西年轻人的慷慨，他们走上街头捍卫民主，”卢拉在周日晚上击败博尔索纳罗后发表胜利演讲时说道。

paras.en: Political scientist Fábio Vasconcellos said Lula’s victory, in which for the first time in Brazil’s democratic history a second-placed candidate overturned a first-round defeat in the runoff, could be explained by a combination of the streets, social media and the machinery of government – in recent weeks, Lula approved a “package of benefits” at the limits of what electoral law allows, including increasing and bringing forward payments from the main cash-transfer programme for poor families.
paras.zh: 政治学家法比奥·瓦斯康塞洛斯(Fábio Vasconcellos)表示，卢拉的胜利是巴西民主历史上首次由排名第二的候选人推翻了第一轮决选的失利，这可以通过街头、社交媒体和政府机构的结合来解释。最近几周，卢拉在选举法允许的范围内批准了一项“一揽子福利”，包括增加和提前支付针对贫困家庭的主要现金转移计划的款项。

paras.en: “The streets and social media almost overlap,” said Vasconcellos, a researcher with the Representation and Democratic Legitimacy group at the Federal University of Paraná.
paras.zh: “街道和社交媒体几乎重叠，”巴拉那联邦大学代表和民主合法性小组的研究员瓦斯康塞洛斯说。

paras.en: Two days after the first round, congressman André Janones, a Lula ally, created a WhatsApp channel called “Lula’s Army”, where Janones sent audio messages, videos – often beginning with shouts of “Guys, urgent!” – and dozens of daily instructions on how to make pro-Lula content perform well on social media.
paras.zh: 第一轮投票结束两天后，卢拉的盟友、国会议员安德烈·雅诺内斯创建了一个名为“卢拉军队”的 WhatsApp 频道，雅诺内斯在其​​中发送音频消息和视频 - 通常以“伙计们，紧急！”的喊叫开始。 – 以及关于如何使支持卢拉的内容在社交媒体上表现良好的数十条日常说明。

paras.en: The channel had 60,000 followers by the end of its first day and, by election Sunday, more than 10 million, and Lula’s digital reach overtook Bolsonaro’s.
paras.zh: 截至第一天结束，该频道已拥有 6 万名粉丝，到周日选举时，粉丝数量已超过 1000 万，卢拉的数字影响力超过了博尔索纳罗。

paras.en: In his victory speech, Lula called Janones “our general”, who had the role of “raising the morale of our troops every day”. The congressman’s relentless efforts, which included a 24-hour YouTube live stream on the eve of the vote, led to him being admitted to hospital last week – the only day the WhatsApp channel went silent.
paras.zh: 卢拉在胜利演讲中称亚诺内斯为“我们的将军”，他的作用是“每天提高我们军队的士气”。这位国会议员的不懈努力，包括在投票前夕进行 24 小时 YouTube 直播，导致他上周入院——这是 WhatsApp 频道保持沉默的唯一一天。

paras.en: Lula’s campaign also overhauled his online communications, and the incumbent, who turns 81 on Tuesday, began recording selfie videos despite not owning a mobile phone. On Sunday night, he said he had been given a phone and that “from now on I’m going to talk a lot to the Brazilian people, many times a day, directly”.
paras.zh: 卢拉的竞选活动还彻底改革了他的在线沟通方式，这位周二就年满 81 岁的现任总统在没有手机的情况下开始录制自拍视频。周日晚上，他说他得到了一部电话，“从现在开始，我将直接与巴西人民交谈很多次，每天很多次”。

paras.en: With the streets and social media, “the mood of defeat was gradually replaced by hopes of a comeback over those three weeks,” said Vasconcellos.
paras.zh: 瓦斯康塞洛斯说，随着街头和社交媒体的出现，“在这三周里，失败的情绪逐渐被卷土重来的希望所取代”。

paras.en: Camila Rocha, a political scientist who studies Brazil’s new right, said Lula’s comeback also represented “a broad rejection of the Bolsonarista project for Brazil”.
paras.zh: 研究巴西新右翼的政治学家卡米拉·罗查表示，卢拉的复出也代表着“巴西对博索纳里斯塔计划的广泛拒绝”。

paras.en: She has been interviewing undecided voters since May and said “the fear voters had, workers had, of losing rights and also of a possible concentration of power in Bolsonaro’s hands was very clear”, which meant that even people who did not like Lula voted for him this time.
paras.zh: 自五月以来，她一直在采访尚未做出决定的选民，并表示“选民和工人们对失去权利以及权力可能集中在博尔索纳罗手中的恐惧是非常明显的”，这意味着即使是不喜欢卢拉的人这次也投票给了他。

paras.en: Bolsonaro had won 56.1m votes in the first round and received 3.7 million more in the runoff. Lula, by contrast, went from 53.9m to 64.2m. The more than 10m-vote increase came both from persuading voters to turn out after historically high abstention in the first round and from convincing voters from other candidates, including Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗在第一轮赢得了 5610 万张选票，在决选中又获得了 370 万张选票。相比之下，卢拉则从 53.9m 升至 64.2m。超过1000万张选票的增加既来自于说服选民在第一轮投票中弃权率创历史新高后投票，也来自于说服了包括博尔索纳罗在内的其他候选人的选民。

paras.en: “Some undecided voters we interviewed said Bolsonaro was a playboy who sided with big business, while at the same time spontaneously saying that, if he won, there would be a dictatorship in which people would lose rights,” said Rocha.
paras.zh: 罗查说：“我们采访的一些犹豫不决的选民说，博尔索纳罗是个花花公子，站在大企业一边，同时又自发地表示，如果他获胜，就会出现独裁统治，人民将失去权利。”

paras.en: Bolsonaro was also embroiled in several controversies recently, including saying he would use the new, even more conservative congress to change the constitution and “re-democratise” Brazil, as well as the two federal police inquiries in which he is under investigation over alleged corruption and money laundering.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗最近还卷入了几项争议，包括表示他将利用新的、更加保守的国会来修改宪法并“重新民主化”巴西，以及他因涉嫌腐败和洗钱而接受的两项联邦警察调查。

paras.en: Many analysts have also pointed to the weight of Lula himself. “If it were another candidate, Bolsonaro would already have won in the first round,” said political scientist Helcimara de Souza Telles.
paras.zh: 许多分析人士还指出了卢拉本人的分量。政治学家赫尔西马拉·德索萨·泰勒斯表示：“如果是另一位候选人，博尔索纳罗早就在第一轮获胜。”

paras.en: Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, Lula’s campaign manager, answered without hesitation when asked what explained the historic election fightback: “President Lula. We have a great statesman on our team. We have a star player. That’s what absolutely made the difference. I haven’t the slightest doubt about it.”
paras.zh: 当被问及如何解释这场历史性的选举反击时，卢拉的竞选经理马可·奥雷利奥·德卡瓦略毫不犹豫地回答道：“卢拉总统。我们的团队中有一位伟大的政治家。我们有一位明星球员。这绝对是造成差异的原因。我对此没有丝毫怀疑。”

paras.en: The question already occupying the minds of Brazil’s left is what happens next, given that Lula has said this was his last election.
paras.zh: 鉴于卢拉曾表示这是他的最后一次选举，接下来会发生什么已经成为巴西左翼人士思考的问题。

paras.en: “That is a very big challenge because, in the polling on this, Lula’s dominance is still very strong. There is no one in his party with the same leadership,” said Rocha.
paras.zh: “这是一个非常大的挑战，因为在这方面的民意调查中，卢拉的主导地位仍然非常强大。他的党内没有人拥有同样的领导地位，”罗查说。

paras.en: Vasconcellos believes Lula’s re-election campaign, “from what we saw on the streets, offered the Brazilian left an opportunity for renewal”.
paras.zh: 瓦斯康塞洛斯认为，卢拉的连任竞选活动“从我们在街上看到的情况来看，为巴西左翼提供了复兴的机会”。

paras.en: “Lula’s party can learn from what happened and find better ways to connect with young people and urban voters who feel their concerns are not being heard,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“卢拉的政党可以从所发生的事情中吸取教训，并找到更好的方式与那些感觉自己的担忧没有被听到的年轻人和城市选民建立联系。”

paras.en: - The Guardian’s Latin America correspondent Tom Phillips will be answering your questions about the election and the future of Brazil from 1500 GMT on Tuesday 27 October as part of our Conversations series. Email questions to conversations@theguardian.com.
paras.zh: - 作为我们对话系列的一部分，《卫报》拉丁美洲记者汤姆·菲利普斯 (Tom Phillips) 将于 10 月 27 日星期二格林尼治标准时间 1500 点回答您有关巴西选举和未来的问题。通过电子邮件将问题发送至conversations@theguardian.com。

articles.title: No 10 clarifies Andy Burnham’s stance on freedom of movement
articles.author: Aletha Adu Political correspondent

paras.en: Downing Street has been forced to clarify Andy Burnham’s stance on whether the UK would return to having freedom of movement with the EU after the prime minister said an “honest discussion” was needed on the issue.
paras.zh: 在首相表示需要就这个问题进行“诚实讨论”后，唐宁街被迫澄清安迪·伯纳姆对于英国是否会恢复与欧盟的行动自由的立场。

paras.en: Burnham fuelled speculation about a return to freedom of movement in an interview at the weekend, prompting questions about how close the UK could become to Brussels.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在周末的一次采访中引发了人们对恢复行动自由的猜测，引发了人们对英国与布鲁塞尔的距离有多近的疑问。

paras.en: Confusion deepened after further interviews were interpreted as leaving the door open to an eventual return to freedom of movement and another referendum on the issue.
paras.zh: 在进一步的采访被解释为为最终恢复行动自由和就此问题举行另一次公投敞开大门后，混乱加深了。

paras.en: It forced a Downing Street spokesperson to say the prime minister was not proposing a return to freedom of movement, or any particular option.
paras.zh: 这迫使唐宁街发言人表示，首相并未提议恢复行动自由或任何特定选择。

paras.en: “He is saying that it’s time for us to discuss what kind of long-term relationship with Europe is best for Britain and he is referring to the types of areas that that agreement and long-term future could cover,” she said.
paras.zh: “他说现在是我们讨论哪种与欧洲的长期关系对英国最有利的时候了，他指的是该协议和长期未来可能涵盖的领域类型，”她说。

paras.en: “He is crucially not leaning either way, and that will be for the British public to decide. And his focus for now is on next month’s summit and the practical arrangements that we hope to make there, which will add billions to the economy.”
paras.zh: “至关重要的是，他不会倾向于任何一种方式，这将由英国公众来决定。他目前的重点是下个月的峰会以及我们希望在那里做出的实际安排，这将为经济增加数十亿美元。”

paras.en: She said the government was not yet at the stage of confirming whether the public would decide on proposals for the UK to move closer to the EU.
paras.zh: 她表示，政府尚未确定公众是否会就英国与欧盟靠拢的提议做出决定。

paras.en: Asked whether Burnham accepted that returning to freedom of movement would mean Britain lost control over legal migration, the spokesperson said: “He’s not setting out a concrete position either way. What he’s saying is that he wants to have a conversation with the British public about what our long-term future with the European Union looks like.”
paras.zh: 当被问及伯纳姆是否承认恢复迁徙自由将意味着英国失去对合法移民的控制时，发言人表示：“无论如何，他都没有提出具体立场。他的意思是，他希望与英国公众就我们与欧盟的长期未来进行对话。”

paras.en: In an interview with the Sunday Times, Burnham indicated that staying out of free movement would no longer be a red line in discussions about how the UK can move closer to the EU.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆在接受《星期日泰晤士报》采访时表示，在有关英国如何向欧盟靠拢的讨论中，不参与自由流动​​将不再是一条红线。

paras.en: On Monday, Burnham ruled out the possibility of rejoining the EU within this parliament and indicated he could fight the next general election on a promise to take the UK back into the EU. He said: “I’m not going to move away from the red lines that were in the Labour manifesto.”
paras.zh: 周一，伯纳姆排除了在本届议会内重新加入欧盟的可能性，并表示他可能会在下一次大选中承诺让英国重返欧盟。他说：“我不会偏离工党宣言中的红线。”

paras.en: Hours later, Burnham told journalists “no” when asked if he would allow the UK to join the EU freedom of movement scheme without a referendum.
paras.zh: 几个小时后，当被问及是否允许英国不经公投加入欧盟行动自由计划时，伯纳姆对记者说“不”。

paras.en: When asked whether he wanted Britain to rejoin the EU, he said: “I’ve said I’m going to be honest and say, in my lifetime I would like to see that happen, but I am not going to move ahead of the public. I am not going to dictate in terms of my own opinions here, you have to make sure that the British public are the bosses.”
paras.zh: 当被问及是否希望英国重新加入欧盟时，他说：“我说过，我会诚实地说，在我的有生之年，我希望看到这种情况发生，但我不会领先于公众。我不会在这里用我自己的观点来发号施令，你必须确保英国公众是老板。”

paras.en: Challenged on how his constituents in Makerfield would feel about his discussions about the EU, given 65% of them voted to leave, Burnham added: “I said we wouldn’t rerun the referendum and that’s not what I’m doing.
paras.zh: 鉴于 65% 的 Makerfield 选民投票支持脱欧，当被问到他的选民对他关于欧盟的讨论有何看法时，伯纳姆补充道：“我说过我们不会重新举行公投，但这不是我正在做的事情。

paras.en: “The British public, the people of Makerfield, will be the bosses here. They will decide what happens in relation to Brexit.”
paras.zh: “英国公众，梅克菲尔德的人民，将成为这里的老板。他们将决定与英国脱欧有关的事情。”

paras.en: Burnham even ruled out an early general election on a manifesto change on this issue. He told GMB: “There is no election coming anytime soon. People may as well put that out of their mind.” However, he left the door open to a future fight on a promise to fully rejoin the EU.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆甚至排除了因在这个问题上改变宣言而提前举行大选的可能性。他告诉GMB：“短期内不会举行选举。人们最好把它抛在脑后。”然而，他为未来全面重新加入欧盟的承诺敞开了大门。

paras.en: Burnham will be in Brussels for the UK-EU summit on 20 November, as he seeks to strike a better deal with the bloc. He believes the Brexit deal has “weakened our economy [and] weakened our control of immigration” and is not good enough for the country.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆将于 11 月 20 日前往布鲁塞尔参加英国-欧盟峰会，寻求与欧盟达成更好的协议。他认为英国脱欧协议“削弱了我们的经济[并]削弱了我们对移民的控制”，对国家来说还不够好。

articles.title: Algeria to send troops to Niger in first foreign deployment since 1973

paras.en: Algeria is to send troops to Niger in its first foreign deployment since sending forces to Egypt during the Arab-Israeli war in 1973.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚将向尼日尔派遣军队，这是自1973年阿以战争期间向埃及派遣部队以来的首次海外部署。

paras.en: The deployment follows a visit to Algiers by Niger's defence minister, as the country seeks support against armed groups, some of which are linked to al-Qaeda or Islamic State.
paras.zh: 此次部署是在尼日尔国防部长访问阿尔及尔之后进行的，该国寻求支持打击武装团体，其中一些武装团体与基地组织或伊斯兰国有联系。

paras.en: Algeria has economic interests in Niger, including a planned gas pipeline that would carry Nigerian gas through Niger to Algeria. The troops are expected to protect energy facilities in northern Niger, near the Libyan border.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚在尼日尔拥有经济利益，包括计划修建一条天然气管道，将尼日利亚天然气通过尼日尔输送到阿尔及利亚。预计这些部队将保护尼日尔北部靠近利比亚边境的能源设施。

paras.en: The deployment comes as the two neighbours rebuild ties after a diplomatic rift in 2025, when Niger recalled its ambassador to Algiers.
paras.zh: 这次部署是在尼日尔召回驻阿尔及尔大使后，这两个邻国在 2025 年发生外交裂痕后重建关系之际进行的。

paras.en: Algeria's upper house of parliament held an emergency session on Sunday to vote on the proposed deployment. According to AFP news agency, 148 of the 174 senators voted in favour. It was later backed by the lower house of parliament.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚议会上院周日召开紧急会议，对拟议的部署进行投票。据法新社报道，174名参议员中有148人投了赞成票。后来得到了议会下院的支持。

paras.en: However, the timing and number of soldiers to be deployed have not been announced.
paras.zh: 不过，部署士兵的时间和人数尚未公布。

paras.en: The move would mark the first use of a 2020 constitutional provision allowing overseas military deployments and a significant shift in Algeria's long-standing policy against sending forces abroad.
paras.zh: 此举标志着阿尔及利亚首次使用2020年宪法允许海外军事部署的条款，也标志着阿尔及利亚长期以来反对向海外派遣军队的政策发生重大转变。

paras.en: "We are not sending our soldiers to wage war in Niger, but for a mission to secure economic infrastructure," Algerian senator Belkacem Boulghiti told reporters after the vote.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚参议员贝尔卡塞姆·布尔吉蒂在投票后告诉记者：“我们派遣士兵不是去尼日尔发动战争，而是为了确保经济基础设施的安全。”

paras.en: Algeria's state-owned energy company, Sonatrach, has also signed an agreement with Niger's petroleum ministry to explore for oil in the Kafra region. Two exploration wells are estimated to contain 168 million and 100 million barrels, respectively, Reuters reported.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚国有能源公司Sonatrach也与尼日尔石油部签署了一项协议，在卡夫拉地区勘探石油。据路透社报道，两口勘探井的储量预计分别为 1.68 亿桶和 1 亿桶。

paras.en: Relations between Algeria and Niger have not always been smooth in recent years.
paras.zh: 近年来，阿尔及利亚和尼日尔的关系并不总是一帆风顺。

paras.en: Algeria condemned the 2023 coup that ousted Niger's elected President, Mohamed Bazoum, and brought Gen Abdourahamane Tchiani to power.
paras.zh: 阿尔及利亚谴责 2023 年发生的政变，政变推翻了尼日尔民选总统穆罕默德·巴祖姆，并让阿卜杜拉哈马内·奇亚尼将军上台。

paras.en: Tensions rose again in 2025 after Algeria shot down a Malian drone near its border. Niger recalled its ambassador to Algiers in solidarity with Mali, a close ally which is also under military rule.
paras.zh: 2025 年，阿尔及利亚在其边境附近击落一架马里无人机后，紧张局势再次加剧。尼日尔召回驻阿尔及尔大使，以声援同样处于军事统治之下的亲密盟友马里。

paras.en: Relations have since improved. Tchiani visited Algeria in February 2026, and in late August, President Abdelmadjid Tebboune sent fighter jets to Niger to help suppress a coup attempt and also donated four military helicopters.
paras.zh: 此后关系有所改善。奇亚尼于2026年2月访问阿尔及利亚，8月下旬，总统阿卜杜勒马吉德·特布恩向尼日尔派遣战斗机帮助镇压政变，并捐赠了四架军用​​直升机。

articles.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback

paras.en: Brazil's President Luiz InÃ¡cio Lula da Silva has won a fourth term in office in a dramatic comeback over his right-wing challenger FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro.
paras.zh: 巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦戏剧性地逆转右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗，赢得第四个任期。

paras.en: Left-wing leader Lula took 51.79% of votes, becoming the first president since Brazil's return to civilian rule in 1985 to be elected after losing the first round of voting.
paras.zh: 左翼领导人卢拉以51.79%的得票率，成为巴西1985年恢复文官统治以来首位在首轮投票落败后当选的总统。

paras.en: Lula told jubilant crowds his victory was a "loss for negativity, lies", adding "long live democracy".
paras.zh: 卢拉告诉兴高采烈的人群，他的胜利是“消极和谎言的损失”，并补充道“民主万岁”。

paras.en: FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro, the son of convicted former president Jair Bolsonaro, has so far refused to recognise the result and called for it to be annulled. World leaders have congratulated Lula on his re-election.
paras.zh: 被定罪的前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的儿子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗迄今为止拒绝承认这一结果，并呼吁废除该结果。世界领导人祝贺卢拉再次当选。

paras.en: Bolsonaro's rejection comes as no surprise to observers. His father did the same.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的拒绝对观察人士来说并不奇怪。他的父亲也做了同样的事。

paras.en: But a challenge appears unlikely to succeed.
paras.zh: 但挑战似乎不太可能成功。

paras.en: Firstly, it seems to centre on the unprecedented decision by the Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin to extend voting nationwide by two hours. Some Bolsonaro fans are pointing out that Zanin was once Lula's lawyer and alleging bias.
paras.zh: 首先，它似乎集中在最高法院法官克里斯蒂亚诺·扎宁（Cristiano Zanin）做出的史无前例的决定，即将全国投票时间延长两个小时。一些博尔索纳罗的粉丝指出，扎宁曾经是卢拉的律师，并声称存在偏见。

paras.en: But both teams had requested an extension to voting times - Lula's had argued that voters in SÃ£o Paulo and Bahia could not get to the polling stations because of a lack of buses, while Bolsonaro's campaign cited heavy rain in some areas in the south of the country and in SÃ£o Paulo as their reason.
paras.zh: 但两支球队都要求延长投票时间——卢拉辩称，圣保罗和巴伊亚的选民因缺乏公共汽车而无法前往投票站，而博尔索纳罗的竞选团队则以该国南部和圣保罗部分地区的大雨为理由。

paras.en: Both knew every vote would count and did not want their side to miss out.
paras.zh: 双方都知道每一张选票都很重要，并且不希望自己的一方错失良机。

paras.en: The president of the Supreme Electoral Court KÃ¡ssio Nunes Marques â appointed by Jair Bolsonaro â confirmed Lula's victory and said that the voter extension did not change the outcome of the race.
paras.zh: 由雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗任命的最高选举法院院长卡西奥·努内斯·马克斯证实了卢拉的胜利，并表示选民延期不会改变竞选结果。

paras.en: The sheer gap between the two candidates' tallies - 4.4 million votes - makes the result more difficult to challenge.
paras.zh: 两位候选人的得票数（440 万张）之间的巨大差距使得结果更难以挑战。

paras.en: The result came as a surprise after FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro won the first round on 4 October with 47% of votes ahead of Lula's 45%.
paras.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗 (Flávio Bolsonaro) 于 10 月 4 日以 47% 的得票率领先卢拉 (45%) 赢得第一轮选举，结果令人意外。

paras.en: The right-wing candidate had been poised to give a victory speech and said the result should be annulled, calling it "inexplicable".
paras.zh: 这位右翼候选人原本准备发表胜利演讲，并表示结果应该被废除，并称其“令人费解”。

paras.en: But Lula's camp gained momentum ahead of election day, focusing on boosting voter turnout after 33 million people did not vote in round one.
paras.zh: 但卢拉阵营在选举日之前势头强劲，在第一轮有 3300 万人没有投票后，重点关注提高选民投票率。

paras.en: Sunday saw the largest drop in abstention between the two rounds of a presidential election since 1989.
paras.zh: 周日，两轮总统选举中弃权率出现了自 1989 年以来的最大降幅。

paras.en: As disconsolate Bolsonaro supporters left the house in BrasÃlia where their candidate had been watching the result, Lula took to the streets in SÃ£o Paulo to celebrate and address his supporters.
paras.zh: 当郁郁寡欢的博尔索纳罗支持者离开巴西利亚的家时，他们的候选人一直在观看选举结果，卢拉走上圣保罗街头庆祝并向他的支持者发表讲话。

paras.en: "This, my fourth term, will be the best of any president in the history of this country," the former metal worker said. "It will be the one in which I listen most to the Brazilian people."
paras.zh: 这位前金属工人说：“我的第四个任期将是这个国家历史上最好的总统。” “这将是我最能倾听巴西人民心声的一次。”

paras.en: Vice-President Geraldo Alckmin told him: "You, for the second time, have saved Brazilian democracy."
paras.zh: 副总统杰拉尔多·阿尔克明告诉他：“你第二次拯救了巴西的民主。”

paras.en: After pulling off this victory, Lula faces big hurdles: a divided country, an opponent that won't recognise the result, and a hostile Congress packed full of Bolsonaro allies.
paras.zh: 在取得这场胜利后，卢拉面临着巨大的障碍：一个分裂的国家，一个不承认结果的对手，以及充满博尔索纳罗盟友的敌对国会。

paras.en: Markets reacted negatively to the unexpected outcome. The Sao Paolo stock exchange opened 15% down, sparking a brief suspension before recovering slightly. Interest rate futures rose as investors scrutinised Lula's fiscal plans.
paras.zh: 市场对这一意外结果做出了负面反应。圣保罗证券交易所开盘下跌 15%，短暂停牌后略有回升。由于投资者审视卢拉的财政计划，利率期货上涨。

paras.en: While US President Donald Trump has yet to react, other world leaders from across the political spectrum have congratulated Lula. Mexico's left-wing President Claudia Sheinbaum said in a post on X: "The people of Brazil won."
paras.zh: 尽管美国总统唐纳德·特朗普尚未做出反应，但来自各个政治派别的其他世界领导人都向卢拉表示祝贺。墨西哥左翼总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆在X上发帖称：“巴西人民赢了。”

paras.en: Peru's right-wing President Keiko Fujimori praised Brazil's "democratic day". Similar messages were shared by the presidents of Chile and Ecuador.
paras.zh: 秘鲁右翼总统藤森庆子称赞巴西的“民主日”。智利和厄瓜多尔总统也表达了类似的信息。

paras.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney noted that their two countries had already "flourished under our partnership".
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼指出，两国已经“在我们的伙伴关系下蓬勃发展”。

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said "democracy and multilateralism" had won. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez - also a left-wing leader - called it a "great victory".
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示，“民主和多边主义”赢得了胜利。西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯（也是左翼领导人）称这是“伟大的胜利”。

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron said the two nations should work "in service of a more just world".
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙表示，两国应该“为一个更加公正的世界服务”。

paras.en: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa called Lula's victory one for the "global south and progressive forces throughout the world".
paras.zh: 南非总统西里尔·拉马福萨称卢拉的胜利是“全球南方和全世界进步力量”的胜利。

paras.en: Lula, who turns 81 on Tuesday, has already been president for three non-consecutive terms, serving two terms between January 2003 to December 2010, and again from January 2023.
paras.zh: 卢拉将于周二满 81 岁，他已经担任了三届非连续任期的总统，其中两届任期为 2003 年 1 月至 2010 年 12 月，并从 2023 年 1 月起再次连任。

paras.en: His win makes him the first in Brazilian history to secure a fourth term, which will last until 2030.
paras.zh: 他的胜利使他成为巴西历史上第一个获得第四个任期的人，该任期将持续到 2030 年。

paras.en: But this has been a bitterly fought campaign and the new term - set to start on 5 January - comes amid significant constraints at home and abroad, including animosity from the US president.
paras.zh: 但这是一场艰苦的竞选活动，而新任期——定于 1 月 5 日开始——是在国内外受到重大限制的情况下进行的，其中包括来自美国总统的敌意。

paras.en: Referring to what Trump has called the "Donroe Doctrine" - which seeks to establish US dominance in the Western Hemisphere - Lula used his victory speech to insist that Brazil "will not accept being anyone's backyard".
paras.zh: 卢拉在谈到特朗普所谓的“唐罗主义”（旨在确立美国在西半球的主导地位）时，在胜利演讲中坚称巴西“不会接受成为任何人的后院”。

paras.en: Trump has previously shown support for Bolsonaro's father Jair, who is currently serving a 27-year prison sentence after being convicted of a coup attempt after losing the 2022 elections to Lula. FlÃ¡vio Bolsonaro met Trump at the White House earlier this year to bid for his support.
paras.zh: 特朗普此前曾对博尔索纳罗的父亲贾尔表示支持，贾尔在2022年选举中输给卢拉后被判犯有政变未遂罪，目前正在服刑27年。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗今年早些时候在白宫会见特朗普，争取他的支持。

paras.en: Lula has also bucked a wider trend in Latin America, where voters in countries such as Argentina, Chile and Colombia have put right-wing candidates and parties in power.
paras.zh: 卢拉也在拉丁美洲逆势而行，阿根廷、智利和哥伦比亚等国的选民让右翼候选人和政党掌权。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.

articles.title: NABC Donates Recycled Rides to Two Chicago Veterans
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: On Thursday, Oct. 8, two refurbished vehicles were presented to two Chicago-area U.S. Army veterans in need. The donations were made possible by the National Auto Body Council (NABC) Recycled Rides program, vehicle donor Allstate and repair partner Gerber Collision & Glass and were sponsored by the Growth Conference 2026, a three-day event at the David Rubenstein Forum at the University of Chicago.

A 2019 Ram 1500 was presented to Michael Powell, who was nominated by Chicago Veterans. Powell is a 15-year U.S. Army combat veteran who has dedicated his life after military service to uplifting fellow veterans, young men, children and families throughout his community. He actively serves as a veteran peer leader, life coach, physical fitness coach, mentor and community volunteer, helping others develop confidence, discipline, leadership and healthier lifestyles. Through his work, Powell supports veterans transitioning to civilian life, promotes physical and mental wellness, and mentors young boys and men. Despite his commitment to serving others, limited access to reliable transportation created challenges in attending community programs, mentoring sessions and volunteer opportunities. This refurbished vehicle from the Recycled Rides program will allow Powell to expand his outreach, transport necessary equipment, and continue making a meaningful difference in the lives of veterans and underserved communities.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: A 2021 Kia K5 was presented to Michelle Scott-Bovell, who was nominated by the Edward Hines, Jr. VA Hospital. Scott-Bovell served in the U.S. Army from 2014-2016. She and her husband are both veterans. Unfortunately, she recently fell on hard times due to her husband suffering a stroke and having their income slashed because he is no longer able to work. They were working on rebuilding their lives, but rideshares and public transportation were extremely expensive. Scott-Bovell needed reliable transportation to take her husband to crucial medical appointments. This refurbished vehicle through the Recycled Rides program will guarantee she’ll be able to get him the critical care he needs.

paras.en: Those in the community can support this program in two ways — donate to the program directly or donate their unwanted or non-running vehicle through the Changing and Saving Lives Keys for Change program. They will receive a tax donation for their contribution, and proceeds will help provide reliable transportation for those in need across the country — and in their community.
Additional partners in this presentation included Mobile Auto Solutions, Zeigler Auto Group, Hi-Tech PDR, Advanced Remarketing Services, Cars for Charity, Copart and Enterprise.

Allstate, a level one partner of the NABC, has donated nearly 400 vehicles to people and organizations through the Recycled Rides program, making it one of the largest vehicle donor partners of Recycled Rides.

Gerber Collision & Glass, a level one member of the NABC, was founded in 1937 as a single glass and trim shop and has grown to be one of the largest auto collision and glass repair companies in North America.
